raw.title: Senior Manager - Programmatic Strategy & Ad Operations (GCR)
raw.excerpt: Smadex is a performance advertising engine for mobile apps, enabling the world's leading marketers to grow across Mobile and Connected TV (CTV).
raw.description:
Smadex is a performance advertising engine for mobile apps, enabling the world's leading marketers to grow across Mobile and Connected TV (CTV). Powered by AI models trained on real campaign outcomes, Smadex delivers profitable growth at scale. Headquartered in Barcelona, with teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, Smadex is a business unit of Entravision (NYSE: EVC) and one of the fastest-growing DSPs.



About the role


We are looking for a Senior Manager, Programmatic Strategy & Ad Operations — GCR to lead the Greater China Region (GCR) AdOps team and oversee a diverse portfolio of programmatic campaigns. This role reports directly to the Head of APAC Strategy and Operations.


This is a hands-on leadership and decision-making role. You will drive campaign performance, operational excellence and team development while partnering with Commercial and technical teams to support client growth.


We are looking for someone who takes ownership of problems and actively develops solutions—not someone who waits for direction. You will be expected to use data and sound judgment to make decisions, challenge assumptions constructively and follow through on outcomes.



What you’ll do



Lead strategy and decision-making


  • Own day-to-day AdOps strategy and operational decisions for the GCR team and portfolio.
  • Set priorities and allocate accounts and resources based on client importance, revenue impact, campaign complexity and team capacity.
  • Make informed decisions on optimization plans, testing priorities and workflows within agreed guardrails.
  • Manage and make recommendations on team structure, hiring needs, processes and broader business priorities.
  • Identify risks early and bring leadership a recommended path forward, not just the problem.



Own solutions and drive results


  • Proactively investigate performance, delivery and operational challenges before they escalate.
  • Develop practical, data-backed solutions, including clear actions, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.
  • Make progress independently where appropriate, while knowing when to involve specialists or leadership.
  • Follow solutions through implementation, measure their impact and adjust when needed.
  • Challenge existing approaches and propose better ways to improve performance, efficiency and service quality.



Drive campaign performance and operational excellence


  • Oversee the GCR portfolio, ensuring account strategies align with client KPIs such as ROAS, CPI, LTV and retention.
  • Ensure campaigns are launched, monitored, optimized and troubleshot to a consistently high standard.
  • Guide the team on pacing, bidding, inventory, attribution, measurement and performance analysis.
  • Lead high-stakes launches and complex troubleshooting, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for fraud, discrepancies, delivery risks and other urgent issues.
  • Maintain an agreed, manageable portfolio of hands-on accounts while protecting time to lead the team.



Lead and develop the team


  • Set clear expectations for quality, accountability, proactivity and communication.
  • Coach team members on campaign strategy, analytical thinking and independent decision-making.
  • Hold regular 1:1s, provide constructive feedback and support individual development plans.
  • Identify skills gaps and organize training, onboarding and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in hiring and recommend ways to strengthen team capacity and capabilities.
  • Build a culture where people raise concerns early, propose solutions and learn from results.



Partner across teams


  • Act as the AdOps leadership partner to GCR Commercial and Client Services, aligning on regional account priorities and client needs.
  • Align stakeholders on account priorities, client expectations, risks, timelines and next steps.
  • Translate complex analyses and technical issues into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Supply, Creative and other teams to resolve issues and improve performance.
  • Share recurring challenges and opportunities to help inform product and operational improvements.
  • Constructively push back when a request conflicts with data, client goals, capacity or agreed policies.



Build scalable practices


  • Develop and improve playbooks, QA processes, escalation paths and strategic frameworks.
  • Lead tests with clear hypotheses, success measures and documented learnings.
  • Share insights and best practices across the team and relevant regions.
  • Track portfolio and team health, highlighting performance, risks, capacity and support needed.
  • Stay current on programmatic advertising, mobile measurement, privacy and platform changes.



Decision-making scope


The Senior Manager is expected to decide and act independently on routine GCR team priorities, account allocation, campaign optimization and troubleshooting within agreed guardrails.


For decisions with broader implications—such as material client or financial risk, policy exceptions, hiring, compensation or organizational changes—the Senior Manager should provide a recommendation and align with their manager and relevant stakeholders. Specific approval thresholds should be agreed during onboarding.



What you bring


  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in programmatic advertising, DSP management or mobile performance marketing.
  • Experience leading, coaching or mentoring others while managing complex accounts and campaigns.
  • Strong knowledge of RTB, bidding, inventory management and performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of attribution, fraud prevention and privacy-compliant measurement.
  • Experience partnering with Commercial and technical teams.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn data into practical decisions.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to challenge ideas constructively.
  • Evidence of ownership: identifying a problem, developing a solution and following through on results.



What success looks like


  • The team delivers consistent campaign management and proactive support to Commercial.
  • Team members have clear priorities, manageable workloads and regular coaching.
  • Problems are identified early, with actionable solutions and clear ownership.
  • The Senior Manager makes well-reasoned decisions without relying on their manager for routine operations.
  • Cross-functional partners receive useful recommendations, and improvements are carried through to adoption.
  • The team grows in capability, accountability and confidence over time.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary and aggressive performance-based incentive plans.
  • Fully remote working arrangement with flexible working hours.
  • Career pathing and continued education available.
  • Highly engaged leadership to support you in your position and career.
  • Friendly and inclusive working environment.
  • Opportunity for international travel.
  • Insurance coverage and support.
  • Short Summer Fridays.

Remote Donation Processor / Pledge Drive Specialist

Your customer-service experience can help nonprofit organizations advance meaningful causes.

We are seeking professional and compassionate individuals to answer inbound donor calls and accurately process donations and pledges for established nonprofit fundraising campaigns.

This is a remote1099 independent-contractor opportunityfor individuals who communicate clearly, follow procedures carefully, and understand the importance of treating every donor with professionalism and respect.

Donors Call You—No Solicitation Required

This opportunity involvesstrictly inbound donor calls.

There is:

  • No cold calling
  • No outbound dialing
  • No donor prospecting
  • No door-to-door or direct solicitation
  • No product selling

Donors voluntarily call after seeing, hearing, or responding to an existing nonprofit fundraising campaign. You will assist those callers by documenting their information and processing their intended donations or pledges.

Your Responsibilities

As a Nonprofit Donation Processor or Pledge Drive Specialist, you may:

  • Welcome and assist inbound donors
  • Follow campaign-approved scripts
  • Enter donation and pledge details accurately
  • Confirm important donor information
  • Answer appropriate process-related questions
  • Navigate multiple applications during calls
  • Protect confidential information
  • Follow compliance and quality requirements
  • Maintain dependable attendance during accepted servicing intervals

Requirements

Experience and Qualifications

Qualified applicants should have:

  • A high school diploma or GED
  • Six or more months of remote customer-service experience or at least one year of onsite experience
  • A professional and welcoming phone presence
  • Strong listening and verbal communication skills
  • Accurate typing and data-entry abilities
  • Comfort following scripts and structured processes
  • The ability to work without direct supervision
  • A dedicated, quiet home workspace

Required Technology

  • Windows 11 computer
  • Minimum 8GB RAM; 16GB recommended
  • Noise-canceling USB headset
  • Wired high-speed internet
  • Direct Ethernet connection
  • Quiet and distraction-free workspace

Dual monitors are recommended for ease of navigation.

MacBooks, Chromebooks, tablets, and Wi-Fi-only connections are not compatible.

Applicants should not purchase new equipment solely to submit an application. Equipment requirements should be confirmed before making a purchase.


Benefits

Contract Rate and Availability
  • Most campaigns offer approximately$13–$15 per hour
  • Rates and earning potential may vary by campaign and performance
  • Some campaigns provide servicing availability across a 24-hour operating schedule
  • Contractors choose from available servicing intervals
  • Consistent access depends on campaign demand and contractor performance

Before You Apply

Please understand:

  • This is an independent-contractor opportunity, not employment
  • Certification is required before servicing
  • Certification does not guarantee campaign placement
  • Available hours and campaigns may change
  • Contractors must honor the servicing intervals they select
  • Continued access depends on attendance, professionalism, quality, and performance

If you want to work from home while supporting organizations that depend on public generosity, this may be the right opportunity for you.

Apply today to be considered for a remote Nonprofit Donation Processor or Pledge Drive Specialist opportunity.

raw.excerpt: About Technosylva Technosylva is the leading global provider of wildfire and extreme weather risk intelligence solutions, giving fire agencies, electric utilities and insurers decision-quality intelligence and the confidence to act.
raw.description:
About Technosylva

Technosylva is the leading global provider of wildfire and extreme weather risk intelligence solutions, giving fire agencies, electric utilities and insurers decision-quality intelligence and the confidence to act. By combining advanced fire science with AI and supercomputing, Technosylva's platform processes billions of simulations a day, enabling customers to anticipate impacts, mitigate risk, and coordinate operational responses that safeguard their communities and teams.

Founded in 1997, Technosylva has offices in La Jolla, CA; León, Spain; and Calgary, Canada. Since 2022, backing from leading private equity growth investors has driven a period of significant growth and transformation. The company has scaled to more than 250 employees and now offers its products in more than 10 countries.

Role Overview

Technosylva’s products help our customers protect people and assets by making high quality and timely decisions. They use our software to apply world class fire, weather, and climate modeling and simulations to pressing operational and planning decisions.

As Senior Product Manager for Technosylva's Planning product, you will help drive the evolution of a platform used by major utilities and other safety-critical organizations to quantify wildfire risk at the asset level and prioritize life-saving mitigation and infrastructure hardening investments as we expand from wildfire into multi-hazard planning for flood, wind, and other extreme weather perils and help customers make risk-informed mitigation decisions that pass regulatory and insurance scrutiny. Our product helps customers answer the question: "Which investments will most effectively reduce my organization's risk from wildfires and extreme weather?"

You will take end-to-end ownership of major initiative areas within the Planning portfolio, partnering with the Planning Product Director to shape strategy and then driving your areas from discovery through delivery. Depending on your background and strengths, this could mean going deep on new analytical capabilities like mitigation prioritization and effectiveness modeling, or leading platform modernization efforts that underpin everything we build. Either way, you'll work across engineering, data science, design, sales, and customer success to ship capabilities that drive meaningful value for our customers.

Your work will directly support utilities and other organizations in protecting lives, property, and critical infrastructure — and will help Technosylva grow revenue within established markets and expand into new markets like insurance.

The people at Technosylva are passionate, expert, and welcoming. You’ll find this to be an environment where you can grow, while working to address some of the most urgent and challenging problems we face.

Responsibilities

  • Lead product discovery through customer interviews, data analysis, and market research to identify valuable, usable, and feasible solutions for our utility and agency customers
  • Create and maintain product artifacts while driving the process from conception through go-to-market, including beta testing and rollout strategies
  • Partner with engineering teams to define technical solutions and success metrics that align with business objectives
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap and vision based on customer needs, market opportunities, and business strategy
  • Build strong relationships with utility and other customers to deeply understand their workflows and pain points
  • Collaborate across sales and customer success teams to gather feedback and market requirements
  • Continuously refine product features based on customer feedback and emerging market needs
  • Assist with product pricing and packaging strategies

Required Skills

  • 4+ years of product management experience, including experience leading B2B/enterprise SaaS products
  • Track record of driving product discovery and validation, including leading research programs and developing systematic approaches to customer feedback
  • Expertise in SaaS metrics, unit economics, and business strategy
  • Experience managing large-scale enterprise deployments with utility companies or similar regulated industries
  • Advanced analytical skills with the ability to develop frameworks for complex decision-making
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and align cross-functional teams

Preferred Skills

  • Product development experience in ClimateTech, wildfire and/or utility software
  • Deep understanding of utility planning and regulatory frameworks
  • Experience with ML and advanced analytics
  • Experience using AI tools to manage product roadmaps, requirement writing and wireframing or UI/UX design

raw.description:
Help Shape Markets. Not Just Respond to Them.

At Turner & Townsend, we're building a globally connected, digitally enabled Strategic Market Management capability that helps clients make better investment decisions, strengthen supply chain resilience and improve delivery confidence across major programmes.

Working across infrastructure, energy, defence, real estate and public sector investment, we help clients understand how markets operate today, anticipate how they may evolve tomorrow, and develop strategies that improve outcomes.

Combining market intelligence, market engagement, strategic supplier relationship management, analytics and commercial insight, we provide the evidence and advice that supports critical investment, delivery and procurement decisions on some of the world's most complex and ambitious programmes.

As our capability continues to grow, we are looking for exceptional people at all levels, from early-career analysts through to senior leaders.

What We Do

Our teams help clients:

  • Understand market capacity, capability and resilience
    - Identify supply chain risks, constraints and opportunities
    - Improve investment and business case decisions through market intelligence
    - Design and deliver effective market engagement strategies
    - Inform commercial, procurement and delivery decisions
    - Develop strategic supplier and ecosystem approaches
    - Monitor market trends, competitive dynamics and future market developments
    - Build confidence in programme affordability, deliverability and market response

Where You Could Contribute

  • Develop market intelligence and analytical insight
    - Assess supplier capability, capacity and market maturity
    - Undertake market research, benchmarking and trend analysis
    - Design and deliver market engagement activities
    - Support strategic sourcing and commercial decision-making
    - Advise clients on market risks, opportunities and interventions
    - Build relationships with suppliers, industry bodies and client stakeholders
    - Lead projects, workstreams and client engagements
    - Develop innovative approaches, digital tools and data-led solutions
    - Help shape the future direction of Strategic Market Management within Turner & Townsend

We welcome applications from people with experience in areas such as:

  • Infrastructure and construction

- Energy and utilities

- Defence and aerospace

  • Real estate
    - Procurement and commercial management
    - Supply chain and logistics
    - Market intelligence and market research
    - Economics
    - Data analytics and business intelligence
    - Strategy and management consulting

- Programme and project delivery

Equally, we recognise that some of the best talent comes from less conventional backgrounds.

We're interested in people who are intellectually curious, analytically minded, commercially aware and motivated by solving complex challenges.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Team

Successful individuals typically demonstrate:

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
    - Commercial awareness and strategic judgement
    - Curiosity about how markets behave and evolve
    - The ability to turn complex information into clear, actionable insight
    - Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
    - A collaborative mindset and willingness to challenge established thinking
    - An interest in the intersection of markets, investment, supply chains and programme delivery

For senior appointments, we're particularly interested in individuals who can build trusted client relationships, lead complex engagements, shape new propositions and support the growth of high-performing teams.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join a capability at a formative stage of growth.

You'll work alongside experts in procurement, commercial strategy, programme delivery, data analytics and digital innovation, helping clients address some of the most significant investment and delivery challenges across global markets.

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to help define what Strategic Market Management becomes, both within Turner & Townsend and across the industries we serve.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at

Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

  • We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
  • In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
  • We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

  • Elixir / Erlang / OTP
  • Phoenix, Phoenix LiveView, Phoenix PubSub
  • Ecto & PostgreSQL
  • Oban (background jobs)
  • Tailwind CSS, LiveView JS hooks
  • Telemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry
  • Docker, Kubernetes, GCP

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Elixir Engineer at Hack The Box:

  • Design and build production Phoenix applications — REST APIs, LiveView UIs, and real-time features on PubSub and Channels.
  • Model and evolve data with Ecto and PostgreSQL, writing performant queries and safe, zero-downtime migrations.
  • Build fault-tolerant systems with OTP: supervision trees, GenServers, and distributed BEAM patterns where they earn their keep.
  • Own background processing and scheduled workloads with Oban, with proper observability via Telemetry and metrics.
  • Ship secure-by-default code: authentication/authorization patterns, least-privilege data access, and input hardening — this is a security company.
  • Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes/GCP, contributing to CI/CD pipelines and release quality.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership through code reviews, design sessions, and coding standards.
  • Document decisions and communicate clearly in a remote-first environment, contributing to a culture of thoughtful async collaboration.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior Elixir Engineer at Hack The Box:

  • 5+ years of professional backend or full-stack development, with 3+ years shipping production Elixir/Phoenix.
  • Strong grasp of OTP and the BEAM — processes, supervision, GenServer/GenStage, and when not to reach for them.
  • Hands-on experience building interactive UIs with Phoenix LiveView (components, streams, JS hooks).
  • Deep Ecto and PostgreSQL knowledge: schema design, query optimization, indexing, migrations.
  • Experience with background job systems (Oban preferred) and event-driven architectures.
  • Solid testing discipline with ExUnit; comfortable with property-based and integration testing.
  • Familiarity with containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD best practices.
  • Security-minded engineering: OWASP fundamentals, auth patterns, secure handling of user data.
  • Excellent written & verbal communication, especially in remote/async environments, with a bias toward documenting architecture and decisions.

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

  • 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
  • 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
  • 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.
  • 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior Elixir Engineer:

  • 25 annual leave days
  • Paid parental leave
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
  • State-of-the-art equipment
  • Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
  • Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Senior Elixir Engineer:

  • Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
  • Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
  • Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.
  • Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.
  • Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
  • Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
  • Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

Hack Your Career, Today. Join us in this epic adventure of cybersecurity at Hack The Box! 🚀🔒💻

At Hack The Box, we are on a quest to find the most exceptional and enthusiastic talent to join our team. Whether or not you consider yourself a gamer, we value what makes you unique and want to know more about you. ABOUT HTB:

Hack The Box is the leading cyber readiness platform for the agentic era, battle-testing and upskilling both humans and AI agents to enhance organizational cyber resilience. Monash Online delivers world-class learning though degrees specifically designed for the online student. Each degree is tailored to provide opportunities for students who are often unable to undertake university studies on campus. 

At Monash Online, the student is at the forefront of everything we do. This role is an opportunity to support and guide our students through their learning journey. Our Online Learning Advisers (OLAs) are the subject matter experts who facilitate the student’s learning, with a focus on helping them achieve their goals.

Research/Scholarly Contributions: Demonstrated research, publication or other scholarly outputs/teaching activities relevant to the discipline.

raw.title: Staff Data Engineer
raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Data Engineer.

About the job

This position is needed to design, build, and optimize Twilio's next-generation unified data platforms and services to power strategic, data-driven business decisions.

As a senior technical leader on our Enterprise Data Engineering team, you will drive a massive, highly visible transformation to unify disparate data lakes into a single, high-performance platform. By combining classic dimensional modeling with cutting-edge AI, you will accelerate data delivery at an immense scale. This is your chance to solve complex architectural challenges, mentor rising talent, and directly influence Twilio’s strategic direction.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Architect and scale high-performance data platforms to unify acquired data lakes, improving delivery speed by leveraging AI-driven workflows.
  • Design robust ETL pipelines and data integration frameworks using Spark, dbt, and AWS to support rapidly growing enterprise data needs.
  • Establish rigorous data modeling standards (Dimensional, Medallion) and implement full-stack observability to ensure data trust.
  • Mentor peer engineers, promoting technical excellence and living our We > Me value through active collaboration with architects and product teams.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 8+ years of professional data engineering experience with progressive technical leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in languages, including scripting (e.g. Python, Scala, Java) and expert-level SQL.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing AWS cloud data infrastructure and scalable ETL pipelines (using Spark, dbt, or AWS Glue).
  • Expert knowledge of data modeling (Dimensional Modeling, Lakehouse/Medallion architectures).
  • Strong experience with distributed databases and query engines (such as Snowflake, Redshift, Athena, or Presto).
  • Proven track record of peer mentoring and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Desired:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines (Buildkite, ArgoCD).
  • Hands-on experience with ingestion systems (Kafka, Debezium, Meltano) and modern data formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Hudi).
  • Familiarity with relational/OLTP databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and OLAP databases (Clickhouse, Druid).
  • Experience leveraging Generative AI (LLMs, Langchain, Bedrock) to accelerate data delivery.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Senior Customer Service Lead & Trainer – Team Leadership & Customer Experience | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Senior Customer Service Lead & Trainer to lead, coach, and develop a remote customer support team serving U.S.-based customers.

This is more than a traditional customer service position. You’ll take ownership of team performance, employee training, quality assurance, escalations, and overall customer experience.

You’ll ensure agents consistently deliver professional, efficient, and high-quality support across phone, email, chat, and other digital channels while using coaching and performance data to continuously improve the team.

If you’re an experienced customer service leader who knows how to develop people, improve performance, maintain accountability, and build strong service standards, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Lead and manage a distributed customer service team
  • Monitor agent productivity, quality, attendance, and KPI performance
  • Conduct regular one-on-one coaching and performance reviews
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve performance
  • Hold team members accountable to service and productivity standards
  • Identify performance gaps and implement improvement plans
  • Track progress following coaching and corrective actions
  • Build a consistent, accountable, and high-performing remote team culture

Training & Onboarding

  • Own onboarding and training for new customer service hires
  • Develop and maintain:
    • Training materials
    • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
    • Call scripts
    • Customer service guidelines
    • Quality standards
  • Conduct structured training and coaching sessions
  • Review calls and customer interactions to identify training opportunities
  • Ensure new hires are fully prepared before independently handling customers
  • Continuously improve training programs based on recurring performance gaps

Quality Assurance & Coaching

  • Conduct regular call reviews and QA evaluations
  • Monitor adherence to scripts, processes, and customer experience standards
  • Identify recurring quality issues across the team
  • Coach agents on:
    • Communication
    • Professionalism
    • Problem-solving
    • Customer handling
    • Process adherence
  • Track improvement following coaching sessions
  • Maintain consistent QA standards across the customer support operation

Customer Experience & Escalations

  • Handle complex or escalated customer concerns professionally
  • Ensure customers receive consistent support across:
    • Phone
    • Email
    • Chat
    • Other digital communication channels
  • Maintain high standards for tone, responsiveness, and professionalism
  • Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements
  • Help resolve operational issues affecting customer satisfaction
  • Support agents in navigating difficult or sensitive customer situations

Customer Support Operations & Reporting

  • Track and report on:
    • Customer satisfaction
    • Response times
    • Resolution rates
    • Agent productivity
    • QA scores
    • Training performance
  • Maintain accurate documentation and operational records
  • Use customer service platforms, VOIP systems, ticketing tools, and reporting systems effectively
  • Identify trends and recurring performance issues through support data
  • Collaborate with other departments to resolve recurring customer or operational issues

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in customer service leadership, support supervision, or customer operations management
  • Proven experience managing remote and/or offshore customer service teams
  • Strong experience with employee coaching, training, and performance management
  • Experience conducting call reviews and quality assurance evaluations
  • Strong escalation management and customer problem-solving skills
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Experience working with:
    • Customer support platforms
    • VOIP systems
    • Ticketing systems
    • Digital communication tools
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to work U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers
  • Background in:
    • Facility Management
    • Energy
    • Tech-enabled services
  • Experience working in startup or high-growth environments
  • Experience scaling customer support teams
  • Strong knowledge of KPI-driven customer service operations
  • Experience developing:
    • SOPs
    • QA scorecards
    • Training programs
    • Coaching frameworks

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Know how to lead and develop people, not simply supervise them
  • Can give direct, constructive feedback professionally
  • Hold team members accountable while maintaining strong morale
  • Stay calm and solutions-focused during difficult escalations
  • Have high standards for customer communication and service quality
  • Understand how to use QA and performance data to improve agent performance
  • Are highly organized and consistent with follow-through
  • Can effectively manage a distributed team without constant oversight
  • Know how to turn recurring performance issues into structured coaching and training opportunities

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing team performance, attendance, customer service KPIs, and any outstanding escalations.

You’ll listen to calls, complete QA evaluations, coach agents on communication and performance, and conduct onboarding or training sessions where needed.

Throughout the day, you may handle escalated customer concerns, review response and resolution times, identify recurring service issues, update SOPs or scripts, and coordinate with internal teams on operational improvements.

You’ll also monitor agents requiring additional coaching and ensure improvement plans are producing measurable results.

In short: you ensure the customer service team is well-trained, accountable, consistent, and capable of delivering an excellent customer experience.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Quality assurance scores
  • Response and resolution times
  • Agent productivity
  • Training and onboarding effectiveness
  • Escalation resolution rates
  • Process and SOP adherence
  • Performance improvement following coaching
  • Overall team reliability and consistency

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over customer service quality and team performance
  • Direct influence on how agents are trained, coached, and developed
  • Opportunity to shape QA standards and training systems
  • Leadership responsibility within a growing remote support environment
  • Strong visibility across operations and customer experience
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Customer Support Manager
    • Head of Customer Experience
    • Training & Quality Manager
    • Customer Operations Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Assessment
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have extensive customer service leadership experience and enjoy coaching teams, improving service quality, developing training programs, and building accountable support operations, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of a remote customer service team where your leadership will directly influence both agent performance and the customer experience.

As a leader in our field, we offer an opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, dynamic, forward-thinking team. Your work will directly contribute to enhancing scientific discovery and innovation.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us:

  • Impactful Work: Your role in implementing and managing QBench directly influences the success and efficiency of our clients’ laboratories.
  • Career Growth: We’re committed to your professional development, offering continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects. Our rapid growth means the coming years present many opportunities for career advancement.

  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a comprehensive salary package, including base and variable components tied to performance metrics.

This is a fully remote position that provides leadership for the implementation and deployment of QBench and then provides long-term account management support for the adoption and growth of QBench for our customers.

This role is responsible for delivering and supporting the implementation of multiple customer projects. You will provide oversight of the product environment and configuration of the system. This position also positively impacts retention and renewal rates through proactive account management.

Your main tasks will include planning a schedule for implementation, defining goals, and tracking progress toward those goals. You will also perform detailed requirements analysis, document processes, oversee software projects from start to finish, and give customer training presentations. You will work directly with a wide variety of laboratory staff, resolving their technical questions and issues to help leverage the QBench platform to maximize their lab's effectiveness, efficiency, and productivity.

To succeed in this role, you should have a natural analytical way of thinking and be able to explain complex concepts to non-technical users.

  • Own the overall relationship with the customer.
  • Plan, lead, and organize multiple project initiatives in accordance with the approved scope and schedule.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn complex software products.
  • Strong ability to pick up new systems quickly and effectively.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

raw.description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: Must overlap at least 4 hours with U.S. Pacific Time

About the Role

We are looking for a senior Full Stack AI Developer to lead the development of an internal AI-powered operating platform.

You will work across data engineering, API integrations, AI/LLM applications, dashboards, automation, and modern web development. You will help design the architecture, build production-ready systems, and improve the platform based on real business needs.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can propose solutions, make technical decisions, and take projects from idea to production.

Key Responsibilities

Data & Platform Development

  • Build and maintain a centralized data warehouse using SQL and modern data tools.
  • Develop a shared metrics layer so business metrics are consistently defined across dashboards.
  • Build data pipelines, models, monitoring, and automated reporting.
  • Connect data from multiple business systems into a centralized platform.

API Integrations & Automation

  • Build and maintain REST API and webhook integrations with platforms such as ServiceTitan, Dialpad, Brex, Ramp, QuickBooks Online, payroll, Google Ads, and other business systems.
  • Develop event-driven automations that monitor business processes and trigger alerts when requirements are missed.
  • Build automated checks and scorecards for operations, payroll, accounting, and marketing.

AI & LLM Development

  • Build AI-powered assistants that can answer business questions using company data.
  • Develop retrieval, text-to-SQL, semantic layers, agents, and tool-use workflows.
  • Design prompts, evaluations, guardrails, and systems that control AI cost and latency.
  • Build AI applications that are reliable enough for real users and business operations.

Dashboards & Web Applications

  • Build dashboards for operations, sales, finance, marketing, and customer service.
  • Develop modern web applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and React or similar technologies.
  • Build backend services using Node.js or Python.
  • Support future customer-facing applications for booking, payments, invoices, job photos, and service history.

Security & Infrastructure

  • Implement secure authentication, OAuth/SSO, role-based access, secrets management, and audit logging.
  • Follow least-privilege access and appropriate PII handling practices.
  • Support CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and production reliability.
  • Build systems that are properly documented and supported with runbooks.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience with production systems.
  • 2+ years of experience building data pipelines, data warehouses, and LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong experience with SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with dbt or equivalent data modeling tools, orchestration, and monitoring.
  • Strong experience building REST APIs and webhook integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with AI/LLM applications, including agents, tool use, text-to-SQL, retrieval, and evaluation.
  • Strong TypeScript/JavaScript and React or similar frontend experience.
  • Experience with Node.js or Python backend services.
  • Experience with serverless or edge technologies; Cloudflare Workers is a plus.
  • Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Strong understanding of application security, authentication, permissions, secrets, and audit logging.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of architecture and technical decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating with ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro, or similar field-service platforms.
  • Experience with React Native or Flutter.
  • Experience working with business SaaS integrations at scale.
  • Experience handling customer data and building systems with SOC 2-style security controls.
  • Experience building AI assistants used by real business users.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You can design the architecture, not just implement assigned tickets.
  • You build production-ready systems that are monitored, documented, and maintainable.
  • You understand how technology connects to business metrics and outcomes.
  • You can explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • You take ownership from planning through deployment and ongoing improvement.
  • You are comfortable working remotely with async communication and regular demos.

Working Style

You will work remotely with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific Time. The team works primarily through async communication, with regular collaboration and weekly demos of shipped work.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

raw.title: Social Media and Community Manager
raw.excerpt: OVERVIEW Better Together works to end the root causes of poverty, dependency, divorce and child abuse by leveraging the power of the local church to provide struggling families with supportive relationships and meaningful work.
raw.description:
OVERVIEW

Better Together works to end the root causes of poverty, dependency, divorce and child abuse by leveraging the power of the local church to provide struggling families with supportive relationships and meaningful work. Once properly supported, families can achieve independence, stay together and thrive.

The Social Media and Community Engagement Manager will lead Better Together’s social media strategy, driving innovative campaigns, compelling storytelling, and meaningful digital community engagement. This role proactively identifies opportunities to expand organizational visibility, strengthen brand affinity, position Better Together as a thought leader, and inspire audiences to take action. As the strategic owner of Better Together’s social media presence, this individual combines creative execution, data-driven decision-making, and relationship-building to advance organizational and regional priorities.

The ideal candidate is a savvy online communicator with a passion for leveraging social media to create impact and inspire action.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at Better Together are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five core values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of these questions, you may be a fit.

  1. Owners Mindset: You are invested in the outcomes of our mission.
  1. Are you a self-starter who is able to take initiative in order to complete a task?
  2. Do you often seek opportunities for professional growth?
  1. Choosing Gratitude: There are many things in life that can make us upset. Every day we have a choice to either be negative or give thanks.
  1. Do you often go out of your way to help others?
  2. Have you written a thank-you card in the last 30 days?
  3. Are you a positive person who is more focused on opportunities instead of obstacles?
  1. Love Others: We aim to love others like Christ loves us. Our hope is that our lives would be filled and overflowing with love, so that we can make a difference in this world.
  1. Do people often say you are a good listener?
  2. Do you make decisions based on what’s best for others over yourself?
  3. Do you often find yourself looking for ways to make others feel empowered, important and appreciated?
  1. Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.
  1. Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?
  2. Do you tend to be the one who initiates conversations with colleagues, rather than waiting for them to come to you?
  1. The Sky is the Limit: We have a big vision at Better Together. No one on our team is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.
  1. Do you often set yourself audacious goals?
  2. Do you wholeheartedly agree with our principles, which include that people’s lives are made better through work and that we can and will end the foster care crisis?

The vast majority of those who don’t get hired (or don’t last) at Better Together lack a fit with these values. Be prepared to have very candid conversations about them in our interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The Social Media and Community Manager will have five primary roles, broken down into key responsibilities. They are:

Social Media Strategy and Campaign Management

  • Independently develop and execute proactive, month-over-month social media campaigns aligned with organizational priorities, audience engagement goals, and emerging opportunities.
  • Identify innovative opportunities to leverage social media for thought leadership, brand awareness, audience growth, and organizational influence.
  • Own the overarching social media strategy and editorial direction, balancing planned campaigns with timely, relevant content opportunities.
  • Stay current with social media trends, tools, and best practices to enhance performance, engagement, and brand presence.
  • Partner with the marketing team to align social media efforts with broader campaigns and organizational objectives.
  • Evaluate campaign performance and proactively recommend strategic adjustments to improve engagement, reach, and measurable organizational outcomes.

Content Creation and Distribution

  • Curate, create, and schedule engaging editorial content across platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), TikTok, Threads, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
  • Independently conceptualize and produce engaging, platform-specific content while collaborating with the Content and Creative team on larger campaign assets and storytelling initiatives.
  • Partner with the Video team on production, including concepting, scripting, and execution, to craft audience-specific video content.
  • Work closely with the Better Together team and broader community to create, edit, and distribute user-generated content (UGC), amplifying authentic stories and experiences.
  • Proactively identify compelling stories, trends, and timely content opportunities that can be translated into engaging social media campaigns.
  • Manage the social content calendar and coordinate the content pipeline with internal teams and stakeholders, balancing scheduled posts with real-time opportunities.

Digital Community Engagement and Real-Time Connection

  • Build an active online community of Better Together advocates. Identify and cultivate social media champions who share our stories and introduce others to our mission. Use those relationships to grow awareness, deepen engagement, and nurture warm leads for volunteering, events, and partnerships.
  • Proactively identify and cultivate relationships with relevant influencers, community partners, thought leaders, and digital stakeholders to expand Better Together’s reach and influence.
  • Identify opportunities to elevate Better Together’s voice in relevant social conversations, emerging trends, and issues aligned with its mission.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Communications to amplify public relations initiatives, organizational thought leadership, media coverage, and strategic messaging through social channels.
  • Develop creative digital engagement initiatives that foster meaningful connections, strengthen brand affinity, and encourage audiences to take action.
  • Lead proactive engagement strategies across social platforms, including relevant community groups, partner organizations, and influential voices.
  • Engage directly with our online community. Respond promptly to comments, messages, and mentions, tag relevant partners and supporters when appropriate, and actively participate in online groups and conversations aligned with our mission.

Analytics, Social Listening, and Regional Support

  • Establish and monitor key social media performance indicators, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations to marketing leadership.
  • Evaluate social media’s contribution to broader organizational goals, including volunteer acquisition, event participation, community partnerships, and audience growth.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize content, campaigns, and engagement strategies based on performance data and audience behavior.
  • Leverage social listening tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite) to gather insights and align content with audience preferences.
  • Collaborate with regional teams to promote local initiatives and customize content for specific needs and priorities.
  • Support regional EDs with tailored content and strategies to ensure alignment with overarching social media goals.
  • Seek opportunities to convert audiences into active participants, such as driving volunteer sign-ups, partnerships, or event attendance.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in social media strategy, digital marketing, community engagement, or related fields, with demonstrated ownership of successful social media campaigns and measurable results.
  • Proven ability to independently develop and execute strategic social media initiatives aligned with broader organizational objectives.
  • Experience cultivating influencer relationships, digital partnerships, and proactive community engagement opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of how social media supports public relations, thought leadership, brand positioning, and organizational visibility.
  • Strong understanding of content creation, creative strategies, and platform-specific best practices across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
  • Experience in creating and editing social media shorts, reels, and video content tailored to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in leveraging social media tools such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or similar, and analytics platforms to track performance and optimize strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience translating social media performance data into actionable strategic recommendations.
  • Technological proficiency in tools like Asana, ActiveCampaign, WordPress, and Basecamp for task management, integrations, and content workflows (nice to have).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a knack for crafting engaging, audience-specific messaging and creative storytelling.
  • Demonstrated creative storytelling abilities, including independently conceptualizing and producing engaging social media content.
  • Excellent project management, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and execute with minimal oversight.
  • Proven ability to foster community engagement and cultivate relationships with partners, influencers, and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with social listening tools and the ability to extract actionable insights to inform strategy.
  • A strong understanding of brand alignment and ability to collaborate with regional teams to customize content and initiatives.
  • Match Better Together’s core values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION AND COMPENSATION

Better Together seeks to fill this position as soon as possible. The organization’s headquarters are in Naples, Florida, but all the Better Together staff reside in Florida. Better Together has built a highly successful work culture over the past decade with systems and structures designed for clarity, flexibility, and great communication. Key elements of the environment include:

  • Weekly team meetings with clear accountability and the opportunity to solve issues as a team.
  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with the Better Together vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the Better Together team, our policies, and how we operate
  • Home office setup, including equipment and communication tools you need to hit the ground running

Compensation and Benefits:

Better Together offers a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a health benefit and generous paid leave plan. It includes:

  • Medical (99% employer paid, employee only)
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Time off
  • Retirement Savings Plan with 50/50 employer match up to 6%

Better Together is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion. We comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are given equal opportunity for employment and advancement within the company.

QUESTIONS

Please direct all questions to .

raw.description:
Hopkins ist eine auf die Rechte von Privatpersonen spezialisierte, deutschlandweit tätige Kanzlei. Gegründet in 2019 durch Arend Liese, zuvor Rechtsanwalt bei Freshfields Bruckhaus Deringer, denkt Hopkins das Prinzip Kanzlei und Rechtsdurchsetzung täglich neu - mit großem Fokus auf moderne Technologie und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit. Mit einem Team von mehr als 150 Personen berät und vertritt Hopkins Privatpersonen deutschlandweit in allen rechtlichen Belangen.

Aufgaben

  • Du etablierst eine neue Ära der Rechtsdurchsetzung und bist Teil der Mission, juristische Prozesse zu digitalisieren und automatisieren

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Beziehung und den Kontakt zu Deinen Mandantinnen und Mandanten und führst rechtliche Beratung und Vertretung im Bereich von mietrechtlichen Fällen durch

  • Du übernimmst die Verhandlungen mit Gegenseiten sowie gegnerischen Anwälten

  • Du erstellst Klageschriften, Schriftsätze, Verträge, etc.

  • Du bearbeitest eigenständig Fälle und vertrittst unsere Mandanten sowohl außergerichtlich als auch vor Gericht

  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen anderen internen Teams zusammen

  • Du gibst Deine Erfahrungen und Dein Feedback in unseren Produktentwicklungsprozess mit ein und arbeitest direkt mit Produktmanagern und der Geschäftsführung an Verbesserungen in der Automatisierung von Abläufen

Qualifikation

Du bist Volljurist:in mit Zulassung zur Rechtsanwaltschaft in Deutschland oder hast diese bereits beantragt. Zudem verfügst Du über mindestens ein Jahr Berufserfahrung (idealerweise im Mietrecht). Deine Arbeitsweise ist pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und Du hast große Lust und Energie, innerhalb eines dynamischen Arbeitsumfelds an der Zukunft des Rechtsmarkts mitzuwirken. Die Vision, in einer durch Technologie skalierbaren Kanzlei mitzuarbeiten, inspiriert Dich und Du denkst gerne darüber nach, wie sich juristische Prozesse durch die Nutzung von Daten und Software verbessern lassen. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und gewissenhaft, setzt dabei klare Prioritäten und legst eine unternehmerische und ergebnisorientierte Denkweise an den Tag. Dazu bist Du lernwillig und übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Arbeit. Deine Stärke in der Kommunikation und Dein Verhandlungsgeschick zeichnen Dich aus.

Benefits

  • Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, als Protagonist die Anwaltskanzlei der Zukunft zu formen und die Welt der Rechtsdienstleistungen für Privatpersonen grundlegend zu verändern

  • Du übernimmst schnell viel Verantwortung für unsere Kanzlei und sammelst für Deinen Fachanwaltstitel in kurzer Zeit viele relevante Fälle

  • Du arbeitest von dort, wo Du am produktivsten bist: Unser Team ist in Deutschland verteilt und arbeitet zum Großteil remote. Wir haben aber natürlich auch ein Büro in Berlin, in dem Du jederzeit willkommen bist.

  • Du bist Teil eines inspirierenden Teams bestehend aus Experten vieler verschiedener Disziplinen

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Produktmanagern und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast großen Einfluss auf die Technologie, die wir bauen

  • Wir bieten eine attraktive und leistungsbezogene Vergütung

  • Wir übernehmen alle Kosten, die mit Deiner Tätigkeit als Rechtsanwalt sowie dem Erhalt und der Aufrechterhaltung der Zulassung zusammenhängen (Versicherungen, Kammergebühren, etc.)

Insbesondere hast Du große Lust und Energie, in einem Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten zu wirken, Themen aufzubauen und zu verändern. Dabei bist Du inspiriert durch den Gedanken mit Deiner Arbeit Menschen zu ihren Rechten zu verhelfen und Zugang zu erstklassiger rechtlicher Beratung zu ermöglichen.

Wir freuen uns sehr auf ein Kennenlernen, wenn diese Herausforderung Dich anspricht.

raw.description:
Our Purpose

Bringing quality, safety, and sustainability to life

About us

Intertek is a leading Total Quality Assurance provider to industries worldwide. Through our network of more than 1,000 laboratories and offices and over 46,000 colleagues in more than 100 countries, we deliver innovative Assurance, Testing, Inspection and Certification solutions that help our customers operate safely and sustainably.

Team & Role Overview

We are looking for a Vulnerability Management Analyst to join our Global Cyber Security team.

In this role, you will support Intertek’s global Threat & Vulnerability Management capability, contributing to vulnerability management, cyber threat intelligence, digital risk protection, and external attack surface management activities. You will help identify, assess, prioritize, and coordinate remediation of security vulnerabilities while supporting proactive threat detection, security investigations, and incident response activities to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform internal and external vulnerability assessments using Vulnerability Management and External Attack Surface Management tools.
  • Monitor CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) alerts and security vendor advisories.
  • Prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and business impact.
  • Coordinate remediation activities and support vulnerability validation, rescans, and exception management processes.
  • Support response efforts related to critical, actively exploited, and zero-day vulnerabilities.
  • Analyze emerging cyber threats, digital risk exposure, phishing activity, credential leaks, and dark web intelligence.
  • Collaborate with Cyber Security Analysts on threat hunting activities and incident investigations.
  • Support incident containment, remediation, and continuous improvement of cyber security operations.
  • Prepare vulnerability governance reporting and provide risk-based remediation recommendations to stakeholders.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience in vulnerability management, threat intelligence, cyber security operations, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of vulnerability assessment processes and remediation lifecycle management.
  • Understanding of CVE, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, and risk-based vulnerability prioritization methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Windows, Linux, networking, cloud technologies, and internet-facing infrastructure.
  • Understanding of cyber threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK framework, indicators of compromise, and threat actor techniques.
  • Experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning tools, OSINT sources, SIEM and EDR platforms.
  • Ability to assess and communicate cyber security risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical mindset, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
  • Fluent English.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Salary: 12,000 - 15,000 PLN gross/month, depending on skills and experience.
  • Access to best-in-class security training platform
  • Eligibility for security certification on a regular basis
  • Medical cover package
  • Multisport

raw.title: Principal Product Lead
raw.excerpt: Role Overview Genus is building a modern Product capability focused on understanding the problems that matter, connecting business needs with Technology capability and delivering measurable outcomes.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Genus is building a modern Product capability focused on understanding the problems that matter, connecting business needs with Technology capability and delivering measurable outcomes. This position represents a great opportunity to join at an early stage of creation

We are looking for a Principal Product Lead – Business Divisions to join our Product Leadership Team. This senior role combines direct Product Owner responsibility for our Commercial team with a broader Product partnering role across the ABS and PIC businesses.

Working closely with Product Managers and key stakeholders, you will develop a deep understanding of business priorities, customers, processes and challenges. You will connect these needs with the wider Product and Technology organisation, helping teams fully understand the problem before committing to a solution.

For Commercial, you will translate the agreed business strategy into clear priorities, lead discovery, shape the roadmap and remain accountable throughout delivery, adoption and value realisation.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will also help strengthen Product capability across Genus by leading a small team of professional Product Owners, mentoring colleagues and sharing good practice.

This is a remote role with some travel both domestically for team meetings as well as internationally

The salary for this role will be up to circa £100,000 with flexibility for outstanding candidates

You Will

  • Own Commercial Product delivery: Translate the agreed commercial strategy into an outcome-focused roadmap, prioritised backlog and clear Product decisions.
  • Build strong partnerships across ABS and PIC: Work with business Product Managers and stakeholders to understand priorities, customer needs, opportunities and operational challenges, ensuring these are appropriately reflected in each business area’s commercial Product plans and priorities.
  • Stay close to the business: Spend time with the people doing the work to understand how processes operate in practice and identify areas of friction and opportunity.
  • Lead effective discovery: Explore the problem, available evidence, user needs and desired outcomes before determining the most appropriate intervention.
  • Influence Product direction: Bring business insight, evidence and Product thinking into roadmap and investment discussions. Help shape departmental Product plans and priorities across ABS and PIC, guided by resource availability, functional objectives and the broader business strategy.
  • Challenge solution-first thinking constructively: Help move conversations from “we need a new system” towards “what are we trying to achieve?”
  • Prioritise and make informed trade-offs: Bring structure to demand, make decisions transparent and focus limited Product and Technology capacity on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Collaborate across Technology: Partner with Engineering, Data, Architecture, Cyber, Design and other specialist teams to determine the most effective route to each outcome.
  • Identify opportunities for reuse: Recognise where capabilities, data, integrations, automation or approaches developed in one area could benefit another, without requiring the businesses to operate in the same way.
  • Drive adoption and value: Remain engaged beyond go-live, using business feedback, usage information and outcome measures to assess whether the intended value has been achieved.
  • Lead by example: Demonstrate effective Product practices and contribute to the continued development of Genus’s Product operating model.
  • Lead and develop a small team: Provide Product Owners with clear direction, coaching and development while remaining close enough to the work to practise Product leadership directly.
  • Mentor Product Owners across the wider team: Help colleagues strengthen their discovery, prioritisation, stakeholder partnership and outcome-ownership capabilities.

Requirements

What you'll bring

You will be an experienced Product professional who combines strong Product expertise with commercial curiosity and the ability to build trusted relationships across complex businesses. You will be comfortable moving between strategy and detail, from discussing priorities with Product Managers to exploring customer or commercial journeys with operational stakeholders and bringing the right Technology capabilities together around an opportunity.

You do not need to have all the answers. What matters is that you are curious, evidence-led and comfortable taking the time to understand a problem before deciding on a solution.

Key indicators of success include:

  • Significant, proven experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, business transformation or a related discipline.
  • Experience owning a Product or business capability through discovery, delivery, adoption and continuous improvement.
  • Strong commercial understanding, with the ability to quickly learn complex business models, customer journeys and operational processes.
  • Experience building productive relationships with business Product Managers and operational stakeholders.
  • Strong discovery and problem-framing skills, including identifying root causes and separating genuine problems from proposed solutions.
  • Experience translating an established business strategy into Product priorities, roadmaps and deliverable outcomes.
  • The confidence to make prioritisation decisions and clearly explain why something should, or should not, be prioritised.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to bring together different perspectives and maintain momentum.
  • People leadership experience, or clear evidence that you can lead and develop a small team of experienced professionals.
  • A strong focus on adoption and measurable outcomes, rather than delivery alone.

Technology and domain requirements

Essential

  • End-to-end ownership of a Product or business capability.
  • Experience within complex enterprise environments and collaboration across Technology disciplines.
  • Familiarity with enterprise capabilities such as CRM, ERP, data, integration, automation or AI.

Advantageous, not essential

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 or broader Microsoft ecosystem exposure.
  • Experience partnering with commercial teams or owning a Commercial Product area.
  • Agriculture, animal genetics or life-sciences experience.

Business Overview

Genus brings together deep scientific expertise, global businesses, valuable data and technology that support critical commercial and operational activities.

We are investing in stronger data foundations, modern platforms, automation and responsible AI. This creates an important opportunity for Product to connect these capabilities more effectively with the needs of our businesses.

Our Product ambition is not simply to deliver more technology. We want to understand the problems that matter, make better use of our existing capabilities, create simpler and more connected experiences, and measure success through the value we deliver.

As Principal Product Lead, you will have the opportunity to take meaningful Product ownership, build close partnerships across ABS and PIC, develop other Product professionals and influence how Product continues to evolve across Genus.

GenusPLC is an agricultural biotechnology pioneer. We are a global FTSE 250 company, headquartered in the UK, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Genus PLC has a presence in over 70 countries and a global workforce of over 3,000 employees and growing. We are a worldwide leader in porcine and bovine animal genetics, partnering with farmers to transform how we nourish the world – a mission that is important to a sustainable future.

We supply high-quality breeding animals with desirable characteristics to farmers, enabling them to produce better quality meat and milk more efficiently to feed the world more sustainably.

Our vision is clear: Pioneering animal genetic improvement to help sustainably nourish the world.

Our Values

  • Collaborate as One Team
  • Create Value for Customers
  • Innovate with Purpose
  • Never stop improving

DEI

Genus is a place where you can be yourself and be part of a growing global team. We have a culture of respect, openness and fairness for all. Whatever your background, your role or your area of work, you will have the chance to thrive in an environment that inspires, challenges and supports you to succeed.

Tackling climate change

  • Monitor and identify goals for the reduction of our GHG emissions from our own operations.
  • Drive porcine and bovine genetic improvements which support productivity gains and improve feed efficiency, enabling a reduction in the production of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions per unit of milk or meat produced
  • Identify facility and other opportunities for reductions in GHG emissions, consistent with our goals
  • Partner and advocate for policies that advance positive climate goals and identified United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Tackling PRRS

  • Developing pigs through gene editing that are resistant to PRRSv (Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus), a deadly disease that causes animal death and suffering as well as the loss of billions of dollars in farm production worldwide.*

Benefits Overview

  • Performance related bonus
  • 25 days holidays + Bank Holidays
  • Pension
  • Company Car
  • Health Cash back scheme
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee share plan
  • Flexible Working Policy (Where appropriate/practicable)
  • Enhanced maternity leave 12 weeks at full pay followed by 4 weeks at 50% followed by SMP
