raw.description:
Senior Customer Service Lead & Trainer – Team Leadership & Customer Experience | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Senior Customer Service Lead & Trainer to lead, coach, and develop a remote customer support team serving U.S.-based customers.

This is more than a traditional customer service position. You’ll take ownership of team performance, employee training, quality assurance, escalations, and overall customer experience.

You’ll ensure agents consistently deliver professional, efficient, and high-quality support across phone, email, chat, and other digital channels while using coaching and performance data to continuously improve the team.

If you’re an experienced customer service leader who knows how to develop people, improve performance, maintain accountability, and build strong service standards, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Lead and manage a distributed customer service team
  • Monitor agent productivity, quality, attendance, and KPI performance
  • Conduct regular one-on-one coaching and performance reviews
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve performance
  • Hold team members accountable to service and productivity standards
  • Identify performance gaps and implement improvement plans
  • Track progress following coaching and corrective actions
  • Build a consistent, accountable, and high-performing remote team culture

Training & Onboarding

  • Own onboarding and training for new customer service hires
  • Develop and maintain:
    • Training materials
    • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
    • Call scripts
    • Customer service guidelines
    • Quality standards
  • Conduct structured training and coaching sessions
  • Review calls and customer interactions to identify training opportunities
  • Ensure new hires are fully prepared before independently handling customers
  • Continuously improve training programs based on recurring performance gaps

Quality Assurance & Coaching

  • Conduct regular call reviews and QA evaluations
  • Monitor adherence to scripts, processes, and customer experience standards
  • Identify recurring quality issues across the team
  • Coach agents on:
    • Communication
    • Professionalism
    • Problem-solving
    • Customer handling
    • Process adherence
  • Track improvement following coaching sessions
  • Maintain consistent QA standards across the customer support operation

Customer Experience & Escalations

  • Handle complex or escalated customer concerns professionally
  • Ensure customers receive consistent support across:
    • Phone
    • Email
    • Chat
    • Other digital communication channels
  • Maintain high standards for tone, responsiveness, and professionalism
  • Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements
  • Help resolve operational issues affecting customer satisfaction
  • Support agents in navigating difficult or sensitive customer situations

Customer Support Operations & Reporting

  • Track and report on:
    • Customer satisfaction
    • Response times
    • Resolution rates
    • Agent productivity
    • QA scores
    • Training performance
  • Maintain accurate documentation and operational records
  • Use customer service platforms, VOIP systems, ticketing tools, and reporting systems effectively
  • Identify trends and recurring performance issues through support data
  • Collaborate with other departments to resolve recurring customer or operational issues

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in customer service leadership, support supervision, or customer operations management
  • Proven experience managing remote and/or offshore customer service teams
  • Strong experience with employee coaching, training, and performance management
  • Experience conducting call reviews and quality assurance evaluations
  • Strong escalation management and customer problem-solving skills
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Experience working with:
    • Customer support platforms
    • VOIP systems
    • Ticketing systems
    • Digital communication tools
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to work U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers
  • Background in:
    • Facility Management
    • Energy
    • Tech-enabled services
  • Experience working in startup or high-growth environments
  • Experience scaling customer support teams
  • Strong knowledge of KPI-driven customer service operations
  • Experience developing:
    • SOPs
    • QA scorecards
    • Training programs
    • Coaching frameworks

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Know how to lead and develop people, not simply supervise them
  • Can give direct, constructive feedback professionally
  • Hold team members accountable while maintaining strong morale
  • Stay calm and solutions-focused during difficult escalations
  • Have high standards for customer communication and service quality
  • Understand how to use QA and performance data to improve agent performance
  • Are highly organized and consistent with follow-through
  • Can effectively manage a distributed team without constant oversight
  • Know how to turn recurring performance issues into structured coaching and training opportunities

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing team performance, attendance, customer service KPIs, and any outstanding escalations.

You’ll listen to calls, complete QA evaluations, coach agents on communication and performance, and conduct onboarding or training sessions where needed.

Throughout the day, you may handle escalated customer concerns, review response and resolution times, identify recurring service issues, update SOPs or scripts, and coordinate with internal teams on operational improvements.

You’ll also monitor agents requiring additional coaching and ensure improvement plans are producing measurable results.

In short: you ensure the customer service team is well-trained, accountable, consistent, and capable of delivering an excellent customer experience.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Quality assurance scores
  • Response and resolution times
  • Agent productivity
  • Training and onboarding effectiveness
  • Escalation resolution rates
  • Process and SOP adherence
  • Performance improvement following coaching
  • Overall team reliability and consistency

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over customer service quality and team performance
  • Direct influence on how agents are trained, coached, and developed
  • Opportunity to shape QA standards and training systems
  • Leadership responsibility within a growing remote support environment
  • Strong visibility across operations and customer experience
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Customer Support Manager
    • Head of Customer Experience
    • Training & Quality Manager
    • Customer Operations Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Assessment
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have extensive customer service leadership experience and enjoy coaching teams, improving service quality, developing training programs, and building accountable support operations, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of a remote customer service team where your leadership will directly influence both agent performance and the customer experience.

At QBench, we’re not just creating software; we’re shaping the future of laboratory efficiency. We’re #1 on G2’s list of the Highest Rated LIMS in North America. As a leader in our field, we offer an opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, dynamic, forward-thinking team. Your work will directly contribute to enhancing scientific discovery and innovation.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us:

  • Impactful Work: Your role in implementing and managing QBench directly influences the success and efficiency of our clients’ laboratories.
  • Career Growth: We’re committed to your professional development, offering continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects. Our rapid growth means the coming years present many opportunities for career advancement.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive team that values your ideas and encourages creativity.
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a comprehensive salary package, including base and variable components tied to performance metrics.
  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom and comfort of a fully remote position, allowing for a healthy work-life balance.

This is a fully remote position that provides leadership for the implementation and deployment of QBench and then provides long-term account management support for the adoption and growth of QBench for our customers.

This role is responsible for delivering and supporting the implementation of multiple customer projects. You will provide oversight of the product environment and configuration of the system. This position also positively impacts retention and renewal rates through proactive account management.

Your main tasks will include planning a schedule for implementation, defining goals, and tracking progress toward those goals. You will also perform detailed requirements analysis, document processes, oversee software projects from start to finish, and give customer training presentations. You will work directly with a wide variety of laboratory staff, resolving their technical questions and issues to help leverage the QBench platform to maximize their lab's effectiveness, efficiency, and productivity.

To succeed in this role, you should have a natural analytical way of thinking and be able to explain complex concepts to non-technical users.


Responsibilities:

  • Own the overall relationship with the customer.
  • Plan, lead, and organize multiple project initiatives in accordance with the approved scope and schedule.
  • Manage project planning, goal-setting, and progress tracking.
  • Deliver customer training and handle technical queries, ensuring effective use of QBench.
  • Responsible for determining client needs and making appropriate recommendations for current and future value-added services, products, etc., while coordinating the involvement of all necessary team members. Provide suitable technical solutions after an end-to-end analysis of the current business process. Translate business requirements into robust requirement documentation. Help resolve any gaps or ambiguities in documented requirements.
    • Produce the following artifacts as needed:
      • Functional Requirements
      • Use Cases
      • UI Prototypes
  • Manage project risks, timelines, and deliverables, including functional requirements and use cases.
  • Conduct high-level testing and ensure smooth transition post-implementation.
  • Gains customer acceptance by understanding and explaining product value propositions and leveraging knowledge of laboratory operations.
  • Interface with engineering, product teams, and external vendors.
  • Identify scope changes and document those changes for the project. Work with the team to create a new project scope to address customer needs.
  • Participate in the pre-sales process to help develop Scope of Work documentation.
  • Ensure successful customer adoption of, usage of, and satisfaction with the QBench product, leading to customer contract renewals.


Qualifications:
  • Minimum 1-year experience in a laboratory environment.
  • Proven track record in project management, preferably with scientific workflow projects.
  • Proficient in software product adoption and support.
  • Organized project management skills such as critical thinking, problem solving, and active listening.
  • A strong aptitude for problem-solving, negotiation, and mediation skills.
  • Evidence of the ability to influence stakeholders and work closely with them to determine acceptable solutions.
  • Proficient at uncovering key business issues and providing insightful, actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Ability to anticipate challenging situations and proactively plan appropriate actions.
  • Strong attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn complex software products.
  • Strong ability to pick up new systems quickly and effectively.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% as required.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior Full Stack AI Developer to lead the development of an internal AI-powered operating platform.

You will work across data engineering, API integrations, AI/LLM applications, dashboards, automation, and modern web development. You will help design the architecture, build production-ready systems, and improve the platform based on real business needs.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can propose solutions, make technical decisions, and take projects from idea to production.

Data & Platform Development

API Integrations & Automation

AI & LLM Development

Dashboards & Web Applications

Security & Infrastructure

  • Support CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and production reliability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience with production systems.
  • 2+ years of experience building data pipelines, data warehouses, and LLM-powered applications.

Preferred Qualifications

raw.title: Social Media and Community Manager
raw.excerpt: OVERVIEW Better Together works to end the root causes of poverty, dependency, divorce and child abuse by leveraging the power of the local church to provide struggling families with supportive relationships and meaningful work.
raw.description:
OVERVIEW

Better Together works to end the root causes of poverty, dependency, divorce and child abuse by leveraging the power of the local church to provide struggling families with supportive relationships and meaningful work. Once properly supported, families can achieve independence, stay together and thrive.

The Social Media and Community Engagement Manager will lead Better Together’s social media strategy, driving innovative campaigns, compelling storytelling, and meaningful digital community engagement. This role proactively identifies opportunities to expand organizational visibility, strengthen brand affinity, position Better Together as a thought leader, and inspire audiences to take action. As the strategic owner of Better Together’s social media presence, this individual combines creative execution, data-driven decision-making, and relationship-building to advance organizational and regional priorities.

The ideal candidate is a savvy online communicator with a passion for leveraging social media to create impact and inspire action.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at Better Together are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five core values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of these questions, you may be a fit.

  1. Owners Mindset: You are invested in the outcomes of our mission.
  1. Are you a self-starter who is able to take initiative in order to complete a task?
  2. Do you often seek opportunities for professional growth?
  1. Choosing Gratitude: There are many things in life that can make us upset. Every day we have a choice to either be negative or give thanks.
  1. Do you often go out of your way to help others?
  2. Have you written a thank-you card in the last 30 days?
  3. Are you a positive person who is more focused on opportunities instead of obstacles?
  1. Love Others: We aim to love others like Christ loves us. Our hope is that our lives would be filled and overflowing with love, so that we can make a difference in this world.
  1. Do people often say you are a good listener?
  2. Do you make decisions based on what’s best for others over yourself?
  3. Do you often find yourself looking for ways to make others feel empowered, important and appreciated?
  1. Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.
  1. Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?
  2. Do you tend to be the one who initiates conversations with colleagues, rather than waiting for them to come to you?
  1. The Sky is the Limit: We have a big vision at Better Together. No one on our team is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.
  1. Do you often set yourself audacious goals?
  2. Do you wholeheartedly agree with our principles, which include that people’s lives are made better through work and that we can and will end the foster care crisis?

The vast majority of those who don’t get hired (or don’t last) at Better Together lack a fit with these values. Be prepared to have very candid conversations about them in our interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The Social Media and Community Manager will have five primary roles, broken down into key responsibilities. They are:

Social Media Strategy and Campaign Management

  • Independently develop and execute proactive, month-over-month social media campaigns aligned with organizational priorities, audience engagement goals, and emerging opportunities.
  • Identify innovative opportunities to leverage social media for thought leadership, brand awareness, audience growth, and organizational influence.
  • Own the overarching social media strategy and editorial direction, balancing planned campaigns with timely, relevant content opportunities.
  • Stay current with social media trends, tools, and best practices to enhance performance, engagement, and brand presence.
  • Partner with the marketing team to align social media efforts with broader campaigns and organizational objectives.
  • Evaluate campaign performance and proactively recommend strategic adjustments to improve engagement, reach, and measurable organizational outcomes.

Content Creation and Distribution

  • Curate, create, and schedule engaging editorial content across platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), TikTok, Threads, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
  • Independently conceptualize and produce engaging, platform-specific content while collaborating with the Content and Creative team on larger campaign assets and storytelling initiatives.
  • Partner with the Video team on production, including concepting, scripting, and execution, to craft audience-specific video content.
  • Work closely with the Better Together team and broader community to create, edit, and distribute user-generated content (UGC), amplifying authentic stories and experiences.
  • Proactively identify compelling stories, trends, and timely content opportunities that can be translated into engaging social media campaigns.
  • Manage the social content calendar and coordinate the content pipeline with internal teams and stakeholders, balancing scheduled posts with real-time opportunities.

Digital Community Engagement and Real-Time Connection

  • Build an active online community of Better Together advocates. Identify and cultivate social media champions who share our stories and introduce others to our mission. Use those relationships to grow awareness, deepen engagement, and nurture warm leads for volunteering, events, and partnerships.
  • Proactively identify and cultivate relationships with relevant influencers, community partners, thought leaders, and digital stakeholders to expand Better Together’s reach and influence.
  • Identify opportunities to elevate Better Together’s voice in relevant social conversations, emerging trends, and issues aligned with its mission.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Communications to amplify public relations initiatives, organizational thought leadership, media coverage, and strategic messaging through social channels.
  • Develop creative digital engagement initiatives that foster meaningful connections, strengthen brand affinity, and encourage audiences to take action.
  • Lead proactive engagement strategies across social platforms, including relevant community groups, partner organizations, and influential voices.
  • Engage directly with our online community. Respond promptly to comments, messages, and mentions, tag relevant partners and supporters when appropriate, and actively participate in online groups and conversations aligned with our mission.

Analytics, Social Listening, and Regional Support

  • Establish and monitor key social media performance indicators, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations to marketing leadership.
  • Evaluate social media’s contribution to broader organizational goals, including volunteer acquisition, event participation, community partnerships, and audience growth.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize content, campaigns, and engagement strategies based on performance data and audience behavior.
  • Leverage social listening tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite) to gather insights and align content with audience preferences.
  • Collaborate with regional teams to promote local initiatives and customize content for specific needs and priorities.
  • Support regional EDs with tailored content and strategies to ensure alignment with overarching social media goals.
  • Seek opportunities to convert audiences into active participants, such as driving volunteer sign-ups, partnerships, or event attendance.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in social media strategy, digital marketing, community engagement, or related fields, with demonstrated ownership of successful social media campaigns and measurable results.
  • Proven ability to independently develop and execute strategic social media initiatives aligned with broader organizational objectives.
  • Experience cultivating influencer relationships, digital partnerships, and proactive community engagement opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of how social media supports public relations, thought leadership, brand positioning, and organizational visibility.
  • Strong understanding of content creation, creative strategies, and platform-specific best practices across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
  • Experience in creating and editing social media shorts, reels, and video content tailored to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in leveraging social media tools such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or similar, and analytics platforms to track performance and optimize strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience translating social media performance data into actionable strategic recommendations.
  • Technological proficiency in tools like Asana, ActiveCampaign, WordPress, and Basecamp for task management, integrations, and content workflows (nice to have).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a knack for crafting engaging, audience-specific messaging and creative storytelling.
  • Demonstrated creative storytelling abilities, including independently conceptualizing and producing engaging social media content.
  • Excellent project management, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and execute with minimal oversight.
  • Proven ability to foster community engagement and cultivate relationships with partners, influencers, and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with social listening tools and the ability to extract actionable insights to inform strategy.
  • A strong understanding of brand alignment and ability to collaborate with regional teams to customize content and initiatives.
  • Match Better Together’s core values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION AND COMPENSATION

Better Together seeks to fill this position as soon as possible. The organization’s headquarters are in Naples, Florida, but all the Better Together staff reside in Florida. Better Together has built a highly successful work culture over the past decade with systems and structures designed for clarity, flexibility, and great communication. Key elements of the environment include:

  • Weekly team meetings with clear accountability and the opportunity to solve issues as a team.
  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with the Better Together vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the Better Together team, our policies, and how we operate

Hopkins ist eine auf die Rechte von Privatpersonen spezialisierte, deutschlandweit tätige Kanzlei. Gegründet in 2019 durch Arend Liese, zuvor Rechtsanwalt bei Freshfields Bruckhaus Deringer, denkt Hopkins das Prinzip Kanzlei und Rechtsdurchsetzung täglich neu - mit großem Fokus auf moderne Technologie und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit. Mit einem Team von mehr als 150 Personen berät und vertritt Hopkins Privatpersonen deutschlandweit in allen rechtlichen Belangen.

Aufgaben

  • Du etablierst eine neue Ära der Rechtsdurchsetzung und bist Teil der Mission, juristische Prozesse zu digitalisieren und automatisieren

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Beziehung und den Kontakt zu Deinen Mandantinnen und Mandanten und führst rechtliche Beratung und Vertretung im Bereich von mietrechtlichen Fällen durch

  • Du übernimmst die Verhandlungen mit Gegenseiten sowie gegnerischen Anwälten

  • Du erstellst Klageschriften, Schriftsätze, Verträge, etc.

  • Du bearbeitest eigenständig Fälle und vertrittst unsere Mandanten sowohl außergerichtlich als auch vor Gericht

  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen anderen internen Teams zusammen

  • Du gibst Deine Erfahrungen und Dein Feedback in unseren Produktentwicklungsprozess mit ein und arbeitest direkt mit Produktmanagern und der Geschäftsführung an Verbesserungen in der Automatisierung von Abläufen

Qualifikation

Du bist Volljurist:in mit Zulassung zur Rechtsanwaltschaft in Deutschland oder hast diese bereits beantragt. Zudem verfügst Du über mindestens ein Jahr Berufserfahrung (idealerweise im Mietrecht). Deine Arbeitsweise ist pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und Du hast große Lust und Energie, innerhalb eines dynamischen Arbeitsumfelds an der Zukunft des Rechtsmarkts mitzuwirken. Die Vision, in einer durch Technologie skalierbaren Kanzlei mitzuarbeiten, inspiriert Dich und Du denkst gerne darüber nach, wie sich juristische Prozesse durch die Nutzung von Daten und Software verbessern lassen. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und gewissenhaft, setzt dabei klare Prioritäten und legst eine unternehmerische und ergebnisorientierte Denkweise an den Tag. Dazu bist Du lernwillig und übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Arbeit. Deine Stärke in der Kommunikation und Dein Verhandlungsgeschick zeichnen Dich aus.

Benefits

  • Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, als Protagonist die Anwaltskanzlei der Zukunft zu formen und die Welt der Rechtsdienstleistungen für Privatpersonen grundlegend zu verändern

  • Du übernimmst schnell viel Verantwortung für unsere Kanzlei und sammelst für Deinen Fachanwaltstitel in kurzer Zeit viele relevante Fälle

  • Du arbeitest von dort, wo Du am produktivsten bist: Unser Team ist in Deutschland verteilt und arbeitet zum Großteil remote. Wir haben aber natürlich auch ein Büro in Berlin, in dem Du jederzeit willkommen bist.

  • Du bist Teil eines inspirierenden Teams bestehend aus Experten vieler verschiedener Disziplinen

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Produktmanagern und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast großen Einfluss auf die Technologie, die wir bauen

  • Wir bieten eine attraktive und leistungsbezogene Vergütung

  • Wir übernehmen alle Kosten, die mit Deiner Tätigkeit als Rechtsanwalt sowie dem Erhalt und der Aufrechterhaltung der Zulassung zusammenhängen (Versicherungen, Kammergebühren, etc.)

Insbesondere hast Du große Lust und Energie, in einem Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten zu wirken, Themen aufzubauen und zu verändern. Dabei bist Du inspiriert durch den Gedanken mit Deiner Arbeit Menschen zu ihren Rechten zu verhelfen und Zugang zu erstklassiger rechtlicher Beratung zu ermöglichen.

Wir freuen uns sehr auf ein Kennenlernen, wenn diese Herausforderung Dich anspricht.

Our Purpose

Bringing quality, safety, and sustainability to life

About us

Intertek is a leading Total Quality Assurance provider to industries worldwide. Through our network of more than 1,000 laboratories and offices and over 46,000 colleagues in more than 100 countries, we deliver innovative Assurance, Testing, Inspection and Certification solutions that help our customers operate safely and sustainably.

Team & Role Overview

We are looking for a Vulnerability Management Analyst to join our Global Cyber Security team.

In this role, you will support Intertek’s global Threat & Vulnerability Management capability, contributing to vulnerability management, cyber threat intelligence, digital risk protection, and external attack surface management activities. You will help identify, assess, prioritize, and coordinate remediation of security vulnerabilities while supporting proactive threat detection, security investigations, and incident response activities to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform internal and external vulnerability assessments using Vulnerability Management and External Attack Surface Management tools.
  • Monitor CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) alerts and security vendor advisories.
  • Prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and business impact.
  • Coordinate remediation activities and support vulnerability validation, rescans, and exception management processes.
  • Support response efforts related to critical, actively exploited, and zero-day vulnerabilities.
  • Analyze emerging cyber threats, digital risk exposure, phishing activity, credential leaks, and dark web intelligence.
  • Collaborate with Cyber Security Analysts on threat hunting activities and incident investigations.
  • Support incident containment, remediation, and continuous improvement of cyber security operations.
  • Prepare vulnerability governance reporting and provide risk-based remediation recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience in vulnerability management, threat intelligence, cyber security operations, or a related field.

  • Knowledge of Windows, Linux, networking, cloud technologies, and internet-facing infrastructure.
  • Understanding of cyber threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK framework, indicators of compromise, and threat actor techniques.
  • Experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning tools, OSINT sources, SIEM and EDR platforms.

raw.excerpt: Role Overview Genus is building a modern Product capability focused on understanding the problems that matter, connecting business needs with Technology capability and delivering measurable outcomes.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Genus is building a modern Product capability focused on understanding the problems that matter, connecting business needs with Technology capability and delivering measurable outcomes. This position represents a great opportunity to join at an early stage of creation

We are looking for a Principal Product Lead – Business Divisions to join our Product Leadership Team. This senior role combines direct Product Owner responsibility for our Commercial team with a broader Product partnering role across the ABS and PIC businesses.

Working closely with Product Managers and key stakeholders, you will develop a deep understanding of business priorities, customers, processes and challenges. You will connect these needs with the wider Product and Technology organisation, helping teams fully understand the problem before committing to a solution.

For Commercial, you will translate the agreed business strategy into clear priorities, lead discovery, shape the roadmap and remain accountable throughout delivery, adoption and value realisation.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will also help strengthen Product capability across Genus by leading a small team of professional Product Owners, mentoring colleagues and sharing good practice.

This is a remote role with some travel both domestically for team meetings as well as internationally

The salary for this role will be up to circa £100,000 with flexibility for outstanding candidates

You Will

  • Own Commercial Product delivery: Translate the agreed commercial strategy into an outcome-focused roadmap, prioritised backlog and clear Product decisions.
  • Build strong partnerships across ABS and PIC: Work with business Product Managers and stakeholders to understand priorities, customer needs, opportunities and operational challenges, ensuring these are appropriately reflected in each business area’s commercial Product plans and priorities.
  • Stay close to the business: Spend time with the people doing the work to understand how processes operate in practice and identify areas of friction and opportunity.
  • Lead effective discovery: Explore the problem, available evidence, user needs and desired outcomes before determining the most appropriate intervention.
  • Influence Product direction: Bring business insight, evidence and Product thinking into roadmap and investment discussions. Help shape departmental Product plans and priorities across ABS and PIC, guided by resource availability, functional objectives and the broader business strategy.
  • Challenge solution-first thinking constructively: Help move conversations from “we need a new system” towards “what are we trying to achieve?”
  • Prioritise and make informed trade-offs: Bring structure to demand, make decisions transparent and focus limited Product and Technology capacity on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Collaborate across Technology: Partner with Engineering, Data, Architecture, Cyber, Design and other specialist teams to determine the most effective route to each outcome.
  • Identify opportunities for reuse: Recognise where capabilities, data, integrations, automation or approaches developed in one area could benefit another, without requiring the businesses to operate in the same way.
  • Drive adoption and value: Remain engaged beyond go-live, using business feedback, usage information and outcome measures to assess whether the intended value has been achieved.
  • Lead by example: Demonstrate effective Product practices and contribute to the continued development of Genus’s Product operating model.
  • Lead and develop a small team: Provide Product Owners with clear direction, coaching and development while remaining close enough to the work to practise Product leadership directly.
  • Mentor Product Owners across the wider team: Help colleagues strengthen their discovery, prioritisation, stakeholder partnership and outcome-ownership capabilities.

Requirements

What you'll bring

You will be an experienced Product professional who combines strong Product expertise with commercial curiosity and the ability to build trusted relationships across complex businesses. You will be comfortable moving between strategy and detail, from discussing priorities with Product Managers to exploring customer or commercial journeys with operational stakeholders and bringing the right Technology capabilities together around an opportunity.

You do not need to have all the answers. What matters is that you are curious, evidence-led and comfortable taking the time to understand a problem before deciding on a solution.

Key indicators of success include:

  • Significant, proven experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, business transformation or a related discipline.
  • Experience owning a Product or business capability through discovery, delivery, adoption and continuous improvement.
  • Strong commercial understanding, with the ability to quickly learn complex business models, customer journeys and operational processes.
  • Experience building productive relationships with business Product Managers and operational stakeholders.
  • Strong discovery and problem-framing skills, including identifying root causes and separating genuine problems from proposed solutions.
  • Experience translating an established business strategy into Product priorities, roadmaps and deliverable outcomes.
  • The confidence to make prioritisation decisions and clearly explain why something should, or should not, be prioritised.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to bring together different perspectives and maintain momentum.
  • People leadership experience, or clear evidence that you can lead and develop a small team of experienced professionals.
  • A strong focus on adoption and measurable outcomes, rather than delivery alone.

Technology and domain requirements

Essential

  • End-to-end ownership of a Product or business capability.
  • Experience within complex enterprise environments and collaboration across Technology disciplines.
  • Familiarity with enterprise capabilities such as CRM, ERP, data, integration, automation or AI.

Advantageous, not essential

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 or broader Microsoft ecosystem exposure.
  • Experience partnering with commercial teams or owning a Commercial Product area.
  • Agriculture, animal genetics or life-sciences experience.

Business Overview

Genus brings together deep scientific expertise, global businesses, valuable data and technology that support critical commercial and operational activities.

We are investing in stronger data foundations, modern platforms, automation and responsible AI. This creates an important opportunity for Product to connect these capabilities more effectively with the needs of our businesses.

Our Product ambition is not simply to deliver more technology. We want to understand the problems that matter, make better use of our existing capabilities, create simpler and more connected experiences, and measure success through the value we deliver.

As Principal Product Lead, you will have the opportunity to take meaningful Product ownership, build close partnerships across ABS and PIC, develop other Product professionals and influence how Product continues to evolve across Genus.

GenusPLC is an agricultural biotechnology pioneer. We are a global FTSE 250 company, headquartered in the UK, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Genus PLC has a presence in over 70 countries and a global workforce of over 3,000 employees and growing. We are a worldwide leader in porcine and bovine animal genetics, partnering with farmers to transform how we nourish the world – a mission that is important to a sustainable future.

We supply high-quality breeding animals with desirable characteristics to farmers, enabling them to produce better quality meat and milk more efficiently to feed the world more sustainably.

Our vision is clear: Pioneering animal genetic improvement to help sustainably nourish the world.

Our Values

  • Collaborate as One Team
  • Create Value for Customers
  • Innovate with Purpose
  • Never stop improving

DEI

Genus is a place where you can be yourself and be part of a growing global team. We have a culture of respect, openness and fairness for all. Whatever your background, your role or your area of work, you will have the chance to thrive in an environment that inspires, challenges and supports you to succeed.

Tackling climate change

  • Monitor and identify goals for the reduction of our GHG emissions from our own operations.
  • Drive porcine and bovine genetic improvements which support productivity gains and improve feed efficiency, enabling a reduction in the production of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions per unit of milk or meat produced
  • Identify facility and other opportunities for reductions in GHG emissions, consistent with our goals
  • Partner and advocate for policies that advance positive climate goals and identified United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Tackling PRRS

  • Developing pigs through gene editing that are resistant to PRRSv (Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus), a deadly disease that causes animal death and suffering as well as the loss of billions of dollars in farm production worldwide.*

Benefits Overview

  • Enhanced maternity leave 12 weeks at full pay followed by 4 weeks at 50% followed by SMP
  • Comprehensive L&D program including career development programs, access to Genus University and Mango (languages)

Equal Employment Opportunities

Genus is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with anti-discrimination law, it is the purpose of this policy to effectuate these principles and mandates. Genus prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Genus conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

Tax Analyst
Location: Remote - Eastern or Central Time Zones Preferred

The Role

As a Senior Tax Analyst at K1x, you'll be the partnership tax expert on our product team. You'll decide how complex partnership reporting is understood, modeled and checked across our platform, which is used by large institutional investors, fund managers and accounting firms.

You'll own the tax logic behind our K-1 and K-3 products from start to finish. That means researching ambiguous rules, writing tax requirements, guiding product and engineering decisions, and making sure what we ship is technically right. You'll be the go-to resource for partnership tax questions inside K1x, help shape the product roadmap, and mentor other tax team members.

We're looking for a seasoned partnership tax professional who knows the technical rules in depth and is curious about how tax data moves through systems. If you want to use your public accounting or fund tax experience to change how the industry handles K-1s, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

    • Act as the main subject-matter expert on partnership taxation (Form 1065, Schedules K-1 and K-3) across product, engineering, client success and leadership
    • Own the tax requirements for new and existing features: write clear specifications, acceptance criteria and test scenarios that engineers can build from
    • Research and interpret complex and ambiguous partnership reporting issues, including:
      • Sections 704(b) and 704(c) allocations
      • Capital account reporting (tax basis capital)
      • Partner liability allocations under Section 752
      • Sections 743(b) and 734(b) basis adjustments
      • Tiered and fund-of-funds structures
    • Lead the analysis of international reporting on Schedule K-3 (Parts I–XIII), including foreign tax credit, PFIC, Section 1446(f) and other cross-border items
    • Guide state and local partnership reporting, including composite returns, nonresident withholding, pass-through entity tax (PTET) elections and multistate apportionment
    • Interpret K-1 reporting that matters to investors, including UBTI for tax-exempt investors, Section 163(j), Section 199A and Section 1061 carried interest
    • Review and approve tax logic, field mappings, calculations and data extraction outputs to keep them accurate across thousands of K-1 variations
    • Track IRS, state and international changes to forms, instructions and guidance; assess the impact on our products; and lead the response from research through release
    • Help set the product roadmap by finding gaps, ranking tax-driven enhancements, and advising on the trade-offs between technical accuracy and practicality
    • Act as the senior tax contact for important client conversations, escalations and special projects with funds, investors and accounting firms
    • Work with taxing authorities, industry groups and outside advisors on new reporting standards
    • Mentor tax analysts, review their work, and build up the team's partnership tax knowledge
    • Improve tax QA processes, regression testing and documentation, using AI and automation where they help

Requirements

What You Bring

    • 7+ years of partnership tax experience in public accounting (Big 4 or national firm strongly preferred), fund administration, or partnership tax technology
    • Deep technical knowledge of Subchapter K, including allocations, capital accounts, basis computations, liability allocations, and partnership life events such as formations, mergers and terminations
    • Direct experience preparing or reviewing Forms 1065 and Schedules K-1 and K-3 for complex entities, such as private equity, hedge funds, real estate, venture capital or fund-of-funds structures
    • Strong knowledge of multistate partnership reporting and international information reporting
    • Proven ability to research complex issues, form a well-reasoned position, and explain it clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
    • Experience owning work end to end and making judgment calls without detailed direction
    • Comfort working closely with product managers and engineers, and interest in how tax rules become data structures and software logic
    • Experience mentoring or reviewing the work of junior tax professionals
    • Bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field

Nice to Have

  • CPA (strongly preferred), EA, JD/LLM in taxation, or a master's in taxation
  • Experience with professional tax software such as CCH Axcess, GoSystem Tax RS, ONESOURCE, or proprietary allocation engines
  • Background in tax software development, requirements writing, field mapping, or QA and user acceptance testing
  • Familiarity with the investor side of K-1 consumption, such as institutional investors, family offices, endowments and other tax-exempt organizations
  • Experience using AI tools in tax workflows, or interest in shaping how AI is used for K-1 data extraction and validation
  • Experience in a SaaS, fintech or other technology company

Benefits

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy + Sick Time + Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Fully Remote Opportunity
  • Healthcare Benefits and 401K
  • Growing Startup Culture

Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

Tasks

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

Requirements

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in German & English.
  • Resident in Germany for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

Benefits

  • Better Work-Life balance
  • Remote work & location independence
  • Positive environmental impact
  • Independent contractor role
  • Flexible hours to work around home life

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

raw.title: Junior Video Editor (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: Über uns Mammutmarsch heißt Abenteuer.  Mammutmarsch heißt Grenzen sprengen.
raw.description:
Über uns

Mammutmarsch heißt Abenteuer. Mammutmarsch heißt Grenzen sprengen. Wir sind die Crew hinter den Extremwanderungen, die Zehntausende Menschen jedes Jahr dabei unterstützt, über sich hinauszuwachsen. Damit noch mehr Menschen den ersten Schritt wagen, suchen wir dich als Social Media Video Editor (m/w/d) - jemanden, der nicht nur Clips aneinanderreiht, sondern mit starken Hooks, Tempo und einem feinen Gespür für Emotionen Videos baut, bei denen niemand weiterscrollt.

Dein Impact

Deine Videos sind der erste Funke für unsere Community. Mit deinen Paid-Social-Ads und Kurzvideos auf Instagram, TikTok und Facebook weckst du Emotionen, machst Lust auf das nächste Abenteuer und sorgst dafür, dass aus Scrollern echte Mammutmarsch-TeilnehmerInnen werden.

So arbeiten wir

Wir arbeiten zu 100 % remote, pragmatisch und mit richtig viel Tempo. Und uns ist tatsächlich egal, wie viele Jahre Berufserfahrung auf deinem Papier stehen oder ob du am liebsten mit CapCut, Premiere oder smarten KI-Tools schneidest - entscheidend ist, was am Ende auf dem Screen passiert: modern, emotional, auf den Punkt und mit Blick auf die Performance.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Scroll-Stopping Video Ads: Du konzipierst und schneidest performante Kurzvideos, UGC-Clips und schnelle Ad-Varianten für Meta (Instagram und Facebook) und TikTok.

  • Hooks, Storytelling & Timing: Du baust starke Einstiege, triffst den richtigen Rhythmus bei Schnitten, Schriften und Übergängen und hältst die Watchtime hoch.

  • Smarte Produktion & KI: Du nutzt moderne Editing-Apps (z. B. CapCut) und KI-Tools clever, um schnell hochwertige Varianten zu produzieren und neue Formate zu testen.

  • Performance-Mindset: Du denkst nicht nur ästhetisch, sondern zielorientiert - du schaust dir an, welche Creatives funktionieren, und entwickelst deine Videos auf Basis von Kennzahlen und Team-Feedback laufend weiter.

  • Trendgespür & Eigeninitiative: Du hast den Puls auf Social Media, bringst proaktiv eigene Ideen ein und überträgst aktuelle Trends authentisch auf die Mammutmarsch-Welt.

Was du mitbringst

  • Ein starkes Auge & Gefühl für Social Media: Du weißt intuitiv, welche Szenen, Farben und Sounds Emotionen wecken und auf Instagram und TikTok heute wirklich funktionieren.

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung im Video-Editing: Du hast bereits eigene Social-Media-Videos, Reels, TikToks oder Paid Ads geschnitten und kannst uns zeigen, was du drauf hast.

  • Geschwindigkeit & Liebe zum Detail: Du arbeitest strukturiert, schnell und selbstständig - ohne dabei bei Timing, Untertiteln oder Übergängen unsauber zu werden.

  • Offenheit für KI & neue Tools: Du probierst gerne neue Workflows aus und nutzt KI-Tools als kreativen Beschleuniger statt als Ersatz für gutes Gespür.

  • Marketing-Grundverständnis: Du verstehst, dass eine gute Ad nicht nur schön aussehen, sondern Menschen zum Klicken und Handeln motivieren muss.

  • Sprache & Remote-Setup: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse und Spaß an eigenverantwortlicher Remote-Arbeit.

Unser Versprechen an dich

  • Wachse mit uns: Viel Raum für eigene Ideen, schnelle Tests und direkte Sichtbarkeit deiner Arbeit in unseren Kampagnen.

  • Sinn & Emotion: Du bewirbst kein austauschbares Produkt, sondern Erlebnisse, die Menschen ein Leben lang in Erinnerung bleiben.

  • 100 % Remote & echte Freiheit: Arbeite von dort, wo du am kreativsten bist - in einem eingespielten Remote-Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Deine Bewerbung

Klingt nach deiner perfekten nächsten beruflichen Herausforderung? Dann schick uns statt eines klassischen Anschreibens bitte einfach:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf

  • Einen Link zu 2–3 deiner bisherigen Videos / deinem Portfolio (z. B. Reels, TikToks oder Ads)

  • 2–3 Sätze zu unserer Mini-Challenge: Schau kurz auf unserem Instagram- oder TikTok-Kanal vorbei - wie sähe deine Idee für eine starke 3-Sekunden-Hook aus, die Menschen motiviert, sich für ihren ersten Mammutmarsch anzumelden?

Wir freuen uns darauf, deine Arbeiten zu sehen, und melden uns in der Regel innerhalb von fünf Tagen bei dir zurück!

raw.title: Program Officer - Economic Security
raw.excerpt: About CWS Imagine waking up every morning with the chance to change someone's life.
raw.description:
About CWS

Imagine waking up every morning with the chance to change someone's life. Imagine knowing your efforts will benefit both your career and our neighbors around the world. At CWS, our team knows they are making a difference every day. Whether you're in our U.S.-based offices supporting refugees, asylees or unaccompanied children ... implementing hygiene initiatives in Cambodia or rebuilding projects in Central America ... or even connecting remotely from your home on fundraising campaigns, grant reports, or critical communications - you have the opportunity to work towards a world where everyone has food, a voice and a safe place to call home.

Overview

The Program Officer, Economic Security will primarily support the Office of Refugee Resettlement funded Matching Grant program delivery by managing day-to-day communication with implementing sites, monitoring program quality and maintaining accurate program documentation. The position will assist with training, technical assistance, report writing, compliance, monitoring, and data analysis while collaborating with team members and external stakeholders to strengthen program outcomes. Experience working in local refugee employment programming, particularly Matching Grant programs, is ideal, as well as experience working in a national Matching Grant program administration capacity. Additionally, the role should anticipate coordinating with CWS local and affiliate partner leadership as well as the Senior Director, State and Local Programs to support technical assistance and training in the Matching Grant program and other Economic Security programming as appropriate.

An important prerequisite for this position is the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team in a collegial manner and to work independently to carry assignments through to completion. This position is fully remote but may require periodic in-person team meetings. Domestic travel is required. Bachelor's degree in areas other than what is listed below will be considered.

This position is grant funded and estimated to continue at least until Sept. 29, 2027, subject to available funding.

Purpose

The Program Officer will support program delivery by managing day-to-day activities, monitoring program quality, and maintaining accurate documentation. This position will assist with training, reporting, compliance, and data analysis, while collaborating with team members and external stakeholders to strengthen program outcomes.

Responsibilities

Core Duties

Program Monitoring and Oversight

  • Maintain up-to-date self-education about programs. Ensure other unit colleagues are informed as appropriate.
  • Regularly review program policies, forms, and manuals to stay abreast of changes in program implementation.
  • Support supervisor with development and curation of tools, resources and training on themes relevant to the program.
  • Monitor general program quality and conduct reviews of program implementation and documentation requirements to ensure quality and timeliness of program service implementation and fulfillment of documentation requirements.
  • As requested, represent CWS at internal and external conferences, meetings, committees and working groups with CWS colleagues, government donors, community partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Support in the management of program trackers and assist with reporting and data collection for program reports and responses to requests for proposals.
  • Support the provision of needs-based technical assistance and training; this may be provided through e-learning modules, webinars, in-person training, communities of practice and one-on-one phone call.

Grants, Reporting, and Compliance

  • Support compilation and analysis of narrative and data reports for submission to funder.
  • In coordination with supervisor, analyze funding guidelines to ensure agency compliance; as necessary, assist in the development or revision of CWS policies, standard operating procedures, and training materials to ensure high quality service provision.
  • Contribute to the development of the proposals when requested. In collaboration with supervisors and colleagues, review written narratives.
  • Contribute to required program reporting as necessary, including but not limited to, data and narrative reporting to ensure proper tracking and reporting of activities.
  • Regularly review qualitative and quantitative program data to identify program trends, areas for improvement, best practices, and make recommendations for program development and enhancements.

Partnerships and Development

  • Develops and nurtures relationships with providers and other community partners to support program requirements and activities.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in social work, human services, sociology, psychology, public administration, public health, or equivalent experience in lieu of degree.

Experience:

  • 5 years of experience working in refugee or immigrant-related services,
  • Experience in a local resettlement affiliate or a national office of a resettlement agency (preferred).
  • Experience in social services or nonprofit sectors (preferred).

Skills:

  • Strong interpersonal and diplomacy skills; ability to work collaboratively and effectively with partners and teams;
  • Strong attention to detail a must.
  • Ability to always conduct oneself in a professional and courteous manner to represent the professional and institutional interests of CWS;
  • Strong knowledge and experience in working with Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and database software is essential;
  • Strong writing skills are required.
  • The ability to work in a multi-cultural environment is required.

Special Requirements

  • Hybrid or in office environment depending on program needs.
  • Occasional evening or weekend hours for client emergencies or community events.
  • Some local travel may be required.
  • This position is fully remote but may require periodic in-person team meetings.
  • Domestic travel is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in areas other than what is listed will be considered.

Benefits

- CWS offers a competitive benefits package that includes: - 403 (b) Retirement Plan - Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance - Generous Paid Time Off (18 Paid Days Off; 24 Days after 2 Years) - 14 Official Holidays - 12 Sick Days Off (Accrued monthly) - Life Insurance and AD&D - Long Term and Short-Term Disability - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Health Savings Account

raw.excerpt: Description As an Incident Response Analyst, you will help contain and remediate cybersecurity incidents across Cynet customer and prospective customer environments.
raw.description:
Description

As an Incident Response Analyst, you will help contain and remediate cybersecurity incidents across Cynet customer and prospective customer environments. You will combine incident coordination, digital forensics, malware analysis, and threat intelligence to support effective response and continuously improve Cynet's detection and incident response capabilities.

We truly appreciate your interest in joining our team. To help us give every application the attention it deserves, please apply directly through the job posting rather than contacting team members individually.

What will you do

  • Execute containment and remediation processes for cybersecurity incidents, coordinating activity across Cynet customer and prospective customer environments.
  • Perform forensic analysis of compromised assets and develop actionable remediation plans.
  • Analyze potentially malicious files to understand their functions and techniques.
  • Extract indicators of compromise and feed them into detection capabilities to support continuous improvement.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting 24×7 escalations outside standard business hours.
  • Help enhance and develop Cynet's tools and capabilities for incident response.
  • Collaborate with the CyOps CTI team and Orion threat hunting team to make effective use of findings and artifacts.
  • Train CyOps team members on incident response best practices.

Requirements

  • Previous experience performing incident response in a Security Operations Center or an equivalent cybersecurity organization.
  • Hands-on experience with host and network digital forensics.
  • Strong knowledge of incident response, digital forensics, and cyber threat hunting.
  • Expertise in identifying the tactics, techniques, and procedures used by threat actors.
  • Familiarity with malware analysis.
  • Ability to coordinate assignments within a team and communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience monitoring EDR, XDR, or SIEM solutions is an advantage.

Compensation: The offered annual salary range for this role is USD 10,000–13,000. Actual compensation will depend on several factors, including seniority level and relevant experience.

About Us

Cynet is a leader in threat detection and response, designed to simplify security for organizations of all sizes. Our mission is to empower lean security teams and their partners with an AI-powered, unified platform that autonomously detects, protects, and responds to threats - backed by 24×7 security experts.

With a Partner First mindset, we focus on helping customers and partners stay protected, operate confidently, and achieve their goals. Our vision is to give every organization true cybersecurity peace of mind, providing fast, accurate protection without the noise or complexity.

Why Join Cynet

This role is central to Cynet's security operations and customer protection, helping detect, investigate, and respond to threats affecting organizations worldwide. You'll work hands-on with real security events, deepen your expertise across threat detection and response, and contribute directly to the continuous improvement of Cynet's platform and services.

Become a part of our caring community

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences.

The Director, Segment Quality Engineering is a strategic technology leader responsible for advancing quality engineering practices across a defined portion of Humana’s technology portfolio. Reporting to the AVP, Quality Engineering – Segment, this role will lead teams responsible for delivery quality, test automation, release readiness, and continuous improvement across multiple product and application teams.

This leader will work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Platform, DevOps, and enterprise quality partners to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle and improve release confidence, delivery speed, and production stability.

Responsibilities


  • Lead quality engineering strategy and execution across a defined portfolio, domain, or segment.
  • Lead and develop quality engineering managers, leads, engineers, and SDETs; drive organization design, talent growth, and team performance.
  • Establish portfolio quality goals, KPIs, and governance to improve delivery quality, release readiness, and production stability.
  • Embed built-in quality across planning, design, development, testing, and deployment.
  • Oversee test strategy and execution across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and release validation.
  • Own portfolio-level quality risk management, including defect trends, release concerns, environment issues, and cross-team dependencies.
  • Drive automation-first practices and integrate quality signals, validation, and gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Lead adoption of AI-enabled quality engineering capabilities and promote innovative practices that improve speed, coverage, and reliability.
  • Sponsor modernization of quality frameworks, tooling, and test approaches for APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Oversee non-functional quality practices, including performance, resiliency, operational readiness, and security validation.
  • Use metrics and production insights to drive continuous improvement, maturity, and investment priorities.
  • Partner with segment and enterprise stakeholders to align execution with broader quality engineering strategy, standards, and reference architecture direction.
  • Ensure responsible adoption of AI and compliance with applicable security, privacy, regulatory, and operational standards.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, testing, or related technical disciplines.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing quality engineering, test automation, or software delivery teams in large enterprise environments.
  • Experience leading quality engineering execution across multiple agile teams or a complex application/product portfolio.
  • Demonstrated success driving quality engineering modernization, including automation, tooling, process improvement, and metrics-driven execution.
  • Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with API, UI, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing approaches.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and modern application architectures.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leaders.
  • Experience working in matrixed organizations and leading geographically distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with member, provider, digital experience, or enterprise platform domains.
  • Experience with enterprise quality tools, test management platforms, and engineering lifecycle tools.
  • Knowledge of microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience supporting non-functional testing, including performance and resiliency.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled quality engineering or intelligent automation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with enterprise reference architecture principles, patterns, and standards in cloud, hybrid, on-premise, and SaaS environments.

Success in this Role


  • In this role, success will be measured by:
  • Improved release stability and delivery quality across the assigned portfolio.
  • Reduced escaped defects and production incidents related to delivery quality.
  • Increased automation adoption, regression reliability, and validation efficiency.
  • Stronger integration of quality engineering into engineering workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Advancement of quality engineering maturity and consistent execution across teams.
  • Positive stakeholder partnership and strong team engagement and development outcomes.
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. raw.description:
Position Summary

The Finance Coordinator – AR and Revenue Support is a key operational member of the Finance Team responsible for routine billing, receipts, revenue-system reconciliation, and revenue workpapers across the Society's systems and programs. This role owns the complete, repeatable accounts receivable and revenue processing workflow, from invoice preparation through cash application and reconciliation to the general ledger.

The Coordinator works across the ERP, registration and association management platforms, merchant service accounts, and banking systems, and plays a central role in matching registration, membership, and Congress revenue data to deposits. The role prepares work and workpapers for Controller review; accounting judgments, revenue recognition, and close ownership rest with the Controller.

Key Responsibilities

Billing, Receipts & Collections

  • Prepare and issue routine invoices within approved contracts, rates, and billing rules; escalate unusual terms, adjustments, or credits to the Controller
  • Monitor bank accounts daily for deposits and record all incoming revenue (checks, wires, ACH, credit cards, merchant services) accurately and on time with appropriate documentation
  • Apply payments, maintain accounts receivable aging, and conduct routine collections and follow-up on late payments
  • Prepare supporting documentation for refunds, write-offs, and credits; unusual refunds, write-offs, and adjustments require documented approval under the authority schedule
  • Maintain supporting schedules for membership, education programs, publications, sponsorship and exhibition, and other revenue streams

Revenue Reconciliations & Data Integrity

  • Extract and reconcile registration, membership, merchant, and other source-system data to settlements, bank activity, and the general ledger
  • Prepare monthly reconciliations for Controller review:
    • Merchant service accounts across all currencies (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, credit card processors)
    • Revenue and AR subledgers to the general ledger
    • Registration data matched to deposits for workshops and the annual Congress
  • Maintain merchant clearing schedules, deferred-revenue schedules, and restricted-receipt schedules under Controller guidance
  • Identify discrepancies and escalate unresolved items to the Controller promptly; maintain exception logs and track the age of unresolved items

Congress & Meetings Revenue Support

  • Maintain Congress and workshop revenue workpapers and support the Controller as the finance contact for Registration and Sales (Business Development) teams
  • Support merchant service account set-up and closeout for Congress and educational workshops, working with the Meetings Registration team
  • Perform monthly revenue reconciliation comparisons with Meetings Registration on ongoing Congress registration revenue
  • Support the Controller and international sales tax consultants with invoice templates, data, and return preparation
  • Be a functional user of the meetings management and registration applications

Grants & Program Financial Administration

  • Maintain incoming grant receipt schedules, and support consolidated grant reporting and audit requests
  • Assist in preparing documentation for grant reporting

Reporting Support

  • Generate standard monthly and ad hoc reports, including accounts receivable aging, revenue reports, and general ledger reports
  • Supplemental reports Produce standard report exports and draft cost-center reporting packages after close
  • Prepare non-payroll indirect cost allocation calculations using ISTH Finance Team-approved rules, for Controller review
  • Compile data and schedules for the Controller and Director

Audit & Year-End Support

  • Prepare revenue, AR, deferred revenue, and grant receipt schedules and supporting documentation for the annual audit and tax filings
  • Keep all revenue records complete, organized, and audit-ready

Systems & Data Coordination

  • Monitor revenue integrations among registration, membership, merchant, and ERP systems, and flag errors or inconsistencies
  • Assist with data imports, exports, and cleanup across systems
  • Maintain organized exception logs and supporting documentation
  • Support documentation of AR procedures and SOPs

Backup Responsibilities

  • After training, serve as backup for invoice entry, reimbursement processing, AP inquiries, and payment-batch preparation
  • Payroll backup requires explicit training and restricted access
  • Backup coverage never includes self-approval or unchecked payment release; approvals move to another authorized person when this role covers a transaction

General Responsibilities

  • Maintain organized digital filing systems for all revenue documentation
  • Undertake special projects and other duties as assigned

Skills, Abilities, and Knowledge

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage recurring deadlines, including Congress peak periods
  • Ability to work across multiple systems and reconcile data inconsistencies
  • Strong problem-solving skills, especially with data discrepancies
  • Comfort handling multiple currencies and international transactions
  • Understanding of internal controls and segregation of duties
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
  • Clear, professional communication with staff, members, customers, and external partners

Minimum Requirements

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field preferred
  • 3–5+ years of bookkeeping or accounting support experience, including accounts receivable or revenue processing (nonprofit preferred)
  • Experience with accounting systems (e.g., Sage Intacct), merchant services and web-based payment platforms
  • Experience with multiple revenue streams and/or international transactions is a plus
  • Experience with registration, meetings, or association management systems is a plus
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial data management

Work Environment

  • Remote work environment and requires use of standard office equipment and systems
  • Ability to collaborate during agreed working hours and meet scheduled payment, payroll, month-end, Congress, and year-end deadlines, as applicable.
  • Occasional travel may be required
Salary: $64,500 - $68,000
