Customer Service Representative (CSR)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Service Representative (CSR) to deliver exceptional support across phone, email, chat, and ticketing platforms.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and delivering professional, empathetic service in a fast-paced environment. You’ll serve as the first point of contact for customers, resolve issues efficiently, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure every interaction leaves a positive impression.

Responsibilities

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

  • Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and support tickets.
  • Resolve customer issues professionally and efficiently.
  • Troubleshoot common concerns and escalate complex cases when needed.
  • Deliver outstanding customer experiences while meeting response time expectations.

Ticket & Case Management

  • Manage support requests using platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, or Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Prioritize tickets based on urgency and SLAs.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions.
  • Follow up on open cases until resolution.

Customer Experience

  • Communicate clearly and empathetically across all support channels.
  • De-escalate challenging customer situations professionally.
  • Capture customer feedback and identify recurring issues.
  • Maintain a customer-first approach in every interaction.

Knowledge Base & Team Collaboration

  • Update knowledge base articles, FAQs, and response templates.
  • Identify opportunities to improve support processes.
  • Collaborate with operations, product, billing, and technical teams to resolve escalated issues.
  • Ensure accurate handoffs and compliance with company policies.

Required Experience & Skills

raw.description:
Location

This role is open to candidates based anywhere in Canada. While we are considering applicants from across the country, we have a strong preference for candidates based in British Columbia or elsewhere in the Pacific time zone, to support employers and advisors across Western Canada.

About Common Wealth

Common Wealth exists to make retirement security accessible to all Canadians. As Canada’s fastest-growing group retirement provider, we serve over 1,800 employers across the country and are helping tens of thousands of Canadians build long-term financial security. Our award-winning retirement platform makes it easy for employers of all sizes to offer competitive retirement benefits, empowers members to build wealth with confidence, and equips advisors with tools to better serve their clients. We work closely with a rapidly expanding network of advisors, for whom we strive to be a true partner in powering the growth of their business.

About the Opportunity

Reporting to the Director of Account Management, you'll own the employer relationship from the moment a deal closes through the life of the partnership. Today, people working for small and mid-sized employers are left to build retirement savings on their own, which leads to inefficient savings and poor outcomes. Our Account Managers are how we change that: getting plans live, getting employees enrolled and contributing, and keeping employers and their advisors confident in Common Wealth year after year. This is a high-volume, scaled role, with each Account Manager supporting a portfolio of several hundred employers.

You'll work closely with advisors, who are often the primary relationship on an account, and with cross-functional partners in Sales, Customer Service and Operations, Employer Service, Product, and Marketing. You'll run on a playbook-driven operating model built on HubSpot and our internal Account Management Hub, and you'll help shape it as the team grows. Your work will directly contribute to better retirement outcomes and a more inclusive financial future for all Canadians.

What You'll Do

Implementation

  • Own implementation for newly signed employers, from closed-won handoff through first payroll contribution
  • Partner with Account Executives on a smooth handoff, then lead kickoff meetings and onboarding check-ins
  • Guide employers through plan setup, including pre-authorized debit (PAD) forms, eligible employee lists, and payroll setup
  • Manage launch timelines, flag risks early, and coordinate with the advisor and Account Executive when a launch date needs to move
  • Deliver employee education sessions that drive enrollment and contributions

Portfolio, adoption, and retention

  • Manage a scaled portfolio of several hundred employers, prioritizing your time using account health signals and a weekly account briefing
  • Run proactive check-ins and stewardship meetings that keep employers engaged and reinforce the value of their plan
  • Grow participation after launch by spotting low-enrollment accounts and acting on them
  • Collect client feedback, including NPS, and use it to improve the client experience
  • Identify at-risk accounts early and act on them using our retention playbook, including plan design and advisor levers

Advisors and partners

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employers and their advisors
  • Partner with advisors as a core channel, coordinating on implementations, plan design, and client health
  • Work with Customer Service and Operations, Employer Service, Product, and Marketing to resolve issues, reduce churn, and improve client outcomes
  • Keep HubSpot accurate and current, and contribute to the playbooks and tools the team runs on

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 2+ years in account management, customer success, client onboarding, or implementation, ideally in B2B SaaS, financial services, or employee benefits
  • Experience managing a high volume of accounts at once, with a track record of prioritizing well
  • Comfort presenting to groups of all sizes, from a small HR team to an all-staff education session
  • Working knowledge of a CRM, ideally HubSpot

Nice to have

  • Experience in group retirement, group benefits, or payroll
  • Familiarity with RRSP, DPSP, and TFSA plans, or eagerness to learn them quickly
  • Experience working alongside financial advisors or brokers
  • Comfort using AI tools to work more efficiently

Who You Are

  • Relationship-driven and collaborative. You build trust quickly with clients and internal partners and thrive in cross-functional environments.
  • Clear, confident communicator. You’re comfortable engaging senior leaders and facilitating education sessions for groups of varying sizes, adapting your message for clarity and impact.
  • Organized, independent, and adaptable. You manage a large portfolio and competing priorities with confidence in a fast-moving, evolving environment.
  • Mission-aligned and curious. You’re motivated by Common Wealth’s mission and eager to learn, ask questions, and continuously improve.
  • Detail-oriented and data-minded. You value precision and use data to guide decisions and deliver consistent, high-quality client experiences.

Why Work With Us

Common Wealth is a fast-growing company with a mission to change the lives of Canadians. You’ll be joining a dynamic and flexible work environment where you have the autonomy to shape your role. You’ll have ample opportunities to learn, grow, and advance within the organization while contributing to improving the Canadian retirement landscape.

Total compensation includes:

  • Join a mission-driven company transforming retirement in Canada
  • High-growth environment with autonomy and clear career pathways
  • Competitive Compensation: $70–80k base pay + variable, with the total target compensation up to $100k
  • Medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Health Spending Account
  • 5% employer match into our group retirement plan
  • 4 weeks vacation
  • Home Office Stipend
  • Top of the line hardware
  • Annual Learning & Development Budget
  • Flex Holiday and Summer Friday Program
  • Annual Company Summit

To Apply:

We are a respectful workplace committed to building a skilled and diverse workforce. We believe in fostering an inclusive work environment where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. We welcome and encourage applications from everyone. We look forward to hearing from you!

Salary: 100, 000

Position: Head of Amazon Operations
Location: Remote (US) with quarterly travel to Michigan
Type: Full time, exempt
Compensation: $140,000–$170,000 salary, paid time off, monthly health stipend (goal of launching insurance in Q1 2027)

NOTE: A short (1-3 min) video upload is required for your application to be considered. All videos will be reviewed by a human - no AI filtering. Details below.

Overview

Ballard House is a founder-led ecommerce company that partners with established brands to scale their Amazon operations using our in-house infrastructure in content creation, advertising and logistics. We began as an Amazon reseller in 2017, evolved into the accelerator model in 2023, and have expanded rapidly, hitting the 2026 Inc 5000 list and Top 25 fastest growing companies in Michigan. We proudly bring our commitment to human relationships and exceptional execution to a growing portfolio of eight and nine figure brands.

We’re hiring a Head of Amazon Operations to lead the operations team, drive process improvement and ensure consistently excellent execution as our brand portfolio and organization grow. This role will focus on scalable systems across operations, including client services KPIs (on time task completion, labor bandwidth allocation per brand, quarterly project management), logistics and fulfillment (freight efficiency, inventory sell through, demand planning) and blending scalable people management with AI implementation into recurring workflows.

This role will oversee the design of Clickup workflows, lead a cross-functional team of 10+, and remove points of friction within verticals including demand planning, catalog management, content creation, advertising and reporting. You will get a direct say in shaping how data is used, the cadence the team follows to get work done, and raising the bar for how Ballard House executes for our partners. Reporting directly to the COO, the Head of Amazon Ops also sits on our leadership team and will directly contribute to strategic planning at the company level through collaboration with other department heads.

This role does not own: Setting strategic growth priorities for brands, leading account management, setting product page content standards or setting advertising strategy. It also does not own day-to-day warehouse operations. Instead, you’ll focus on building the engine that drives consistent execution across our portfolio.

Meet Your Future COO

Watchthis short video (3 min) to hear about the role and the kind of team we’re building.

Responsibilities

  • Accountable for leading team performance across inventory planning, content, advertising, catalog and operations to hit KPIs for core service
  • Lead process improvement across brand management operations and cross-functionally with the warehouse and account management teams
  • Ensure SME team leads (ads, media, catalog, inventory) own and maintain current SOPs and hold them accountable for documentation quality, versioning, and adoption
  • Coordinate with brand managers, inventory planning team and warehousing to ensure product flow is optimal throughout seasonal fluctuations and peak events
  • Define operational reporting requirements, and drive improved data quality and accessibility
  • Identify resource gaps and lead initiatives to expand the team and toolset, including hiring, training, and software implementations
  • Lead recurring operations meetings to track KPIs, remove friction, and drive collaboration across disciplines
  • Help evolve team structure, management systems, communication cadence, and delegation as the department grows from 15 to 30+ people
  • Serve as a core member of the leadership team, pressure-testing ideas against real team capacity and implementation feasibility
  • Travel quarterly to Michigan or other domestic location for leadership team strategic planning and/or team events, with greater frequency in year one
  • Periodic trade show and industry event travel required

Qualifications

  • 3–7 years of experience leading operations or client services at an ecommerce agency or 8-9 figure ecommerce brand
  • Deep operational fluency in Amazon Seller Central in subjects including catalog, ecommerce demand planning, logistics, account health and data management
  • Proven ability to lead and grow teams of 10+, build SOPs, and own execution across multiple functions
  • Hands on experience building and refining project management workflows, preferable in an agency environment
  • Ability to communicate concisely, run effective meetings, hold a team accountable, and work cross-functionally
  • Real world experience using AI to accelerate teams or individual contributors

This role is for you if:

  • You look at a workflow and can’t stop finding ways it could be simpler
  • You prefer small biz scrappy to corporate drama and committees
  • You love doing work that makes an impact and generates a real win
  • You’ve worked brand-side or agency-side in ecommerce operations and love the mix of logistics, data, and team execution
  • Love the puzzle of making sure products are at the right place at the right time
  • You like to clarify the goal, then compress the timeline to completion
  • You wouldn’t trade your reputation for a short-term win
  • You agree that watching a team run smoothly is one of life’s greatest joys
  • You believe the shared mission is more important than keeping everyone happy

Probably not the right fit if you:

  • Love the comfort of having an SOP for all situations
  • Would rather let someone else manage the details so you can focus on the big picture
  • Get burned out managing multiple projects
  • Prefer to set easy goals because missing a target feels bad
  • Want to ship something once, then move on forever
  • See operations more as “maintenance” than a growth driver
  • Think learning AI is ‘not your thing’
  • Feel like giving or receiving process-oriented feedback is painful or unkind

Benefits

We invest in people who move the business forward. We offer competitive compensation and a high-trust, high-performance environment where operators can thrive. Perks include:

  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • No bureaucracy or layers of management, just clear goals and real ownership
  • Work with founders and leadership daily
  • Tools and training to help you grow in ecommerce and operations
  • A team that moves fast, wins together, and doesn’t tolerate drama

In addition, we provide a monthly health stipend to support coverage until we transition to a full healthcare and retirement package, which is on the roadmap for 2027.

Travel Requirement:

This is a remote leadership role. Because much of the team this position leads and our broader leadership team are based in Southeast Michigan, we expect the Head of Amazon Operations to spend meaningful time in person with the team. During the first six months, expect approximately one Michigan visit every 4–6 weeks, with visits typically lasting 2–4 days. Long-term cadence will typically be 4–6 times per year for 2–4 business days at a time, including quarterly leadership planning and periodic operations/team working sessions. Travel expenses are covered by Ballard House.

Company Core Values

These aren’t poster values. We use them every day to make decisions. If they match how you operate, you’ll fit right in.

Unimpeachable Character: Be someone others are always proud to associate with, personally and professionally

Open and Honest: Feedback is our fuel to grow

Play to Win: Define what it takes to win, then do it

Always MovingForward: We choose relentless positivity

How to apply

Please submit a 1–3 minute video answering the following. We don’t care about polish - we care about clarity, energy, and how you think.

  • Why are you interested in this position?
  • What are your strengths?
  • What’s something small you’ve learned recently that made a real difference?

Submit your video via this Google Form:

raw.description:
Own Sherman's investment thinking and carry it to the world.

Role: Head of Investment Research (Full-Time)
Team: Investment Research
Company: Sherman Research

Location: Remote (US), with regular travel for conferences, media, and advisor events

Reports to: President & CEO

Compensation: $220,000-$260,000 on-target earnings (salary + bonus), depending on experience

Who we are

Sherman Research has been doing this since 1999. We're based in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, and we build signal-driven research, model portfolios, and technology for financial professionals.

At the core is a patented set of six proprietary indicators that track short, medium, long, and seasonal timeframes. When momentum shifts in either direction, the system triggers a real-time signal. Advisors use those signals to make disciplined allocation decisions instead of guessing. That research sits underneath more than fifty tactical allocation portfolios, plus the Sherman Launch System, the Command Module, and the Portfolio Toolkit.

Roughly 300 independent advisors, RIA firms, broker-dealers, and platform partners use our work, representing close to $2 billion in client assets.

Two things to know before you apply.

We're a research firm first. Everything we publish sits next to an investment process people have real money in. Accuracy comes first.

Our work is worship. Sherman is a mission-driven, values-led company. We hire for character alongside competence. We run on a purpose beyond profit: we launch financial strategies that propel lives for Christ. That's why we donate 51% of our profits to advance the gospel.

Why this role exists

Research is the heart of Sherman's value. We need a leader who owns that research and can carry it to the world.

This is a rare two-sided role. You have the depth to own our investment thinking, test new ideas, and defend every decision with evidence. You also have the presence to stand on a conference stage, sit down with a news anchor, or lead a webinar for hundreds of advisors, and leave people clearer and more confident than when they arrived.

We're looking for an optimist. Not a cheerleader, and not a doom forecaster. Someone who studies the data honestly, has a clear view of where things are going, and helps advisors and their clients act on it with confidence.

You'll be Sherman's public voice on markets. You'll speak from a believer's perspective, in a way that wins the hearts and minds of believers and non-believers alike.

What you'll be building

  • A research engine. A documented investment philosophy and process, a research agenda, and new methods that grow the depth and breadth of what Sherman brings to advisors.
  • A public voice. Sherman as a recognized, trusted voice on markets: webinars, conferences, shows, podcasts, news outlets, and our own channels.
  • An advisor education practice. Clear, simple explanations of complex strategies, so advisors know what to do and why.
  • A research practice that scales. Work that is documented and repeatable, and does not depend on any one person.

Core responsibilities

1) Research and R&D

  • Own and articulate Sherman's investment philosophy and methodology.
  • Lead ongoing research across markets, asset classes, and strategies.
  • Find, test, and validate new approaches. Pressure-test ideas and guard against bias and overfitting.
  • Grow the depth and breadth of our research, including diversifiers beyond equities such as managed futures, gold, and Treasuries.
  • Review and vet new strategies before they go to market, and decide how they should be explained.

2) Thought leadership and public voice

  • Lead Sherman's monthly Client Briefing webinar for advisors.
  • Represent Sherman on financial shows, podcasts, and with news outlets.
  • Speak at industry conferences, including alongside economists and other market voices.
  • Publish steady commentary: written pieces, social posts, and short video market updates. Think in public and grow an audience for Sherman.
  • Share a clear, forward-looking view: "Here's where we think things are going, and here's what it means for you."

3) Advisor education and support

  • Turn complex research into simple, useful guidance. Lead with the takeaway and keep the detail ready for anyone who wants it.
  • Own the advisor and client education roadmap: what we teach, in what order, and in what format.
  • Answer the deep research and model questions that advisors bring to our team.

4) Partnership with Product, Machine Learning, and Growth

  • Work with Product and Machine Learning to put research methods into production.
  • Make sure our models reflect sound investment reasoning, not just statistics.
  • Help the Growth team market new strategies clearly and accurately.
  • Help advisors find the right Sherman solution for their clients, including our models on the True Freedom Investing TAMP.

5) Research operations and leadership

  • Document methods, data sources, and decisions so the work can be repeated. Cite every source.
  • Set research quality standards and review practices.
  • Direct the research work of our analysts and help them grow.

What success looks like (first 90 days)

  • You're leading the monthly Client Briefing webinar.
  • Sherman's investment philosophy and process are documented in your words.
  • You've reviewed the strategies in our pipeline and have a plan to bring them to advisors simply.
  • A prioritized research agenda is in motion.
  • Your first public pieces are published, and your first media or conference appearances are on the calendar.

What success looks like (ongoing)

  • Advisors trust the thinking behind our portfolios and know what to do with it.
  • Sherman is a recognized voice on markets in the media, at conferences, and online.
  • Our research grows in depth and breadth, and every decision is defensible and documented.
  • More advisors and their clients choose Sherman's models.
  • The research practice scales beyond any one person.

Who you are

  • An optimist with depth. Your hope comes from the evidence, not from ignoring it.
  • Dynamic and deep. You can go three layers into the data, then explain it to a room in two minutes.
  • Mission-aligned. You share Sherman's purpose, and you speak from a biblical worldview with grace and conviction. This one is non-negotiable.
  • A strong communicator. Verbal, written, on camera, and on stage.
  • A teacher. People leave your webinars smarter and more confident, not more confused.
  • Humble and honest. You follow the evidence, not your ego, and you say "I was wrong" when you were.

How you work (standards and values)

  • Intellectual honesty: you follow the evidence, not the ego.
  • Rigor: reproducible methods, tested assumptions.
  • Clarity: you explain the "why" in plain language.
  • Discipline: you stay anchored to process under market pressure.
  • Stewardship: you remember real clients are on the other side.
  • Character: our culture is built on the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23).

Required

  • 10+ years in investment research (asset management, RIA, broker-dealer, or research firm), including senior leadership of research strategy or a research team.
  • Deep expertise in momentum, trend-following, and tactical asset allocation, including building and leading tactical model portfolios.
  • Strong understanding of portfolio construction and markets.
  • Quantitative rigor and sound statistical judgment.
  • A proven track record as an industry expert and speaker: conference talks, media interviews, podcasts, webinars, or video you can show us.
  • Excellent writing, with published research or commentary.
  • High standards for documentation and reproducibility.
  • Alignment with Sherman's mission and values.

Strong pluses

  • CFA or CMT, or equivalent depth.
  • Experience as a chief investment officer, chief market strategist, or head of research.
  • Experience with systematic or multi-asset strategies.
  • An existing audience on YouTube, X, Substack, LinkedIn, or a podcast.
  • Regular appearances on financial TV, radio, or podcasts.
  • Experience presenting to financial advisors.
  • Experience working with quant or machine learning teams.

What this role is not

  • A behind-the-scenes analyst who never presents.
  • A pundit who chases headlines or promises returns.
  • A pessimist who leads with fear.

Tools you'll use

  • Research, data, and analytics tools
  • Notion (research notes and methodology docs)
  • Portfolio and modeling systems (with Product and Machine Learning)
  • Zoom, plus camera and audio for webinars and video

Reporting and collaboration

  • Reports to: President & CEO
  • Works closely with: Product Development, Machine Learning, Advisor Success, and Growth

Guardrails

Public commentary goes through our compliance review. Views on the future are shared as views, not guarantees. No performance promises and no personalized advice.

How we hire

We're taking our time with this hire, because it matters. Expect several conversations, a short research work sample, a recorded or live 10-minute market briefing for an advisor audience, and time with our team and our CEO.

How to apply

Apply through this posting. Along with your resume, please share links to talks, media appearances, webinars, or published research you would like us to see.

The role in one line

The Head of Investment Research owns Sherman's investment thinking and carries it to the world: deep research, a clear and hopeful view of where things are going, and the presence to share it with advisors, the media, and the conference stage.

Salary: $220,000-$260,000 Annually OTE (salary + bonus)

Job description

Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.

  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.

  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.

  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.

  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.

  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.

  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

The hourly earnings for this role are 23 USD per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in English.

  • Resident in Australia for the last 5 consecutive years.

  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.

  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.

  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.

  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification

  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.

  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.

  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.

  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

raw.title: Senior Cyber Incident Response Engineer
raw.excerpt: NBCUniversal is seeking a Senior Cyber Incident Response Engineer to design, automate, integrate, and continuously improve the technical systems, workflows, and tooling used to detect, investigate, contain, and recover from cybersecurity incidents.
raw.description:
NBCUniversal is seeking a Senior Cyber Incident Response Engineer to design, automate, integrate, and continuously improve the technical systems, workflows, and tooling used to detect, investigate, contain, and recover from cybersecurity incidents. This role combines hands-on response engineering with incident readiness and operational improvement, helping ensure responders have the automation, telemetry, access, and processes needed to act quickly and effectively. The ideal candidate brings strong incident response and DFIR expertise, practical engineering skill, and the ability to turn repeated operational pain points into scalable, reliable capabilities that improve response quality and reduce time to action.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex investigations involving host, network, identity, email, and cloud artifacts to determine risk, impact, scope, and root cause.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to guide containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident improvement activities.
  • Brief technical teams and leadership on findings, risks, recommendations, and response decisions during and after incidents.
  • Contribute to incident response standards, methodologies, documentation, and internal knowledge sharing.
  • Serve as technical escalation point for incident response activities, including containment, investigation, and remediations
  • Design, build, and improve automated evidence collection capabilities that increase the speed, consistency, and completeness of incident investigations.
  • Create and maintain SOAR playbooks that orchestrate investigation, enrichment, containment, notification, and recovery workflows.
  • Integrate SIEM, EDR, IAM, cloud, email, case management, and threat intelligence platforms to enable unified response actions and stronger analyst context.
  • Develop and deploy response tooling that may utilize AI to improve response capabilities across cloud, endpoint, identity, SaaS, email, and data platforms.
  • Develop scripts, tools, and integrations that support triage, containment, enrichment, forensic collection, and operational response workflows.
  • Work alongside incident responders to ensure logs, telemetry, access, and tooling needed to investigate and respond are available without unnecessary delay.
  • Build dashboards, operational views, and incident metrics that measure response performance, workflow health, and process effectiveness.
  • Identify repeated manual analyst tasks and turn them into safe, scalable, and repeatable automation opportunities.
  • Review incident response plans, identify readiness gaps, and help develop practical strategies to improve preparedness.
  • Design and optimize incident response playbooks aligned to relevant threats, operating models, and business needs to allow for quick identification and response to potential incidents.
  • Collaborate with Response Operations and Automation team stakeholders for prioritization, automation creation, and integrations with security tooling
  • Facilitate or support tabletop exercises, drills, and readiness activities to validate plans and improve operational performance.
  • Availability for incident response on-call rotation, including weekend coverage, as required.
  • 6+ years of relevant cybersecurity experience in incident response, DFIR, detection engineering, threat hunting, SOC escalation, security automation, cyber defense engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Strong proficiency with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages used for automation and response engineering.
  • Ability to lead projects with little guidance, and strong communication
  • Knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, Data Lake, and enterprise security tooling and methodologies.
  • Experience handling security incidents and investigating a multitude of cyber threats with various TTPs across multiple enterprise platforms
  • Experience building and maintaining API integrations across security and enterprise platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SIEM query languages such as SPL, KQL, SQL, or equivalent analytics languages.
  • Experience with EDR response actions, investigation workflows, and endpoint containment techniques.
  • Experience designing, building, or operating SOAR platforms and automated playbooks.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint, identity, network, cloud, email, and SaaS telemetry, including logging, evidence collection, and containment actions across modern environments.
  • Experience collecting and using forensic artifacts to support investigations across endpoints, identities, cloud services, email, or SaaS platforms.
  • Ability to design for scale, repeatability, automation, reliability, and reduced response time in a production security environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Digital Forensics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ownership of incident response engineering, automation, forensic collection, containment workflows, or large-scale security operations improvements.
  • Experience conducting threat intelligence, threat detection, malware analysis, or forensic analysis in security incidents as a team
  • Experience building and leveraging AI-assisted tooling in investigation or triage workflows for a large, distributed enterprise environment
  • Experience integrating case management, email security, identity platforms, cloud services, and threat intelligence into response workflows.
  • Experience building analyst-facing dashboards, metrics, and reporting that show operational health and response effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies, AI agents, and LLMs
  • Familiarity with secure automation guardrails, approval models, and change control for containment actions.
  • Experience with detection engineering and the operationalization of alerts, enrichments, and response workflows.
  • Experience improving responder access to logs, telemetry, and investigative tooling across multiple security domains.
  • Relevant certifications: GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, EnCE, CFCE, GCIA, GSEC, CySA+, Blue Team Level 2, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, Google Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CISM, GPEN, OSCP, or PNPT.

Additional Requirements

Fully Remote: This position is fully remote, meaning you are expected to work from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company-sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $140,000 - $175,000 (bonus eligible)

We are accepting applications for this position on an ongoing basis.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. Job Title: Consultant - People Science

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We've moved away from traditional resume-based screening to a more data-driven and objective approach to identify talent more accurately and discover diverse candidates. You'll help manage these programs, working across functions to evaluate whether our approach is improving hiring quality and efficiency. You'll partner closely with our Recruitment team to integrate the process seamlessly and maintain operational excellence in the hiring process.

But it's not just operational. You'll analyze what we're learning about the talent we hire and help leaders understand what that means for how their organizations develop over time. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to business leaders, using data and behavioral science to help bring objectivity to talent decisions such as hiring, promotions, internal transfers, and organizational design.

What You’ll Do

    • Support business leaders in talent decisions across multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Services, Product Management) using data and behavioral science
    • Partner with senior leaders to evaluate hiring model effectiveness and make data-driven improvements
    • Work with Recruitment to maintain operational excellence in our assessment-based hiring process
    • Analyze hiring patterns and provide insights on talent composition and development needs as departments evolve
    • Present findings and recommendations to leadership on program effectiveness

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience in management consulting, human capital, or internal talent/org strategy
    • Strong problem solving ability, communication, presenting, and operational skills
    • Client-facing experience working with leaders at various levels (managers and executives)
    • Comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations
    • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
    • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a "do the right thing" company. We expect that from all employees
    • Based in Madison, Boston, Philadelphia, or New York

Nice to Have

    • Experience with assessment tools or psychometric instruments
    • Exposure to data analytics or business intelligence tools

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $82,000 - $125,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Our holistic and streamlined approach offers comprehensive solutions for small business entrepreneurs, real estate developers, community-based organizations, and local leaders at every stage of growth, from inception to expansion. The Loan Officer position is part of the Community Development Lending (CDL) team under Capital Impact Partners (CIP). This individual will contribute to projects nationwide, with a primary focus on transactions within CIP's Western region.

The ideal candidate is passionate about community and economic development, and impact investing.

The Loan Officer is responsible for originating and underwriting acquisition/predevelopment, construction, lines of credit, and term loans to support projects in Capital Impact’s key sectors: housing, healthcare, education, healthy food, aging, and cooperatives. The position also involves closing transactions that utilize New Markets Tax Credits (NMTCs).

In accordance with Capital Impact’s lending policies and procedures, the Loan Officer prepares and presents loan narratives and credit memos to the loan committee or other approved Momentus Loan Administration groups for closing. Additionally, they collaborate with the Momentus portfolio management team on ongoing asset management. The role also supports the achievement of lending work plan goals, markets Momentus products, and manages relationships with borrowers, lending partners, technical assistance providers, government agencies, and public officials.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:

The Loan Officer reports to the NMTC & Structuring Market Manager. The Loan Officer works closely with the Capital Deployment team, Business Development Officers, and Underwriters on loan closings. They also work with Underwriters and Portfolio Managers on asset management. The Loan Officer communicates regularly with borrowers, third-party lenders, attorneys, and other external stakeholders. Additionally, they attend loan committee meetings and represent Momentus/CIP to outside groups as needed.

Essential Responsibilities

Marketing/Business Development:

  • Supports the team in developing the lending pipeline by: helping to screen inquiries for mission and strategic alignment, feasibility, and project readiness; identifying and responding to new business opportunities; and meeting regularly with current CIP clients, potential borrowers, and lending partners to discuss their development pipelines and credit needs.
  • Attends various industry and client functions, representing Momentus/CIP as a part of the client team.
  • Maintains current knowledge of local, regional and national trends and conditions in the real estate development sector, including policy initiatives that will affect the underwriting, financing, and development processes.
  • Contributes to new product development including researching and analyzing market needs and analyzing credit risk of new product opportunities.

Underwriting:

  • Structures loans both to meet customers’ needs and to comply with internal guidelines based on extensive review and analysis of information gathered from the potential borrower and other sources and in consultation with the Head of Community Development Credit, the SVP of CDL, the Community Solutions team, and other relevant Momentus/CIP staff.
  • Performs due diligence review and evaluation of loan requests, which sometimes include a grant component, including conducting site inspections, analyzing cash flow projections, reviewing appraisals, assessing entitlement status, reviewing environmental reports, understanding market and operating strategy for community facility projects, reviewing organizational capacity and leadership, and spreading/analyzing sponsor financial statements, etc.
  • In consultation with the Manager, negotiates with borrowers on all aspects of loans, prepares a credit memo, and secures the appropriate level of approvals from internal staff and/or the appropriate loan committee with a recommendation for action.
  • Collaborates with co-lenders and third-party participants on co-lending and participations, respectively. In these cases, the Loan Officer mediates between the borrower and co-lender or participant and negotiates all aspects of the loan in accordance with Capital Impact’s agreement with the third party.

Closing:

  • Following financing approval, drafts an approval letter and coordinates loan documentation and work performed by attorneys and other Momentus/CIP staff.
  • When a portion of CIP’s loan will be shared with another financial institution, coordinates the distribution of information needed for the other lender to underwrite, approve, and close the loan.
  • Working in close collaboration with the assigned Underwriter, guides the transaction through closing. The Loan Officer is responsible for ensuring that the business terms of the transaction as reflected in the loan documents are consistent with the underwriting of the loan.
  • With the Underwriter, develops and maintains files to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • After loan closing, provides ongoing support to successful transition to the Portfolio Management Officer.
  • Coordinates closely with the applicable Underwriter and Portfolio Manager as part of the relationship management team for each client.

Other Responsibilities:

  • The Loan Officer must consistently provide excellent external relationship management and work closely with all internal lending and operations staff to ensure excellent customer service throughout the client’s relationship with Momentus/CIP.
  • The Loan Officer must maintain knowledge of all products across Momentus Capital products and refer prospective clients and partners to other Momentus teams when applicable.

Requirements

Professional Skills, Education and Experience

  • A degree in finance, real estate, urban planning, public policy, business administration, or a related field is preferred. However, education and experience are considered holistically.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of lending experience. Community development lending or mission-driven work is preferred.
  • Experience in community development or real estate lending, including credit analysis, deal structuring, underwriting, and due diligence. Familiarity with loan documentation is required.
  • Familiarity with federal, state, and local development programs, including NMTCs and Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs), is a plus.
  • Proficiency in analyzing financials for nonprofit organizations and for-profit developers.
  • Strong communication skills, including public speaking.
  • Knowledge of community facilities is preferred. Knowledge of funding sources for charter schools, health centers and community facilities (e.g., childcare centers, food markets, shelters, and social services).
  • Experience managing multiple projects under tight deadlines and developing innovative products for diverse borrowers.
  • Self-motivated, dedicated, and flexible, with strong time management and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20%.

Benefits

This role is eligible for remote work; however, it is preferred that the selected candidate resides in the Los Angeles or Oakland areas.

The salary range for this position is $85,896 – $127,412 and is eligible for an annual discretionary incentive.

  • Structure A: $85,896 to $114,671 All locations except Structures B and C
  • Structure B: $95,440 to $127,412 Washington, D.C.; Maryland; Virginia (DMV); non-Bay Area California markets; and Massachusetts

All employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The company will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

About YouScience, LLC

YouScience® is the leading education technology company dedicated to empowering individuals with the data and credentials needed to succeed in school, career, and life.

Its award-winning platform, YouScience Brightpath®, is the only College & Career Readiness solution built for both compliance and impact—powered by scientifically backed aptitude discovery, industry-recognized certifications, and meaningful career connections.

YouScience has served more than 13,400 educational institutions and millions of users nationwide, making it the preferred choice for individuals, parents, educators, and counselors to achieve real outcomes through education and career pathways.

Job Description

The Manager of Sales Enablement will be responsible for equipping our revenue teams with the knowledge, content, and tools required to drive growth and improve sales productivity in the education technology sector. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to build, deliver, and continuously optimize onboarding programs, ongoing training, and sales enablement resources. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, combining a strong understanding of B2B/EdTech sales cycles with expertise in instructional design and revenue technology platforms. By bridging product knowledge, market insights, and sales execution, you will play a critical role in helping sales representatives achieve consistent quota performance and accelerate time-to-value for customers. Successful candidates will bring a proactive, data-driven approach to identifying skill gaps, measuring training impact, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and high performance.

This role has the flexibility to be remote, in office (American Fork, Utah), or hybrid.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage comprehensive onboarding programs for new sales representatives to accelerate time to productivity.
  • Develop and maintain a centralized repository of sales collateral, playbooks, battle cards, and pitch decks in collaboration with Product Marketing.
  • Partner with sales leadership to identify skill and knowledge gaps across account executives and territory managers, creating targeted training initiatives.
  • Administer and optimize sales technology tools, learning management systems (LMS), and revenue enablement platforms to support day-to-day sales operations.
  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of enablement programs and report metrics to executive stakeholders.
  • Facilitate ongoing continuous education, including product releases, competitive positioning, consultative selling methodologies, and industry trends.
  • Conduct regular ride-alongs and call reviews (e.g., via Gong) to coach representatives on discovery, handling objections, and closing strategies.
  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to translate complex software features into compelling, value-based customer messaging.
  • Organize and execute sales enablement events, quarterly sales training workshops, and annual sales kick-off (SKO) programming.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 3-5+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Training, Product Marketing, or B2B SaaS Sales Excellence roles.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and delivering successful onboarding and continuous training programs for sales teams.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales enablement/LMS technologies (e.g., Docebo, LearnUpon, Gong, Highspot).
  • Exceptional presentation, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences and senior executives.
  • Strong understanding of consultative selling methodologies and B2B SaaS buyer journeys.

Extra Credit

  • Direct experience working within the Education Technology (EdTech) or K-12 / Higher Education market sectors.
  • Prior individual contributor experience in quota-carrying B2B software sales or account management.
  • Familiarity with career and technical education (CTE), aptitude assessments, or industry-recognized certifications.
  • Formal certifications in sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, MEDDPICC, Solution Selling) or Instructional Design.

  • Lead discussions with stakeholders to define the business or customer problem, conduct data discovery, and clarify key outcomes and success criteria

Wir sind P&T Software, rund 10 Leute, und bauen individuelle B2B-Software für Unternehmen mit komplexen Geschäftsprozessen. Bei uns setzt niemand nur Tickets um: Wir finden gemeinsam mit dem Kunden heraus, was wirklich gebaut werden muss, und setzen dann genau das um.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Backend (Java, Spring Boot) und Frontend (TypeScript, Vue.js) in anspruchsvollen Kundenprojekten entwickeln

  • Softwarearchitektur entwerfen und im Team diskutieren

  • Kundenberatung und Anforderungsanalyse, auch wenn der Kunde selbst noch nicht genau weiß, was er braucht

  • In unseren Projektteams arbeiten oder mehrere Monate als Berater:in im Team eines Kunden

  • Unsere Methoden und Werkzeuge weiterentwickeln und neue Technologien bewerten

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre in agilen, kommerziellen Softwareprojekten gearbeitet und kennst Java/Spring Boot sehr gut

  • Erfahrung im Frontend mit TypeScript und einem modernen Framework (bei uns vor allem Vue.js, Angular- oder React-Erfahrung ist ebenso willkommen)

  • Gutes Verständnis gängiger Webarchitekturen, REST-APIs, relationaler und dokumentenorientierter Datenbanken

  • Erfahrung mit dem Betrieb von Anwendungen in der Cloud (AWS, GCP oder Azure) sowie mit Docker und CI/CD

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau (du führst Kundengespräche und Workshops auf Deutsch) und gut Englisch

Bonus, kein Muss

AWS-Zertifizierungen, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK), Serverless, GraphQL, Node.js, Erfahrung als Berater:in beim Kunden, Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur (z.B. iSAQB).

Was wir bieten

  • Kompetetives Gehalt

  • Remote-Arbeit deutschlandweit, mit Büro im Herzen von Frankfurt, wenn du es nutzen möchtest

  • Kurze Wege und echten Einfluss auf Technologie- und Unternehmensentscheidungen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du teilst dir deinen Tag selbst ein, abgestimmt wird nur bei Kundenterminen und Teamrunden

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung mit fester Ansprechperson im Team

  • Moderne Ausstattung

  • 30 Urlaubstage

raw.excerpt: Worth AI, a leader in the computer software industry, is looking for a talented and experienced Product Manager to join their innovative team.
raw.description:
Worth AI, a leader in the computer software industry, is looking for a talented and experienced Product Manager to join their innovative team. At Worth AI, we are on a mission to revolutionize decision-making with the power of artificial intelligence while fostering an environment of collaboration, and adaptability, aiming to make a meaningful impact in the tech landscape. Our team values include extreme ownership, one team and creating reaving fans both for our employees and customers.

We’re seeking a Platform Product Manager who is passionate about building the dataand machine learning foundations that enable transformative digital experiences. Inthis role, you’ll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of our data and ML platform focusing on the core infrastructure, tooling, and services that power analytics, intelligent features, and product personalization at scale. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of product, data, and engineering. You are both technically fluent and deeply user-focused, with a strong ability to define scalable, privacy-conscious solutions that align with business strategy. You’ll partner closely with engineering, data science, design, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, extensible, and high-impact platform capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the vision and roadmap for our internal data and ML platform, ensuring it supports current and future product needs.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data science, and infrastructure teams to build scalable pipelines, APIs, services, and tooling for ML model development, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Gather and synthesize requirements from internal users (product teams, data scientists, analysts, etc.) to inform feature development and prioritization.
  • Drive the operationalization of ML models into production workflows, ensuring robust performance, scalability, and observability.
  • Define and maintain clear success metrics for platform features, including data quality, latency, reliability, and model impact.
  • Manage the product backlog and ensure timely, well-scoped, and technically feasible user stories for engineering teams.
  • Partner with design and engineering to improve internal UX for platform tools, data access, and workflows.
  • Establish and promote best practices around data governance, documentation, and developer experience.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure effective model integration, A/B testing, and measurement frameworks.
  • Lead platform-level initiatives such as self-serve data tooling, experimentation infrastructure, and data cataloging.
  • Support platform adoption by enabling documentation, training, and onboarding resources.
  • Serve as a key voice for platform product strategy in leadership forums and cross-functional planning sessions.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience as a product manager, preferably in platform, data infrastructure, or ML tooling
    • Deep understanding of data platforms and modern data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, Spark)
    • Strong grasp of ETL/ELT workflows, ML model lifecycle, and platform architecture
    • Hands-on experience working with data engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists in cross-functional teams
    • Proficiency in SQL and comfort navigating complex datasets to drive product insight
    • Proven ability to translate technical requirements into business value and vice versa
    • Excellent communication skills with experience presenting to technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Demonstrated track record of delivering platform products or services that enable broader team productivity and innovation
    • Strong prioritization, execution, and decision-making skills in fast-paced, evolving environments
    • Curious, collaborative, and growth-oriented mindset

Benefits

    • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
    • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
    • Life Insurance
    • Unlimited Paid Time Off
    • 9 paid Holidays
    • Family Leave
    • Work From Home
    • Free Food & Snacks (Access to Industrious Co-working Membership!)
    • Wellness Resources

raw.title: Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking
raw.excerpt: About The Company At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.
raw.description:
About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

  • Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
  • You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
  • Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords
  • Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators
  • Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus
  • Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper
  • Experimental: You actively try new channels and formats, like AI search, new social formats, distribution plays
  • You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling
  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Here's what we care about:

🔑 High Ownership
We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 No Bullshit, No Ego
We're too small for politics, posturing or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ Flexibility
Exceptional work doesn't require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We're remote-first and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 Sometimes We Leave the House
We do make time for real-life moments, like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions, to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Hire for Spikes
We don't expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We're building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

🛠 Default to Rethink
We don't accept "that's just how it is." We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there's a better way. First Principles isn't a buzzword for us.

💅🏼 Give Yourself a Little Treat
We offer benefits via hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy: Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

🤓 Your Learning Curve is Our Investment
Everyone at NaroIQ gets €1,000 per year for courses, books, coaching, or whatever helps them grow.

raw.description:
• Opracowywanie, wdrażanie i aktualizowanie standardów oraz procedur operacyjnych w obszarze logistyki zwrotnej.
  • Analizowanie procesów logistycznych w skali ogólnopolskiej, identyfikowanie nieprawidłowości oraz rekomendowanie działań optymalizacyjnych.
  • Przygotowywanie analiz i raportów operacyjnych dotyczących m.in. wolumenów, terminowości, efektywności procesów oraz realizacji budżetu.
  • Tworzenie i rozwijanie narzędzi analitycznych oraz raportowych wspierających podejmowanie decyzji biznesowych.
  • Koordynowanie projektów związanych z usprawnianiem procesów logistycznych, wdrażaniem nowych rozwiązań oraz rozwojem infrastruktury operacyjnej.
  • Przygotowywanie prezentacji, zestawień i rekomendacji biznesowych na potrzeby kadry zarządzającej.
  • Współpraca z zespołami regionalnymi i oddziałowymi w zakresie standaryzacji procesów oraz rozwiązywania bieżących problemów operacyjnych.
  • Współpraca z działami IT, analityki, HR oraz innymi jednostkami organizacyjnymi przy realizacji projektów międzydziałowych.
  • Udział w audytach i wizytach operacyjnych w oddziałach w celu monitorowania zgodności procesów z przyjętymi standardami.
  • Minimum 2 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w obszarze logistyki, operacji logistycznych lub optymalizacji procesów.
  • Doświadczenie w analizowaniu danych operacyjnych, przygotowywaniu raportów oraz formułowaniu rekomendacji biznesowych.
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość programu MS Excel, w tym zaawansowanych formuł i narzędzi analitycznych.
  • Umiejętność wykorzystywania narzędzi AI do analizy danych i usprawniania codziennej pracy.
  • Umiejętność tworzenia i prowadzenia prezentacji biznesowych oraz przedstawiania wniosków i rekomendacji.
  • Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną komunikację.
  • Wykształcenie wyższe, preferowane kierunki związane z logistyką lub analityką danych.
  • Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analityczne oraz zdolność identyfikowania obszarów wymagających optymalizacji.
  • Umiejętność skutecznej komunikacji, współpracy z różnymi interesariuszami oraz wywierania wpływu bez formalnej podległości służbowej.
  • Samodzielność, proaktywność oraz bardzo dobra organizacja pracy w dynamicznym środowisku.
  • Gotowość do odbywania podróży służbowych na terenie Polski.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu lub koordynowaniu projektów związanych z optymalizacją procesów logistycznych.
  • Znajomość specyfiki logistyki zwrotnej oraz funkcjonowania sieci oddziałów logistycznych.
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z systemami WMS lub narzędziami do raportowania i wizualizacji danych.
  • Wykształcenie kierunkowe w obszarze analityki danych.
  • Znajomość języka angielskiego w stopniu biegłym.

To, co zapewniamy:

  • Zatrudnienie w ramach umowa o pracę
  • Samochód Służbowy
  • System kafeteryjny, w którym to pracownik sam wybiera benefity, z których korzysta (np. Multisport, prywatna opieka medyczna, bony do sklepów, bilety na wydarzenia sportowe i muzyczne i wiele, wiele więcej )
  • Możliwość rozwoju w ramach struktury firmy
  • Stabilną pracę w firmie, która jest liderem na rynku
  • Możliwość poszerzenia swoich kompetencji oraz zdobywania nowych
  • Dostęp do platformy e-learningowej GoodHabitz, na której znajduje się mnóstwo inspirujących szkoleń
  • Dostęp do aplikacji do nauki języków obcych eTutor

Nasze wartości
W InPost nasze wartości wyznaczają kierunek wszystkiego, co robimy:

  • START WITH THE CUSTOMER: Każda decyzja i działanie zaczyna się od myśli o kliencie. Staramy się nie tylko spełniać oczekiwania, ale je przekraczać.
  • THIS IS YOUR COMPANY – ACT LIKE IT: Wykazujemy się inicjatywą i bierzemy pełną odpowiedzialność za swoje działania. Gdy widzimy, że coś jest nie tak, reagujemy od razu – niezależnie od tego, czyja to działka.
  • CREATE, TEST, GROW: Stawiamy na przedsiębiorczość, ambicję i podejście budowniczego. Innowacja to próbowanie, porażki, wyciąganie wniosków, ulepszanie i wspólne osiąganie sukcesu.
  • ADAPT, LEARN, MOVE ON: Dobrze radzimy sobie w zmieniającym się otoczeniu. Działamy szybko, ale nie na oślep. Stale analizujemy, uczymy się i dostosowujemy. Tempo ma znaczenie, ale wygrywa tempo mądre i skoordynowane.
  • OUR TEAMS WIN, TOGETHER: Ostatecznie liczą się ludzie. Łączy nas zwycięska mentalność i pasja do naszej misji, a wyjątkowe wyniki osiągamy dzięki współpracy, docenianiu się nawzajem i świętowaniu sukcesów, dużych i małych.

Jak pewnie wiesz, w InPost bardzo dużo się dzieje! Głównym corem naszej działalności są urządzenia Paczkomat, które od lat produkujemy i projektujemy we własnym zakresie. Dodatkowo, stale rozwijamy nasze portfolio usług i wprowadzamy nowe rozwiązania, takie jak InPost Fresh, Fulfillment czy InPost Pay, ułatwiające życie milionom naszych klientów.

Praca w naszej firmie to praca wśród najlepszych liderów w międzynarodowym środowisku. Jako InPost Group działamy pod dwoma markami InPost i Mondial Relay, na rynku w Europie, w tym w Polsce, Francji, Wielkiej Brytanii, Hiszpanii, Portugalii, Włoszech i w krajach Beneluxu. Jesteśmy innowacyjni, konkretni, proaktywni, a przede wszystkim, zorientowani na efekt biznesowy naszych działań.

Are you an organized, customer-focused professional who enjoys solving account and operational issues?

Would you like to help sales teams stay focused on customer relationships, retention, and growth?


About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at


About Our Team

Our sales organization partners with customers to address complex risk, fraud, identity, compliance, and customer data management challenges. The team works collaboratively with Market Planning, Legal, Pricing, Sales, and other internal partners to develop strategic opportunities, negotiate customer agreements, and deliver solutions that support customer and business growth.


About the Role

As a Sales Support Specialist, you will serve as a key operational partner to the field sales organization, providing day-to-day support that enables Account Managers and sales leadership to focus on customer relationships, retention, and revenue growth. You will coordinate customer and sales support needs from initial inquiry through resolution, including billing and invoice inquiries, account and service issues, contract research, account maintenance, reporting, customer troubleshooting, and coordination with internal support teams.


Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive day-to-day operational support to assigned Account Managers, sales teams, and sales leadership.
  • Research and resolve customer account questions and operational issues, coordinating requests across internal teams to support timely resolution.
  • Research account history, agreements, contracts, and other customer information needed by the sales organization.
  • Help sales representatives navigate internal processes, systems, and support channels.
  • Research and assist with customer billing, invoicing, collections/dunning, service concerns, account discrepancies, and other customer-impacting issues.
  • Maintain ownership of issues through resolution and communicate status and next steps clearly to sales partners and, where appropriate, customers.
  • Prepare, maintain, and distribute reports that help Account Managers and sales leadership manage their books of business.
  • Support Top Account Reviews, booked-versus-billed tracking, invoice audits, and account and ID management activities.
  • Analyze available account information to identify issues requiring sales or operational attention.
  • Support regional and national sales campaigns and initiatives by coordinating information, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Build productive working relationships with Account Managers, sales leadership, customer support, billing, operations, and other internal teams.
  • Facilitate communication between sales and operational teams, escalate complex or high-impact customer issues through appropriate channels, and maintain documentation and follow-up on outstanding requests.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and sales support.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience preferred.
  • Experience in sales support, customer service, account management support, sales operations, or a related business function.
  • Demonstrated experience researching and resolving customer or account-related problems.
  • Strong customer service orientation and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, research, troubleshooting, organizational, and follow-through skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.
  • Sound judgment regarding escalation and issue resolution.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales professionals, customers, and cross-functional business partners.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced sales environment and ability to learn and navigate multiple internal systems and processes.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Teams, and related business productivity tools.
  • Ability to interpret account, billing, and operational information and communicate findings clearly.

Working for you:

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive, multi-carrier program for medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with match and an Employee Share Purchase Plan
  • Wellbeing: Wellness platform with incentives, Headspace app subscription, Employee Assistance and Time-off Programs
  • Short-and-Long Term Disability, Life and Accidental Death Insurance, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
  • Family Benefits, including bonding and family care leaves, adoption and surrogacy benefits
  • Health Savings, Health Care, Dependent Care and Commuter Spending Accounts
  • In addition to annual Paid Time Off, we offer up to two days of paid leave each to participate in Employee Resource Groups and to volunteer with your charity of choice
