raw.description:
The Senior Actuarial Analyst delivers decision-support analytics that help clients understand and improve their risk profile, taking a lead role on discrete pieces of client-facing analysis. This role prepares loss projections, claims analytics, collateral projections, and program comparisons that clients and Advisors rely on to make coverage, retention, and renewal decisions, and provides technical guidance to less experienced analysts. The ideal candidate is a critical thinker with strong technical and communication skills who can translate complex claims and financial data into clear recommendations, and who is comfortable working with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepare and lead analytical work for client decision-making, including loss projections, claims analysis, collateral projections, financial impact analyses, and program comparisons
  • Participate in client and prospect meetings, and lead discussions when necessary
  • Execute and present Catastrophe Modeling analysis
  • Manage discrete analyses and projects from start to finish, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely completion
  • Assist in data analysis to determine optimal program structure options
  • Create and maintain client presentations, including spreadsheets, charts, and interactive dashboards that tell a clear story to aid decisions and negotiations
  • Maintain analytical models and update rating factors as appropriate
  • Provide technical support and informal mentoring to Actuarial Analysts, including peer review of their work
  • Educate colleagues on analytical findings and the effective use of analytics
  • Respond to ad hoc analytic requests as needed; other duties as assigned

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Accounting, Finance, Analytics, or related field); substantial work experience may be considered in lieu of degree
  • 2–5 years of relevant work experience desired but not required
  • 2–4 actuarial exams preferred, with progress toward an Associate-level designation (ACAS)
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Strong multitasking and time-management skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Power BI)
  • Working knowledge of R, SQL, Python, or Tableau preferred
  • Professional in appearance and business conduct, with strong customer service

Salary: $95k - $120k salary range plus bonus opportunity and benefits. This information reflects the anticipated range for this position. Actual salary may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience, and other relevant factors.

Primary Function of Position:

The Clinical Territory Associate (CTA) will work closely with the Clinical Sales Manager to gain knowledge across all aspects of the business, including technical, clinical, and sales functions. Through a structured development journey, this role will build expertise in da Vinci® Surgery across a range of surgical specialties, supporting the growth of surgical robotics programs within the assigned territory. During the first year, the focus will be on developing strong technical and clinical capabilities, with increasing involvement in sales activities throughout the second year. The role also provides the opportunity to support a specific region by driving utilization of installed da Vinci® Surgical Systems through product demonstrations, in-service training, and sales support activities

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Case Support - be a resource to the surgical team by providing guidance, insight, and training on the use of the da Vinci® Surgical System.
  • Product Demonstrations/In-Services- Lead all technical in-services for customers to include OR staff, surgeons, etc.
  • Selling Activities- Contribute to Clinical Sales Manager team quarterly sales goals by helping influence behavior change in customers such as product demonstrations/in- services, OR selling activities, and customer support trainings.
  • Customer Support - Support and or coordinate, under the direction of the local sales management team, regional sales and marketing development events that create system awareness and procedure adoption through product demonstrations/in-services and selling activities.
  • Administrative Duties- Responsibly manage administrative tasks: reporting of sales/procedures, outcomes of sales activities, submission of expense reports, and assigned ISU on-line modules using company required software systems.
  • Act as a Medical Device Consultant, after appropriate training, as per legal requirement and provide guidance, insight, and support in the proper handling of Intuitive medical devices.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field, or several years of relevant professional experience.
  • Fluent in English and local language as required.
  • Ambition and strong work ethic.
  • Ability to excel in a high-energy, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and persuasive communication skills.
  • Proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Ability to travel up to 70%.
  • Sales degree a plus.

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

raw.description:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Test Equipment Planner to serve as the central operational leader for manufacturing testing logistics within our Project Management Office (PMO). In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical projects and procurement. You will be responsible for forecasting, tracking, and allocating specialized test hardware, custom fixtures, and lab instrumentation across a dynamic portfolio of hardware programs.

Your primary mission will be to eliminate testing bottlenecks, maximize asset utilization, streamline procurement pipelines, and ensure manufacturing test infrastructure is fully prepared to meet critical product milestones on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Master Equipment Scheduling & Capacity Planning: Develop, maintain, and optimize a master schedule for all manufacturing test equipment, environmental chambers, automated test equipment (ATE), and custom test fixtures across multiple product lines.
  • Cross-Project Allocation & Conflict Resolution: Serve as operational controller to coordinate asset sharing between competing project teams, proactively identifying resource constraints and negotiating resolutions with TPMs.
  • Technical Procurement & Demand Planning: Translate engineering requirements and high-level schedules into validated technical Bills of Materials (BOMs) for auxiliary hardware, custom cabling, pogo-pin jigs, and spare parts. Manage Clear-to-Build (CTB) tracking with Contract Manufacturers (CMs).
  • Vendor & Supply Chain Management: Partner with Procurement and vendors to flag long-lead items, obtain quotes, drive Purchase Order (PO) approvals, track deliveries, and verify incoming shipments against engineering specifications.
  • Asset Lifecycle & Maintenance Tracking: Monitor and schedule mandatory equipment calibration, routine preventative maintenance, and firmware updates to maintain 100% testing compliance without impacting project timelines.
  • Inventory Management: Oversee physical inventories of critical test consumables, high-wear tooling components, and backup instruments to prevent factory floor stoppages.
  • KPI Tracking & Reporting: Establish and report key metrics including equipment utilization rates, procurement lead times, and schedule variances due to hardware availability.

The ideal candidate in a few words

Minimum Qualifications

  • Technical bachelor's degree or strong technical college diploma plus relevant experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in hardware capacity planning, test engineering, technical program management, or manufacturing operations.
  • Experience with hardware development lifecycles, test hardware, and BOM management.
  • Demonstrated experience working with manufacturers, vendor management, and technical procurement processes.
  • Strong analytical skill set with proficiency in scheduling tools, capacity modeling, and inventory management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in high-volume electronics or hardware manufacturing environments.
  • Proven track record of cross-functional leadership across TPM, Engineering, and Procurement teams.
  • Deep understanding of Clear-to-Build (CTB) tracking, calibration standards, and preventive maintenance frameworks.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to negotiate resource conflicts and align stakeholders across organizational boundaries.
  • Flexible schedule and location – must be able to support the customer’s working hours located in Pacific time zone (GMT-7) and the contract manufacturer’s time zones in east Asia (GMT+8).
  • Fluency in French and high fluency in English written & spoken.

What’s in It for You

  • Learn and grow through multiple cutting-edge projects
  • Remote work model
  • Competitive benefits package and competitive total compensation
  • An additional day off for your birthday
  • Flex days paid between Christmas and New year's
  • Significant discounts on Montreal public transit passes.
  • Be part of a company that puts people, planet, and performance at the heart of its ESG commitments.

Our Group is committed to employment equity and to encouraging diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment, regardless of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

As of January 2026, Averna and Spherea joined forces to form the Spherea Group.  A global Test & Quality Solution leader, Averna Powered by Spherea partners with product designers, developers and manufacturers to help them achieve higher product quality, accelerate time to market and protect their brands by covering and offering solutions and expertise for the entire product lifecycle.

Averna Powered by Spherea offers specialized expertise and innovative test, vision inspection, precision assembly and automated solutions that deliver substantial technical, financial and market benefits for clients in the aerospace, automotive, consumer electronics, defense, energy, industrials, medical devices & life sciences, semiconductor, telecom and transportation industries. 

Their solutions include prototyping & consulting, precision assembly & production, automated test solutions, in-line test systems, test system replication, and test platforms & products. Averna Powered by Spherea’s expertise ranges from vision systems, specialized battery test, RF & microwave and fiber optics to robotics & motion, instrumentation, control systems, and data management.

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Lead QA Automation Engineer will drive quality strategy, test automation, and team leadership for CorroHealth IGNiTE™, a healthcare interoperability platform that connects EHR data with AI-powered solutions supporting clinical documentation integrity, coding automation, revenue optimization, denial prevention, and compliance. This role partners closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to ensure scalable, secure, and high-quality software through automated testing, CI/CD integration, and continuous process improvement in an Agile environment. This role is best suited for a QA leader with strong healthcare technology experience who can balance hands-on technical execution, team leadership, and strategic quality initiatives within a fast-paced, enterprise healthcare environment.
This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

This is a remote position.

Sadly, we are on high alert for scams, imposters and application fraud.We employ comprehensive screening and verification methods. Any attempt at application fraud or misrepresentation will be identified and lead to immediate removal from consideration.


This position requires permanent work status (US Citizenship OR Green Card).

Employees must live and work within the continental U.S.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of QA engineers to deliver high-quality software.
  • Lead manual and automated testing efforts, including regression, functional, UI, API, and performance testing.
  • Drive QA strategy, roadmap, and best practices in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to define testing goals and implement QA processes.
  • Establish automation-first testing culture and CI/CD best practices.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluation for QA engineers.

Test Strategy & Execution

  • Define and maintain test plans, test cases, and automation strategies.
  • Implement and enhance automated testing frameworks using Selenium, Cucumber, and Appium.
  • Ensure test coverage for new features, enhancements, and bug fixes across multiple platforms.
  • Work with DevOps teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
  • Establish best practices for performance testing, load testing, and security testing.

Collaboration & Problem-Solving

  • Work closely with developers, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure quality standards.
  • Identify risks and proactively implement mitigations in the SDLC.
  • Investigate complex defects and system failures, providing detailed reports and root cause analysis.
  • Improve testing processes by implementing best practices, AI tools, and emerging technologies.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing in a multi-tier, database-intensive, mission-critical application.
  • Excellent verbal and written problem-solving skills, communication, and stakeholder management.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Proactive, self-starter, highly accountable, and responsible
  • Intellectually curious and seeking continuous improvement
  • Proficiency in manual testing with an understanding of software QA methodologies.
  • Proficiency in test automation frameworks (Selenium, Appium, TestNG, NUnit, etc.).
  • Proficiency in coding/scripting technologies for automation (C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.).
  • Experience in API testing, SQL database testing, and UI testing.
  • Strong programming/scripting experience that has translated to automation of test cases using C#, Java, Python, PowerShell, etc
  • Experience with SQL and SQL Server
  • Experience integrating tests with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, etc.).
  • Experience with API testing tools (Postman, etc)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience leading QA strategy and process improvements in Agile environments.
  • Experience with front end performance / load testing
  • Experience with continuous delivery
  • Experience testing in the healthcare industry
  • Knowledge of healthcare industry standards like HL7, FHIR, and medical data exchange protocols.
  • Expertise in front-end performance/load testing tools like JMeter or k6.
  • Experience in visual test automation, AI-driven testing, or contract testing (Pact, Karate, etc.).
  • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Power BI, and other reporting tools.
  • Strong knowledge of Cloud environments (Azure, AWS) and microservices testing.
  • Familiarity with a suite of technology platforms and concepts such as HTML, .Net, C#, APIs etc.
  • Knowledge of HL7 message exchanges engines (Mirth, etc)

EDUCATION: Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

EXPERIENCE: Minimum 7+ years of related experience

We Offer:

  • Quality of life with a remote predictable, full-time schedule
  • Competitive Salary commensurate to experience
  • Medical, Dental, Vision coverage and more
  • Long-term disability insurance, and life insurance
  • Ample parental leave

What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As an AI Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems.

What you can work on:

  • From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data.

  • Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results.

  • Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights.

  • Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents.

  • Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus.

  • Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them.

  • Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Kinaxis Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career?
raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland, UK, Sweden, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium or Italy.

About the team

Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to help customers transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role and it is not a features team. It is a multi-disciplined deployment unit operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.

You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with customers from warehouse floor to executive sponsor designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi-disciplinary, and self-directed. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.

Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy.

What you will do

  • Own customer solutions end-to-end. Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy solutions in live operational environments where the stakes are real and the timeline is short.
  • Deliver relentless customer value. Build trusted relationships from the IC level to the executive sponsor and become the technical face of our company in the room.
  • Run multiple threads. Carry several customer engagements in parallel based on customer priorities and pod capacity. Set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when reality shifts, operate without close supervision, and own the outcome.
  • Operate as a SEAL team. A small, tight, multi-disciplinary unit with focus and urgency tasks are traded seamlessly to whoever is closest to the skills needed.
  • Make the product better. Partner with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings into durable platform capabilities not one-off scripts.
  • Drive adoption and lead the change. Mentor customer operators and guide their teams through solution transitions, so the new way of working actually sticks.

What we are looking for

  • AI & Agentic Development
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications RAG systems, multi-agent workflows, tool-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
  • Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns when to use single vs. multi-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.
  • Software Engineering
  • Solid, hands-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
  • Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Data Engineering & Platforms
  • Ability to build and maintain data pipelines ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
  • Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
  • Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real-world data in production environments.
  • Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)
    • Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus not a requirement
  • 2 – 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering, or a technical-founder role. Strong candidates at either end of that range are welcome to apply.

  • Prior exposure to customer-facing technical roles solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats is a strong signal, though not a requirement.

How to succeed in this role

  • You measure your own success in business outcomes efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements not lines of code shipped.
  • You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
  • You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end-to-end without requiring close supervision.
  • You are curious and pragmatic you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.
  • You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders written, verbal, and in the room.
  • You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours no waiting for perfect clarity.
  • You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver without being told.
  • Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
  • You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
  • Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric and you still ship.
  • You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
  • Ability to travel as required up to 50%

#Associate; #Intermediate #Senior

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at . This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior Director Business Development who will expand our existing client base in Europe. This role leads the sales strategy, manages the end-to-end sales process, and works closely with Operations to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and account success.

  • Actively prospects and leverages potential new business opportunities within specified Customer/Accounts.

  • Cultivates strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers with Account and develops deep knowledge of the Customer/Account organization.

  • Analyses potential opportunities and develops detailed business plans and sales strategies for each Customer/Account. Monitors actions and results against plans.

  • Identifies and responds to Customer/Account needs in order to define potential PSI opportunities. Ensures appropriate strategy/solution is proposed to Customer/Account.

  • Works with Operations to identify sales team and prepare presentation. Educates team participants in Customer/Account culture, operational needs/methods and sales techniques needed to close the sale.

  • Leads the entire sales process, including identifying the appropriate team for pitch and preparing and leading the sales presentation.

  • Coordinates with the Proposal Development Group to develop proposal and Operations to finalize strategy and pricing.

  • Handles follow-up related to the sales and facilitates completion of contractual documents.

  • Ensures appropriate hand-off to project team by transferring knowledge on Customer/Account needs and expectations.

  • Shares Customer/Account strategies and sales plans with Project Directors/Managers.

  • Coordinates with Project Managers/Directors and Operations to escalate and quickly address Customer/Account issues/concerns.

  • Seeks input from Project Managers/Directors to proactively address Change in Scope, new opportunities or customer dissatisfaction

  • Works with Project Manager/Director and Operations to ensure Changes in Scope (CIS’s) are appropriately negotiated with the Customer/Account.

  • Maintains high visibility within Customer/Account organization.

  • Monitors Customer satisfaction through regular formal and informal surveys.

  • Coordinates with Project Managers/Directors to ensure Customer/Account needs are being met and address concerns/issues in a timely manner.

  • Bachelor's degree in Health Science or equivalent professional qualifications combining education, training, and relevant experience

  • Minimum 5-8 years of business development experience with demonstrated success in Contract Research Organizations or healthcare service providers

  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce

  • Demonstrated excellence in strategic communication, cross-functional collaboration, analytical problem-solving, and organizational management

  • Full professional proficiency in English

  • Willingness and ability to travel as required for business development activities

Why join PSI?

  • Established global CRO with a strong reputation for high client retention and long-term partnerships
  • Collaborative, relationship-driven culture focused on sustainable client success
  • Supportive and stable environment with one of the industry’s lowest staff turnover rates
  • Clear and structured career development pathways to support long-term growth

We are the company that cares – for our staff, for our clients, for our partners and for the quality of the work we do. A dynamic, global company founded in 1995, we bring together 3000 driven, dedicated and passionate individuals. We work on the frontline of medical science, changing lives, and bringing new medicines to those who need them.

PSI’s business is about conducting clinical research of novel medications. We work at the interface of R&D, pharmaceutical industry and healthcare science and provide services to big and mid-sized pharmaceutical companies. We help our clients to generate data about safety and efficacy of medications and bring the best ones to market. By conducting global clinical research trials, PSI makes cutting-edge treatment available in drugstores all over the world and helps patients with serious medical conditions to improve or even save their life. Help us to make sure that PSI medical and business documents are clear to patients, physicians, regulatory authorities, and clients.

We offer an inspiring story of the company that has grown organically from a handful of countries to global presence. PSI is a mature company with standards and practices, but we do not stand still. Every day, there is a figurative Everest to climb, and you will not get bored here.

Sales Associate – (Sales Development)

Sales Development | Prospecting | Pipeline Creation Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: Remote

Why This Role Stands Out:

Entry point into a sales career path with the career growth opportunity toward Media Specialist or Account Executive roles.

Hands-on experience building prospect pipelines, generating leads, and creating qualified sales opportunities.

Opportunity to partner directly with Sales Leaders, Account Executives, Media Specialists, Account Coordinators, and business partners.

Structured learning through coaching, training, role-playing, and professional development.

Exposure to digital marketing solutions, customer engagement, CRM tools, and consultative sales processes.

Opportunity to support open sales territories and contribute to pipeline health and future revenue growth.

Remote flexibility.

About LocaliQ At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.  You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth. About the Role Our Sales Associate role is similar to a Sales Development Representative and is an entry point into the LocaliQ sales career path for someone who is energized by prospecting, building pipeline, creating new sales opportunities, and learning how to grow into a future sales role. In this role, you will focus on generating top-of-funnel sales activity, identifying new prospects, supporting open sales territories, and helping create qualified opportunities for the sales organization. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leaders, Account Executives, Media Specialists, Account Coordinators, and other business partners to help drive prospect engagement, secure qualified meetings, and support business development efforts that contribute to future revenue growth. This role is designed for someone who wants to build strong sales fundamentals through daily prospecting, customer engagement, market research, Salesforce activity management, and structured coaching. You’ll gain hands-on experience in how LocaliQ supports businesses, develops prospects, and creates meaningful customer conversations that lead to long-term sales opportunities. In your first 90 days, you’ll begin learning LocaliQ’s solutions, sales tools, prospecting approach, CRM expectations, and lead qualification process. You’ll build confidence in outbound outreach, customer communication, territory support, and opportunity handoff while developing the habits and skills needed for long-term growth in a sales career. What You Will Do

Build and maintain prospect lists using Salesforce, market research, industry resources, business intelligence tools, and other lead-generation sources.

Conduct outbound prospecting through phone calls, email campaigns, social selling, referrals, and other outreach channels to identify potential customers and create sales opportunities.

Secure qualified customer meetings and discovery conversations for Account Executives and sales teams.

Develop and execute daily prospecting plans designed to achieve activity, meeting, and opportunity creation goals.

Support open sales territories and transitional account assignments through prospecting, business development, and customer outreach.

Maintain accurate prospect, activity, opportunity, and pipeline information in Salesforce and other sales systems.

Research prospects, industries, customer needs, and competitive information to support sales strategy and customer engagement.

Conduct basic qualification and needs assessment conversations to determine customer fit and opportunity potential.

Ensure qualified opportunities are documented and transitioned effectively to Account Executives for continued sales engagement.

Collaborate with Account Executives, Sales Managers, Account Coordinators, Client Solutions, vertical specialists, and other internal partners to support territory growth and customer acquisition efforts.

Represent LocaliQ professionally while building relationships with prospective customers and business decision-makers.

Actively participate in coaching, training, role-playing, and professional development activities designed to prepare you for future sales advancement opportunities.

Qualifications

2+ years of customer service, account support, administrative, sales support, operations, or related experience preferred. Associate degree preferred; a comparable combination of education, experience, and/or training may be considered.

Experience working in a deadline-driven environment preferred.

Experience using CRM systems such as Salesforce preferred.

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Strong customer service orientation and professional communication skills.

Process-driven, accountable, and comfortable following established sales and lead management processes.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

Ability to adapt to change and support organizational transformation initiatives.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, email, Salesforce, and other sales or business systems.

Who Thrives Here High performers in this role are curious, organized, resilient, and highly accountable. They enjoy connecting with people, asking thoughtful questions, learning new tools and processes, and building strong daily sales habits. They are comfortable with outbound outreach, motivated by activity and progress, and able to stay focused in a deadline-driven environment. They are also strong collaborators who communicate clearly, follow through on details, and take ownership of how their work contributes to the broader sales organization. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build a foundation in sales, learn from experienced leaders, and grow into future opportunities within LocaliQ. Benefits We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

High-performance culture with recognition and Career progression opportunities

Flexibility remote work environment Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

PTO time off, including paid holidays

401(k) with company match

Structured onboarding to help you build confidence quickly

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

This is an opportunity to build your sales career from the ground up while contributing to meaningful pipeline growth, customer engagement, and future revenue opportunities. If you’re motivated, coachable, organized, and ready to learn the fundamentals of business development and digital marketing sales, we encourage you to apply. The hourly rate for this role will range between $21.63/hr – $24.04/hr.  Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

raw.description:
Wir sind cinify – ein junges, KI-getriebenes Start-up, das das Gesundheitswesen datenintelligent macht. Wir verbinden Praxisverwaltungs-, Radiologie- und Terminsysteme, führen ihre Daten zusammen und machen daraus Dashboards, Reports und zunehmend KI-gestützte Anwendungen, die Praxen und Radiologiezentren wirklich weiterbringen.

Wir denken AI-first. Ein Großteil unseres Codes, unserer SQL-Queries und Dashboards entsteht heute schon mit KI, und genau so wollen wir weiterwachsen. Wir suchen Menschen, die KI nicht als Spielerei sehen, sondern als selbstverständliches Werkzeug, mit dem sie schneller, besser und kreativer arbeiten.

In deiner Rolle arbeitest du eng mit Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen zusammen, nimmst ihre Anforderungen auf und entwickelst mit SQL und KI maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Dabei bist du nicht nur technischer Umsetzer, sondern auch Projektmanager, der seine Projekte eigenständig organisiert und zum Erfolg führt.

Tipp: Auf unserer Webseite unter „Jobs“ findest du ein kurzes Video, in dem unsere Data Analysts von ihrem Job erzählen. Schau gern vorbei!

Aufgaben

Als Data-Analyst bei cinify ist es Deine Aufgabe, komplexe Sachverhalte möglichst greifbar und verständlich für unsere Kunden aufzubereiten.

  • Du stehst im direkten Kundenkontakt, berätst und setzt Anforderungen direkt um.

  • Du baust Dashboards, Reports und Workflows und nutzt dafür konsequent KI-Tools, um vom Datenmodell bis zum fertigen Dashboard schneller ans Ziel zu kommen.

  • Du integrierst, validierst und optimierst Daten aus unterschiedlichsten Quellsystemen.

  • Du entwickelst unser Produkt aktiv weiter, inklusive neuer KI-Anwendungen für unsere Kunden.

  • Du arbeitest im Team an Standardlösungen für den Gesundheitsmarkt und hilfst dabei, unsere AI-first-Arbeitsweise stetig zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, bringst Du folgende Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium und/oder erste Berufserfahrung im kaufmännischen oder IT-Bereich

  • Routinierter Umgang mit SQL

  • Erfahrung mit BI-Lösungen wie Power BI, Qlik oder Tableau

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) und Lust, deinen Arbeitsalltag damit neu zu denken

  • Datenaffinität und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten zu verstehen und ansprechend zu visualisieren

  • Selbstständigkeit und den Antrieb, unser Produkt immer besser zu machen

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Remote-first

  • Falls gewünscht EGYM-Wellpass und Corporate Benefits

  • Mitwirken bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer innovativen BI-Lösung

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Engagiertes, modernes und kreatives Arbeitsumfeld in einem aufstrebenden Start-up

  • ca. 1x im Quartal Team-Events (unsere letzten Team-Events: Weihnachtsmarkt, Escape-Room, VIP-Lounge Basketball Alba Berlin, Spielshow, Beachvolleyball)

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss

Standort:

Unser Büro ist in Bochum. Der Großteil des Teams ist aber Deutschlandweit aktiv. Unter anderem: Berlin, München, Stuttgart, Frankfurt und Düsseldorf.

Teamwork:

Unser Teamgeist ist uns besonders wichtig. Wir legen viel Wert auf gegenseitige Unterstützung und offene Kommunikation. Eine offene Fehlerkultur gehört bei uns dazu – wir lernen aus Fehlern und wachsen gemeinsam daran. Wir sind kein Konzern mit starren Strukturen, sondern ein dynamisches Start-up, bei dem du direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens hast. Du gestaltest den Weg von cinify aktiv mit und siehst, wie deine Arbeit echten Impact hat. Wenn du eine Umgebung suchst, in der dein Beitrag zählt und du gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchtest, dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Ablauf der Bewerbung:

  1. SQL-Test: Im ersten Schritt bekommst du von uns einen kurzen SQL-Test, da wir solide SQL-Grundlagen voraussetzen.

  2. Gespräche: Danach führst du voraussichtlich zwei Gespräche mit unseren Gründern und aktuellen Data Analysts, in denen wir gemeinsam herausfinden, ob cinify und du ein Match seid.

Bock drauf?

Wenn du richtig Bock hast, ein Teil unseres Teams zu werden, dann schick uns eine Bewebung!

Wir wissen, dass es immer schwierig ist, sich von einem Unternehmen zu überzeugen, wenn man es noch nie gesehen hat. Schau doch mal auf unserer LinkedIn-Seite vorbei, um etwas über uns zu erfahren. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn Du uns über die Fragen in dem Bewerbungsformular oder in einem Anschreiben erzählst, was Dich an cinify interessiert, wie du KI heute schon in deiner Arbeit einsetzt und warum Du Dich bei uns bewerben möchtest.

title: Head of Payments & Payment Strategy

raw.title: Head of Payments & Payment Strategy
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Head of Payments who has run payments from the merchant's seat.
raw.description:
We are looking for a Head of Payments who has run payments from the merchant's seat. You have owned checkout, billing and fraud for a global online business, and you were accountable for the revenue those decisions produced.

You will own how our customers pay in every market we sell in: what the payment page looks like, which methods and currencies it offers by region, how transactions are routed and retried, and where we set the line on fraud. Success is measured in checkout conversion, approval rates, recovered revenue, fraud losses and cost per transaction.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will be in the data every day, finding where approvals drop or customers abandon, and fixing it with Product, Engineering, Finance and Risk.
You will work closely with CentroBill, our internal billing and acquiring arm. CentroBill provides the gateway, acquiring relationships and payment method coverage. You are its merchant-side counterpart: you set the requirements, review performance together and push for the routing, coverage and commercial terms the business needs.

About Us

Centro is an international product company with over 20 years of expertise in product development, affiliate marketing and online technologies. Our team of 300+ professionals across Europe and North America builds products used by millions of users worldwide.

What You Will Manage Daily

  • Checkout conversion by market, device, traffic source and product, from payment page load to successful charge.
  • Approval and decline rates by region, acquirer, card type and issuer, split by initial sales, trial conversions, upsells and renewals.
  • Decline reason codes, and the routing, cascading and retry rules that respond to them.
  • Payment method and currency mix in each region, so customers see the options they trust and expect locally.
  • Fraud rules and 3DS settings, watching false declines as closely as fraud losses.
  • Chargebacks, pre-dispute alerts and refunds, tracked against card scheme monitoring thresholds.
  • Recurring billing health: renewal success, failed rebills, retry schedules and involuntary churn.
  • CentroBill and provider performance: uptime, incidents, cost and the fallback when something underperforms.

Key Responsibilities

Checkout and payment page optimization

  • Own the payment page experience across web and mobile: layout, form fields, method ordering, error messaging and localization.
  • Add and tune express checkout options such as Apple Pay and Google Pay where they lift conversion.
  • Run a continuous testing program on checkout flows and report results in conversion and revenue terms.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to prioritize and ship checkout and billing improvements.

Regional payment strategy

  • Decide which cards, wallets, bank transfers and local payment methods to offer in each market, based on customer behavior and unit economics.
  • Set currency, pricing presentation and local acquiring strategy by region to lift approval rates and reduce cross-border costs.
  • Launch payments in new markets and retire methods that do not earn their place.

Authorization and revenue optimization

  • Drive improvements in authorization rates, payment conversion and transaction success rates.
  • Own payment routing, cascading and retry logic across providers.
  • Identify revenue leakage and fix it: soft declines, failed renewals, abandoned payments and avoidable fees.

Subscription and recurring billing

  • Improve trial-to-paid conversion and renewal success rates.
  • Optimize rebill timing, retry schedules, card updater and network token usage, and dunning communication.
  • Reduce involuntary churn and raise payment recovery rates.

Fraud, risk and chargebacks

  • Set fraud rules and 3DS strategy by region, balancing acceptance, fraud exposure and customer experience.
  • Oversee chargeback prevention, pre-dispute alerts, dispute handling and win rates with Risk and Compliance.
  • Keep dispute and fraud ratios within card scheme monitoring program thresholds across every merchant account.
  • Keep checkout and billing flows compliant with card scheme rules, PCI DSS and PSD2.

CentroBill partnership and provider management

  • Act as the business's primary partner to CentroBill, our internal billing and acquiring arm, representing merchant-side needs in its roadmap and priorities.
  • Source and bring forward new acquirers where they improve coverage, approvals or cost. CentroBill is the primary partner, and you are free to go outside it when another acquirer serves the business better. Work with CentroBill on merchant account structure, routing and payment method coverage in each region.
  • Run regular performance reviews with CentroBill on approvals, declines, chargebacks, uptime and cost, and agree the actions that follow.
  • Select and manage any third-party fraud, dispute and checkout vendors the business uses.
  • Own the merchant-side payment roadmap and total cost of payments.

Leadership and reporting

  • Define payment KPIs, build the dashboards that track them and review performance daily.
  • Build and lead the payments team as the function grows.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance and Risk on payment initiatives.
  • Bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to senior leadership.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in digital payments, with a substantial part of that spent merchant-side at an international e-commerce, subscription or digital goods business.
  • Direct ownership of checkout and payment page performance, with before-and-after numbers you can walk us through on conversion, approval, renewal or recovery rates.
  • Experience building payment strategy by region: local payment methods, wallets, currencies, local acquiring and regulatory requirements such as SCA and 3DS.
  • Deep understanding of recurring billing, trial and subscription payments, payment recovery, routing and cascading.
  • Hands-on experience setting fraud rules and managing chargebacks, pre-dispute alerts and card scheme monitoring programs, including the trade-off between fraud losses and false declines.
  • Experience sourcing acquirers and running multiple merchant accounts across them, and working with a gateway or acquiring partner as a demanding, constructive merchant.
  • Self-sufficient in data: you pull and analyze transaction-level data yourself and turn findings into measurable results.
  • Experience with high-risk industries, subscription-based businesses or complex online merchant environments.
  • Strong commercial judgment and stakeholder management across Product, Engineering, Finance and Risk.

Why Work With Us

  • Competitive salary that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Growth and development, with support for your professional development.
  • High level of autonomy, ownership and accountability.
  • No bureaucracy or micromanagement. We value autonomy and initiative.
  • Educational programs to expand your knowledge and skills.
  • Team-building activities and opportunities to attend industry events.
  • Paid holidays, vacation, personal days and sick leave.

Who We Are

Jolera offers MSPs & IT solution providers next-generation managed services, enabling them to create world-class experiences for their clients. Our award-winning solutions are built on over 20 years of experience servicing businesses worldwide. We've transformed hundreds of MSPs & solution providers globally through our collection of tenured experts, delivering an elevated managed service experience tailored to each partner's unique business needs.

Who You Are

We are looking for a Senior ServiceNow Consultant who is far more than a platform administrator. This is a strategic, customer-facing role that sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, hands-on development, and trusted advisory. You will serve as a subject matter expert (SME) across the full ServiceNow platform, owning complex implementations, guiding enterprise clients, and delivering solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

This role is ideally suited for a seasoned professional with a background in MSP or GSI environments who thrives in a fast-paced, multi-customer setting and can seamlessly shift between technical solutioning, platform development, and executive-level stakeholder engagement.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Platform Strategy & Advisory

  • Act as the primary ServiceNow SME and trusted advisor for internal teams and external enterprise clients
  • Lead platform strategy conversations, translating complex business challenges into scalable ServiceNow solutions
  • Conduct platform health assessments, maturity reviews, and roadmap planning sessions with customers
  • Drive adoption of ServiceNow best practices and governance standards across all engagements
  • Present technical architectures, recommendations, and project outcomes to executive and C-suite stakeholders

Consulting & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as the face of ServiceNow expertise in pre-sales, discovery, and ongoing delivery engagements
  • Facilitate workshops, requirements-gathering sessions, and solution design discussions with customers
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a long-term strategic partner rather than a transactional vendor
  • Provide proactive guidance on platform capabilities, upcoming releases, and opportunities for expansion

Development & Technical Delivery

  • Architect, develop, and deliver enterprise-grade ServiceNow solutions, including:
  • Complex Business Rules, Client Scripts, and Script Includes
  • Flow Designer and IntegrationHub workflows and spokes
  • Custom applications and scoped app development
  • REST/SOAP API integrations with third-party platforms
  • Service Portal and UI Builder customizations
  • Lead end-to-end implementation projects from discovery through go-live and hypercare

Platform Administration & Operations

  • User, role, and access control management
  • Instance health, upgrades, patching, and performance optimization
  • Data management, import sets, and transform maps
  • Administer and support the ServiceNow TPSM (Third-Party Service Management) instance with an emphasis on Domain Separation and multi-tenant configurations
  • Ensure platform security, compliance, and alignment with ServiceNow architectural best practices
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation including solution designs, runbooks, and operational standards

ITSM & TPSM Excellence

  • Configure and optimize core ITSM processes: Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request, and Knowledge Management
  • Design and maintain domain-separated workflows and data models in a multi-tenant TPSM environment
  • Support integration points and service lifecycle processes specific to the TPSM/MSP delivery model
  • Ensure alignment between platform configuration and contracted service delivery obligations

Team Leadership & Partner Coordination

  • Mentor junior administrators and developers, fostering a culture of learning and technical excellence
  • Define technical requirements, review deliverables, and ensure quality standards are met when coordinating with third-party ServiceNow development partners
  • Collaborate with internal product, delivery, and onboarding teams to align platform capabilities with business strategy
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases, playbooks, and delivery accelerators

Required

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience spanning both administration and development
  • Demonstrated track record as a customer-facing consultant or technical lead in an MSP, GSI, or service provider environment
  • Expert-level proficiency in ServiceNow development: JavaScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP APIs
  • Deep experience with Domain Separation and multi-tenant architecture in a TPSM or similar environment
  • Strong command of ITSM modules: Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management
  • Experience leading full-lifecycle ServiceNow implementations from requirements through go-live
  • Proven ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical executive audiences
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset

Certifications (Required)

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

Certifications (Strongly Preferred)

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) — ITSM, HRSD, CSM, or equivalent
  • ServiceNow Certified Technology Architect (CTA)
  • ITIL Foundation v4 or higher

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with ServiceNow Now Assist / AI capabilities and the Now Platform AI roadmap
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum project delivery models
  • Experience contributing to pre-sales, solution scoping, and effort estimation
  • Exposure to complementary platforms (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Salesforce, Microsoft 365) and integration patterns

Core Competencies

Technical Excellence

  • Deep ServiceNow platform and architecture knowledge
  • Strong JavaScript and scripting fundamentals
  • Integration design and API proficiency

Customer & Communication

  • Executive-level stakeholder communication
  • Trusted advisor mindset and relationship building
  • Workshop facilitation and requirements gathering

Delivery & Leadership

  • End-to-end project ownership and accountability
  • Ability to mentor and elevate junior team members
  • Agile delivery and iterative problem-solving

MSP / Multi-Tenant Acumen

  • Domain Separation and multi-tenancy expertise
  • Managing competing priorities across client accounts
  • Service delivery and SLA adherence in MSP contexts

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package
  • Company perks including GoodLife gym membership and brand partner discounts
  • Company events, recognitions, and team celebrations
  • Meaningful career development, certifications support, and growth opportunities within Jolera’s expanding platform practice

At Jolera, we are committed to creating a diverse, equal and inclusive. Our goal is to attract and retain the best talent while embracing diversity in all its forms. We value and respect differences in ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.excerpt: Bluebird Auto Rental Systems builds cloud car rental management software for rental operators, dealership loaner fleets, franchises and airport locations.
raw.description:
Bluebird Auto Rental Systems builds cloud car rental management software for rental operators, dealership loaner fleets, franchises and airport locations. It has a cloud-based rental software used by more than 1,000 operators across 70+ countries. It runs the full rental workflow in one system: reservations, rental agreements, e-signature, rate management, counter operations, fleet, payments and claims. Customers range from dealership loaner fleets and airport counters to franchise, regional, corporate, truck rental and luxury operators. Bluebird is headquartered in New Jersey.

Aspire Software is the operating group of Valsoft Corporation, the Montreal-based company founded in 2015 that buys and grows vertical market software businesses. Aspire runs Valsoft's portfolio of more than 100 companies, with over 3,000 employees in 20+ countries. Each business keeps its own leadership and gets Aspire's resources, support and expertise to grow long term. Car rental is a core vertical: Aspire operates Valsoft's car rental software portfolio and keeps investing in innovation and digital tools for the industry.

Role overview

As Account Manager, you own the customer relationship for a portfolio of 200 named accounts and are accountable for keeping and growing them. You will be the trusted advisor each customer turns to, working alongside Customer Success and Support to deliver an excellent client experience.

You will learn how each account's systems perform today and where its business is headed. You will then align Bluebird's new AI tools and software capabilities to those goals, driving renewals and expansion.

Key responsibilities

Own the customer relationship

  • Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for 200 named accounts, building relationships with decision-makers, users and executive sponsors.
  • Build and maintain account plans that capture each customer's goals, stakeholders, risks and growth opportunities.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with each client to report on value delivered, system performance and the roadmap ahead.
  • Support and attend relevant industry and client events to strengthen relationships and represent Bluebird.

Drive retention and renewals

  • Manage the full renewal cycle for your portfolio, from early forecasting through negotiation and signature.
  • Spot churn risk early using usage data, support trends and customer sentiment, and lead recovery plans with Customer Success.
  • Maintain all renewal and expansion forecasts, and log every client engagement, in HubSpot CRM so records stay accurate and current.

Grow the portfolio

  • Become an expert on the functionality and value proposition of RentWorks Plus and all relevant modules.
  • Run discovery calls to uncover upsell and cross-sell opportunities, then close them, including added users or locations and new modules.
  • Introduce Bluebird's new AI tools and software capabilities where they solve a clear customer problem or advance a business objective.
  • Build a healthy expansion pipeline and move opportunities through it with discipline.

Understand the customer's business

  • Assess each account's current system performance, adoption and pain points.
  • Learn each customer's growth plans and business objectives, and map Bluebird solutions to them.
  • Bring customer feedback to Product and leadership to shape the roadmap.

Deliver an excellent client experience

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and Support to resolve issues quickly and keep customers informed.
  • Coordinate internal resources so the customer sees one joined-up Bluebird team.

How success is measured

Your performance is measured primarily on renewal rate and expansion sales across your portfolio. Key measures:

  • Renewal rate
  • New revenue from upsell, cross-sell, and adoption of AI tools and new capabilities
  • Renewal and expansion forecasts versus actual results
  • QBRs and account plans completed across the portfolio
  • Satisfaction and health scores, shared with Customer Success

Who you are

  • A natural customer advocate who champions the client's interests inside Bluebird.
  • Curious and eager to learn, drawn to exploring and solving hard challenges.
  • An insatiable appetite for growth, matched by a will to win.

Required qualifications

  • 3+ years in account management, customer-facing sales or a similar role at a B2B software or SaaS company.
  • A track record of retaining and growing customers, including turning around at-risk accounts.
  • Commercial sense: you spot an upsell or a renewal risk without being prompted, and you are comfortable negotiating.
  • Experience managing a large portfolio of accounts and prioritizing time across them.
  • Ability to understand how a rental operator makes money, and to talk credibly about revenue, costs and ROI.
  • The desire to become an expert in car and commercial truck rental workflows, from reservations and rental agreements to inventory and fleet management, across both retail and commercial sectors.
  • Ability to present application functionality and deliver complete software demonstrations.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills, including with senior executives.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM or a similar CRM, using data to forecast and manage a pipeline.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling or positioning AI-enabled software or automation tools.
  • Experience in the automotive rental industry.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, technology or a related field, or equivalent experience.

The Director of Product Management for Innovation Squads is accountable for leading discovery efforts to identify and validate internal productivity opportunities, defining product management standards, and managing Product Managers who must both discover the right problems and execute solutions rapidly across cross-functional Innovation Squads aligned to key business functions.


The role exists to ensure squads are solving the right internal productivity problems and delivering solutions at pace by bringing structured discovery discipline, workflow analysis, and outcome-oriented execution to GenAI, automation, and emerging technology initiatives that improve how employees work. This is a senior operating role that bridges strategy and execution, ensuring innovation investments deliver measurable operational efficiency gains quickly and sustainably.


Responsibilities

  • Ways of working. Design and implement the product operating model and ways of working for Innovation Squads with the Technology Director, and drive adoption across functions, geographies, and competing priorities.
  • Change leadership. Lead change management for squad practices, GenAI adoption, and new workflows, so solutions are adopted and sustained, not just shipped.
  • Thought leadership. Set the organization's point of view, guardrails, and priorities for GenAI in internal productivity, and represent the squads to executives and across the enterprise.
  • Discovery and delivery. Lead discovery and execution for efficiency opportunities, from workflow analysis through validation to production deployment.
  • People. Manage, coach, and develop Product Managers in workflow mapping, rapid prototyping, stakeholder management, and change leadership.
  • Roadmaps. Turn discovery findings into prioritized roadmaps tied to faster cycle times, less manual work, better quality, and improved employee experience.
  • Measurement. Define and track adoption, time savings, quality, employee satisfaction, and speed to value with squad leads, finance, and business stakeholders.
  • Partnerships. Build partnerships with operational leaders, process owners, enablement teams, and governance, risk, security, and legal stakeholders on responsible GenAI use.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous product management experience, including hands-on ownership of products or solutions and direct management of Product Managers.
  • Demonstrated expertise in change management and implementing new ways of working across a large, matrixed organization, with evidence of sustained adoption.
  • Established thought leadership in GenAI and innovation: a clear point of view, internal or external visibility, and a record of applying GenAI to real operational use cases.
  • Experience leading discovery and delivery for internal or operational products, measured by adoption and efficiency impact.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

Key Competencies

  • Change leadership and ways of working. Has introduced and scaled operating models and standards across multiple functions and leadership layers; applies a structured change approach and measures adoption; navigates matrix dynamics.
  • GenAI and innovation. Articulates a practical view of GenAI value, limits, and risks; knows which workflows warrant AI investment and can explain why to executives; stays ahead of a fast-moving landscape.
  • Product management. Strong in discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, workflow mapping, and rapid prototyping; balances rigor with speed.

You will primarily be reaching out to nursing home owners and key decision-makers to introduce the business, generate interest and arrange meetings for the sales team.

You will not be responsible for closing sales. Instead, your main focus will be getting conversations started, identifying potential opportunities and booking qualified meetings.

No previous experience is required. We are looking for someone with the right personality, confidence, communication skills and willingness to learn..


Interested? Check out the steps below:




➡️ Click here to complete your video

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Outbound Calling & Lead Generation

  • Make a high volume of outbound calls to prospective clients.

  • Cold call nursing home owners and key decision-makers.

  • Introduce the business and generate interest in its services.

  • Identify potential business opportunities and suitable leads.
