  • Conduct outbound email campaigns to prospective clients.

  • Identify and contact relevant nursing home owners and decision-makers.

  • Write professional and engaging outreach emails.

  • Follow up with prospective clients to encourage engagement.

  • Maintain consistent communication with potential leads.

3. Appointment Setting & Business Development Support

  • Identify interested prospects and arrange meetings for the sales team.

  • Schedule appointments with relevant decision-makers.

  • Ensure meetings are booked with suitable potential clients.

  • Pass on relevant information and notes to the sales team.

  • Follow up on outstanding leads and opportunities.

4. Lead Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate records of calls, emails and interactions.

  • Track lead progress and follow-up activities.

  • Keep prospect information updated.

  • Meet daily and weekly outreach targets.

  • Provide regular updates on lead generation activities and results.

Minimum Requirements

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

  • Confident and comfortable speaking to new people.

  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

  • Willingness to make cold calls and approach prospective clients.

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

  • Good organisational and time-management abilities.

  • Self-motivated, driven and target-oriented.

  • Comfortable using email and basic computer systems.

  • Ability to follow up consistently and work independently.

Previous experience is not required. Candidates from customer service, call centres, sales, hospitality or other customer-facing environments are welcome to apply.

Preferred Personality Traits

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Outgoing: Naturally enjoys speaking to people and starting conversations.

  • Confident: Comfortable approaching business owners and senior decision-makers.

  • Self-motivated: Takes initiative and does not need constant supervision.

  • Driven: Motivated by targets, activity levels and generating results.

  • Persuasive: Can create interest and engage prospects without being pushy.

  • Resilient: Comfortable handling rejection and moving on to the next opportunity.

  • Professional: Represents the business positively through calls and emails.

  • Proactive: Consistently follows up and looks for new opportunities.

Key Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be measured on:

  • Daily outbound call activity.

  • Number of prospective clients contacted.

  • Email outreach activity.

  • Number of leads generated.

  • Number of qualified meetings booked.

  • Consistency of follow-ups.

  • Accuracy of lead tracking and reporting.

Important Notes

  • This is an outbound lead generation role, not an Executive Assistant position.

  • The role focuses on generating leads and booking meetings, not closing sales.

  • Candidates must be comfortable with cold calling and handling rejection.

  • No previous sales or lead generation experience is essential, provided the candidate has the right personality and communication skills.

raw.excerpt: ★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★ AI-First Growth Marketer Location: Remote – Chile Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
raw.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

AI-First Growth Marketer

Location: Remote – Chile

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Financial Services / Private Lending / Real Estate Financing

Compensation: $2,500–$3,000 USD/month

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:45 AM–5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

English Proficiency: C1+ (written and spoken)

Start Date: Before December 31, 2026

About the Role

We are hiring an AI-First Growth Marketer for a U.S.-based private direct lender that funds business-purpose real estate loans nationwide, including fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction and DSCR rental loans across a wide range of loan sizes. The company markets to two audiences: real estate investors who borrow and loan brokers who refer deals.

As the company's first dedicated marketing hire, you will own the function end to end. You write a short, data-backed plan, a company partner approves it, and you build and ship it yourself. Over time, you will run marketing entirely, reporting directly to a partner.

Above all, we are looking for an AI power user backed by real marketing experience. You use Claude and other AI tools every day to research, build, automate and produce work, and your experience tells you where to aim them. Where you lack depth, you learn fast with AI or direct and check a specialist; outside help is the exception.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Be the first marketing hire and build the function your way, with a clear path to running all of marketing

  • Spend your time building: CRM workflows, live dashboards, SEO content, community engagement and PR, not decks or long strategy documents

  • Freedom to test better tools and drop anything that isn't earning its cost

  • A direct line between your work and qualified leads, broker sign-ups and funded loans

What You'll Do

CRM, Email & SMS Automation (top priority)

  • Build GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, lead routing, nurture sequences and a recurring newsletter for borrowers and brokers

  • Create segments such as borrowers by loan type, experience and state, and brokers by deal volume

  • Clean data safely, with backups and test runs before any bulk change

Tracking, Attribution & Live Reporting

  • Capture first- and last-touch source from WordPress (Gravity Forms) into the CRM without either being overwritten

  • Own UTMs, Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Microsoft Clarity

  • Build live dashboards on lead quality, AI mentions, traffic, form submissions, broker sign-ups, referral sources and funded loans; no manual reports

SEO, AEO, Website & PR

  • Run keyword research; write and optimize product, blog and state pages; manage internal linking and schema in WordPress

  • Earn citations in ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and emerging AI agents, and keep business listings consistent

  • Build lead magnets and A/B test landing pages, starting with the application and broker pages

  • Build backlinks at scale and source, pitch and write PR, feature and guest post placements

Social Media & Community

  • Share helpful, non-spammy content on LinkedIn, BiggerPockets, Reddit, Quora, investor forums and Facebook groups from a monthly calendar

  • Lightly manage the existing reviews setup

AI Content & Sales Enablement

  • Produce emails, landing pages, graphics, direct mail, one-pagers, term sheets, case studies and broker kits with AI

  • Maintain the brand guidelines and prompts the AI follows, and turn each funded deal into multiple content formats

  • Check all output for accuracy, loan terms and brand voice before it goes out

Data, Direct Mail, Automation & Paid Ads

  • Build targeted lists and enrich the CRM with data enrichment providers, and run hyper-personalized, measured direct mail campaigns

  • Replace manual work with automation and AI through Make.com, Zapier and GoHighLevel's AI tools

  • Later, once baselines exist, own paid ads (likely through GoHighLevel), including cost per lead and lead quality by channel

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • AI power user first: heavy daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or similar, with AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built yourself

  • 3+ years as the only or second marketer at a small company or startup, covering several channels long term

  • Hands-on CRM automation (GoHighLevel ideal; HubSpot or ActiveCampaign also count)

  • Make.com, Zapier or n8n, with enough understanding of APIs and webhooks to troubleshoot

  • GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTMs and attribution, including live dashboards used by leadership

  • SEO work with measurable results, plus working knowledge of AEO and WordPress

  • Proven growth of a brand on social media and in online communities

  • Ability to produce creatives and sales materials with AI tools and Canva

  • Track record of finding, testing and rolling out new marketing tools with results that justified them

  • Strong data sense to catch errors in AI output and data; self-directed without a playbook

  • C1+ English (written and spoken) and full, exclusive commitment during U.S. Eastern hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lending, real estate, fintech or B2B lead generation experience, including the ability to explain fix-and-flip, bridge and DSCR loans

  • Paid ads on Google or Meta, including through GoHighLevel

  • Direct mail campaign experience

  • Gravity Forms and WordPress-to-CRM integrations

  • Lightweight internal tools built with Claude Code or Cursor

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:

  • Concrete examples of AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built

  • Measurable results in SEO, lead generation and community growth

  • Technical fluency with CRM automation, attribution and integrations

  • Accuracy and judgment when reviewing AI output and data

  • Autonomy, speed of learning and clear communication in English

How Success Is Measured

  • By Day 14: Productive in the tools, with the first quick wins shipped.

  • By Day 30: CRM, website and tracking audited; a 6-month plan approved; at least 3 quick wins live.

  • By Day 90: First- and last-touch source captured on every new lead; a live baseline dashboard running; borrower and broker nurture plus a monthly newsletter in place.

  • By Day 180: Targets set for qualified leads and broker sign-ups; SEO/AEO program running; weekly community posting with leads tracked; at least one direct mail campaign tested.

  • After Month 6: Success is judged by growth in qualified borrower and broker leads and funded loans from marketing.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote, full-time role with a U.S.-based direct lender

  • Ownership of an entire marketing function, reporting directly to a company partner

  • Visible, measurable impact on company growth

Important Notes

  • This is a hands-on execution role: no decks, long strategy documents or waiting for direction

  • Advanced AI use is the core of this role, not a nice-to-have

  • Agency or freelance project work alone does not count toward the experience requirement

  • Lending experience is not required; learn the industry with AI and be productive by week two

  • No coding needed, but you must understand automations and APIs well enough to diagnose issues and direct AI

  • This is a full-time, exclusive position: no other clients, freelance work or side jobs

This is a remote/telecommute position.

By applying, you can choose to let Hire Emerald and its technology partners use your de-identified application materials to train AI matching models, as described in our Privacy Policy (). This is optional and does not affect whether we consider your application.

This is a hands-on specialist role combining analytics, customer research, experimentation and implementation. You will work with marketing, sales, operations and development to turn evidence into clearer pages and easier customer journeys.

What you will own • Map the journey from campaign or search visit through enquiry, registration, booking and purchase. Identify drop-off by device, channel, location and customer type.

• Validate analytics events and funnel definitions, reconcile reporting with business records and distinguish tracking failures from genuine customer friction.

• Use customer feedback, usability observations and appropriately permissioned session recordings to identify problems worth testing.

• Build and maintain a prioritized experiment backlog covering landing pages, messaging, calls to action, forms and mobile usability.

• Implement changes within approved publishing permissions and provide precise specifications and acceptance checks for developers when changes touch checkout or platform behavior.

• Design controlled tests with a clear primary metric, guardrails, audience, expected sample requirements and stopping rules. Use research and usability evidence when traffic cannot support a reliable experiment.

• Report outcomes transparently, including inconclusive or negative results, implementation costs and effects on revenue, lead quality, refunds or cancellations.

• Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, research synthesis and variant creation while verifying outputs and protecting customer information.

Requirements

What you bring Demonstrated ownership of website or ecommerce conversion improvements; practical analytics and tag-management experience; sound experimentation judgment; strong UX and conversion-copy instincts; and the ability to ship improvements with designers and developers. You can communicate findings clearly in English and show what you personally did.

Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and an experimentation or behavioral-analytics platform is valuable. Booking, registration, subscription or multi-location service experience is an advantage. Evidence of results matters more than a particular tool brand or job title.

Evidence of your work Provide two case studies describing the problem, baseline, hypothesis, your contribution, measurement method, sample size or traffic, result and limitations. Include an inconclusive or unsuccessful test if available. Redacted examples are welcome; do not share a previous employer’s confidential data.

Kapadi, a Humaneva Group company,is a full service CRO that focuses on complex oncology indications including immunotherapy and cellular therapies. As aSenior CRA, you will:

  • Perform monitoring and site management activities for Phase I-IV clinical research projects to assess the progress of clinical projects at assigned investigative/physician sites (either on site or remotely).
  • Serve as the primary liaison for project site personnel throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close out, including site identification and site start-up support.
  • Perform site evaluation, site initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out assessments (performed on-site or remotely), telephone assessments and central monitoring (performed remotely), and site management, ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP, and protocol compliance.

  • Support subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of oncology therapeutic area and early phase research design.
  • Demonstrated proficient computer skills and ability to embrace new technologies.

Customers

Action

About TJM Labs

TJM Labs builds Pharmacy AI: the AI agents hundreds of pharmacies rely on to handle the repetitive work that keeps pharmacists away from patients. Our platform handles prescription intake, data entry, refill management and patient calls. It works on top of the systems pharmacies already run, across 26+ pharmacy management systems and the portals and tools around them, so teams can take on more volume with the same staff. Today TJM Labs supports more than 550 pharmacies across the U.S. and Canada and automates over a million pharmacy tasks a day.

TJM Labs is built by pharmacists. Through our Dual-Expert Model™, pharmacists and engineers work side by side to design automation around the real workflows, systems and challenges pharmacies face every day.

We are a remote-first, high-growth organization united by a shared mission to help pharmacies scale without proportionally scaling their workforce. Our culture emphasizes direct impact, autonomy with responsibility, collaboration, practical problem-solving, continuous learning, and a commitment to healthcare. Team members have the opportunity to see their work make a meaningful difference in real pharmacies while contributing to technology that helps healthcare professionals focus on what matters most: their patients.

Requirements

About the Role

As our People Operations Generalist, you'll be the first stop partner for our employees on everything from workplace questions to leaves of absence. You'll own day-to-day functions, keep us compliant as our remote team grows across many U.S. states, and build the processes that help a fast-growing company run smoothly. You'll work closely with our VP of People Operations, Talent Acquisition and teams across the company.

This role is a great fit for someone who loves bringing order to fast-moving environments, treats every employee conversation with care, and wants to help shape how a mission-driven healthcare company scales its people operation function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run core people operations. Own employee lifecycle work such as onboarding, offboarding, employee changes and records, keeping our HR systems accurate and audit-ready.
  • Employee relations. Serve as a trusted first point of contact for employees and managers. Coach managers through performance, conduct and team concerns, and run fair, well-documented workplace investigations.
  • Help build our total rewards approach. Partner with the VP of People Operations to shape how we pay and reward our team, from compensation benchmarking and salary bands to benefits strategy and clear, consistent processes for offers, raises and annual reviews.
  • Own leave of absence administration. Manage leaves from first request to return to work, including FMLA, state family and medical leave programs, disability and accommodation requests. Keep employees informed and supported throughout.
  • Compliance. Partner with VP of People Operations to track and build policy around global federal and state employment law changes that affect our remote workforce. Responsible for maintaining required postings and notices, and support audits, policy updates and annual compliance work.
  • Partner on people programs. Support projects such as HR system rollouts, benefits enrollment, performance cycles and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Turn data into insight. Maintain clean employee data and pull reports that help leaders make informed decisions.

What you will bring

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as an HR or People Operations generalist, handling a broad range of employee questions on your own.
  • A track record of managing employee relations matters, including investigations, with sound judgment and discretion.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. employment law and multi-state compliance, including FMLA, ADA and state leave programs. Experience administering leaves of absence and accommodations from start to finish.
  • You've built or improved HR processes and documented them so others can follow them
  • Strong organization skills: you keep many moving pieces on track with accuracy and close attention to detail.
  • You communicate clearly, in writing and in person, with employees at every level.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a startup or high-growth company, where you helped build things from scratch
  • Experience supporting a remote workforce spread across many states
  • Familiarity with HR systems such as Rippling or BambooHR
  • Experience with global teams and compliance functions
  • An HR certification such as SHRM-CP or PHR

Benefits

Benefits

Remote-first collaborative work environment

Paid time off

401K with company match

Health Plan

The opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, pharmacy, and AI

Meaningful ownership and opportunity to grow as TJM Labs continues to scale

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world. With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research. *SUMMARY: **The Specialist, Site Contracts is responsible for the development preparation, negotiation, and finalization or assistance in preparation, negotiation, and finalization of Site Agreements, amendments or any other document associated between sponsors and clinical research sites.* *RESPONSIBILITIES:* _Tasks may include but are not limited to:_ Local negotiation: Prepare country contract templates; Draft and send Site Agreements or any contracts associated to sites to begin negotiations; Provide site contract execution planned timelines and site negotiation status; Send items for translation, if applicable. Receive and translate items; Reviewing study budgets and costs pertaining to contract negotiation; Negotiate contract(s) language and budget(s) with each assigned site to finalization / execution; Escalate to Site Contracts Lead site requests outside of preapproved parameters, to be forwarded to the Sponsor; Escalate risks and non-responsive sites to Site Contracts Lead or internal team, as applicable; If required to provide equipment to the sites, ensure appropriate information or appendix is added in Site Agreements or any document associated; Create donation agreement, as applicable; Review Site Agreements or any contracts associated for completeness and accuracy; Finalize contract and budget with sites; Perform quality check of Site Agreements or any documents associated before signature process starts; If requested, provide draft/signed contract/budget to the regulatory team for submission purpose, where needed; Liaising with Worldwide Legal Department, Data Privacy team, study teams, Sponsor, sites, investigators etc. Facilitate contracts signature by Worldwide, when applicable; Send Fully Executed Site Agreements or any document associated to: site, eTMF, payment team, Sponsor, post to internal Sharepoint, as applicable; Negotiate Site Agreements Amendment language and budget with sites; Create termination letter or any other type of documents related, and send to sites for signature, as applicable; Maintain tracking tool with live/real-time/regular updates for functional activities; Prioritizes effectively and responds to urgent requests within internal team or Sponsor. Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. *OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:* *Contract Negotiation:* Proficient in negotiating contract terms with clinical sites and vendors. Ability to identify and address contract issues and disputes efficiently. *Regulatory Compliance*: Good understanding of international and local regulatory require-ments for clinical trials (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH-GCP). Ensure all contracts comply with the latest regulations and guidelines. *Communication*: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective interac-tion with internal stakeholders and clinical sites. Ability to clearly explain contract terms and processes. Solid analytical skills to review and interpret contract terms and finan-cial data. Ability to identify risks and develop mitigation strategies. *Collaboration and Teamwork*: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including legal, finance, and clinical operations. Strong project management skills to handle multiple site contracts simultaneously. Ability to prioritize tasks, manage timelines, and ensure contract deliv-erables are met. *Technical Proficiency*: Proficiency in contract management software and tools. Strong problem-solving skills to address and resolve contract-related issues. Ability to think critically and strategically to overcome challenges. High level of accuracy in reviewing and drafting contracts. Ability to identify and correct discrepancies or potential issues in con-tract documentation. Understanding of budgeting and financial principles related to clinical trial contracts. Ability to negotiate cost-effective terms and manage financial aspects of contracts. Basic understanding of legal terminology and principles related to con-tracts. Ability to work closely with legal counsel to ensure all contracts meet legal and regulatory requirements. Strong time management skills to meet deadlines and manage the contract lifecycle efficiently. Ability to handle high volumes of work and work under pressure. *REQUIREMENTS:* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in business administration, finance, science or related field. 1 to 3 years of experience in Clinical Research Pharmaceutical or CRO industry working with investigator/site contracts or related legal field. Excellent verbal and written English language skills. Proficiency with MS Word, Excel and Outlook. Knowledge and understanding of ICH and GCP Guidelines, as well as local country legislation in the sphere of clinical trials and local regulatory requirements. Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently. raw.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Legal Compliance Organization (LCO) provides legal guidance to further KLA’s strategic objectives and protect and preserve the company's legal, ethical and financial integrity and reputation. Drawing on expertise in corporate law, commercial law, employment law, ethics and compliance, and intellectual property, the LCO offers strategic legal counsel that is informed by a clear understanding of the company’s business objectives and knowledge of the laws and regulations relevant to the business worldwide.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


The Senior Export Specialist is a key member of the Global Trade Compliance team responsible for ensuring compliant, efficient, and scalable import and export operations with a primary focus on U.S. export controls and export compliance, while supporting import compliance. This role is responsible for complex tariff classification, export control compliance activities, import compliance controls, analytics, audit support, process design, and cross-functional trade compliance initiatives. The position partners closely with Legal, Logistics, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, Product Management, Customs Brokers, and regional trade teams to standardize processes, improve data quality, implement automation opportunities, and maintain compliance with export control, sanctions, and customs regulations across global trade operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support ECCN determinations, export jurisdiction/classification reviews, and support HS/HTS classifications for semiconductor equipment, spare parts, components, electronics, software, and related technologies.
  • Review and validate broker filings, internal AES filings, customs documentation, customs values, country of origin declarations, and trade remedy applicability.
  • Support export control reviews, restricted party screening escalations, license requirement assessments / decrementing, license exception analysis, and voluntary disclosure evaluations, as needed.
  • Post-clearance reviews, disclosures, and compliance inquiries.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve trade compliance processes, controls, SOPs, and governance procedures.
  • Develop exception reporting, validation controls, systemic data feeds, and compliance monitoring metrics for ECCN, license determination/decrementing, restricted party screening, HTS, origin, and clearance data.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, compliance analytics, and exception reporting to monitor key trade compliance KPIs.
  • Identify operational and regulatory risks, and drive data-driven decision making. Partner closely with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and external service providers to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, and alignment with broker instructions, service level expectations, and established standard operating procedures.
  • Lead trade compliance projects, system enhancements, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Logistics teams, procurement, engineering, and manufacturing, logistics providers, customs brokers, to standardize global processes.
  • Support internal and external audits and conduct periodic reviews of trade compliance controls and records.
  • Monitor regulatory changes related to export controls, sanctions, customs, and trade remedies and present risk assessments and recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in International Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, Finance, Legal or related field.
  • Strong knowledge of EAR requirements, ECCN classification, export licensing concepts, restricted party screening, sanctions/embargo controls, and technology/software transfer considerations.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. Customs regulations, tariff classification, valuation, country of origin, and import documentation.
  • Experience responding to export control inquiries, customs audits, and regulatory inquiries.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Experience within semiconductor, electronics, advanced manufacturing, or other technology industries, especially environments involving controlled technology, software, encryption, or complex global supply chains.
  • LCB, CCS, CES, or similar certification preferred.
  • Experience with SAP GTS, SAP, ACE reporting, or trade management systems.
  • Experience designing controls, validations, automation solutions, and exception-based monitoring for export controls and import compliance.
  • Advanced Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
  • Advanced Excel skills including Power Query, Pivot Tables, and XLOOKUP.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into business actions.
  • Experience supporting workflow automation and digital transformation initiatives across export classification, screening, licensing, and import compliance processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

raw.title: Senior Manager/Assoc Dir, Product Marketing
raw.excerpt: The AutoVitals suite of SaaS products is designed to solve many of the current hurdles faced by auto repair shops.
raw.description:
The AutoVitals suite of SaaS products is designed to solve many of the current hurdles faced by auto repair shops. Our mission is to help auto repair shops drive profitable growth by attracting new customers, delivering superior communication and customer service, increasing shop efficiency, and raising average repair orders.

We are building product marketing as a dedicated function for the first time and looking for someone to own it and build it. This role takes our products to market: positioning and messaging across the suite, who each product is for by shop size and by role, the launch plans that turn a release into revenue, and our competitive picture. This is a hands-on role. You will write the messaging, build the plan, and sit with sales to make sure it lands. Over time you will build the function, hire and develop product marketers, and put in place the standards and playbooks it runs on. The scope of this role grows with the function you build.

Product marketing works across product, sales, and marketing. You take what is coming from Product and turn it into something Sales can sell. Before a campaign goes out, this role provides the air cover: segmented messaging and content that warms up a market so a prospect is already primed when sales makes contact. You will coordinate with demand generation and content so one message reaches each segment through one plan, not several.

Responsibilities

  • Own positioning, messaging, and value proposition for every product in the AutoVitals suite, grounded in buyer needs and differentiated by shop size and by buyer role
  • Define who we sell to by revenue band, location count, and role, and keep that segmentation and their pain points current as the product catalog and market evolve
  • Partner with Product on what is coming and translate the roadmap into market-facing language before it ships
  • Partner with Brand on product naming and identity so the product story and the company story line up
  • Own the go-to-market plan for every launch on the product roadmap, including audience, message, sequence, channels, internal readiness across sales, support, training, and shop success, and the measures of whether it worked
  • Own the launch communication plan across clients, prospects, and internal teams, including FAQs so everyone answers questions the same way
  • Own adoption of features already in market, not just what is new, so existing shops know what they have and use it
  • Own the competitive picture end to end, including who we win against, who we lose to, and why, with battlecards, win and loss themes, and positioning against the platforms shops evaluate alongside us
  • Bring the competitive read into pricing, packaging, and roadmap conversations, and keep leadership current on what is changing in the market
  • Build the material sales actually uses: decks, one-pagers, talk tracks, objection handling, and FAQs tied to the problems shops are trying to solve
  • Own the customer proof points and reference stories sales relies on, and work with content to get them produced
  • Give campaigns air cover with segmented messaging and content that runs ahead of outreach, coordinating with demand generation and content so one consistent message reaches each segment
  • Measure what you build against sales adoption and pipeline, and improve it based on what closes
  • Build product marketing into a function with defined standards, process, and an operating cadence with product, sales, and the rest of marketing so launches are planned, not reactive
  • Hire, onboard, and develop product marketers as the team grows, and define how they align to areas of the product and their product management counterparts

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS or technology company
  • Experience conducting market discovery through customer, prospect, and win and loss interviews, then translating those insights into validated market problems, buyer personas, positioning, and go-to-market decisions
  • Experience managing or developing product marketers and building the process, standards, and playbooks a function runs on, not only doing the work yourself
  • Track record owning product launches end to end, from positioning through sales readiness and results
  • Strong writer and clear communicator who can take a technical product and say plainly what it does and who it is for, across all levels of an organization
  • Experience building competitive intelligence from scratch, including research, battlecards, and win and loss analysis
  • Experience segmenting a market and building differentiated messaging by segment and by buyer role
  • Comfortable working directly with sales reps, sitting in on calls, and building what they will actually use
  • Data-literate, able to connect messaging and launch work to pipeline and bookings
  • Comfortable building from scratch in a fast-moving environment where not everything is defined yet
  • Bonus
    • Pragmatic Marketing or Product Marketing Alliance certification
    • Experience taking a multi-product platform to market
    • Experience marketing to small and medium-sized businesses, particularly in automotive, home services, or a similar vertical
    • Familiarity with Salesforce and HubSpot
    • Background or knowledge of the automotive repair industry

Salary Range Transparency

Annual Total Compensation Range: $135,000 – $155,000 OTE (On Target Earnings include 10% Bonus)

Individual compensation offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, applicable skills, educational background, relevant experience

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401K Match
  • Flexible PTO

raw.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Thermal-Fluid Systems
raw.excerpt: About Skyven At Skyven Technologies, we are replacing industrial boilers with electric heat pumps that make process steam at a lower cost than burning fuel.
raw.description:
About Skyven

At Skyven Technologies, we are replacing industrial boilers with electric heat pumps that make process steam at a lower cost than burning fuel. Under the hood, our Arcturus heat pump is an open-cycle mechanical vapor recompression (MVR) system: we flash hot water to low-pressure steam, then compress that steam with multi-stage centrifugal machinery up to the pressure the plant needs. We give our customers two options to deploy the heat pump: (A) a traditional CAPEX purchase, and (B) an innovative Energy-as-a-Service (EaaS) model with zero CAPEX and savings from day one. Either way, customers save money and reduce emissions while minimizing risk.

We are past the lab: our first commercial systems are in execution at industrial customer sites, and we keep pushing the technology at our Demo Center. This is a role for someone who wants to do serious engineering in a startup environment: move quickly, think deeply, work with strong people, and help turn ambitious concepts into equipment that works in the field.

Why This Role

  • You will be the lead mechanical engineer on the first commercial units of a new class of multi-megawatt industrial machine, not the next copy of a proven design.
  • Your designs get built and run in operating plants, and your decisions will carry into every unit that follows.
  • You get both halves of engineering: first-principles design on novel equipment, and the rigor of real industrial execution.
  • Small team, real influence: you work directly with the CTO, and your judgment shapes the product.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer who exemplifies strong engineering judgment combined with strong practical mechanical engineering capability. We especially value engineers who have spent time close to real hardware in the field and know the difference between what looks good on paper and what really works.

You will own the mechanical side of our first commercial deployments, from P&ID through vendor selection, drawings, fabrication, and startup. Most of your time will go to project execution, with the rest on product development for future sites. You will bring deep practical mechanical judgment to the team’s system-level and conceptual thinking, turning ambitious concepts into designs that can actually be built, commissioned, operated, and maintained. This is an individual contributor role, but we are looking for someone with the maturity and breadth to grow into the technical lead for our mechanical systems.

This role is for someone who is energized by understanding how an entire system works, not just producing drawings or sourcing parts. You should be the kind of engineer who wants to understand the “why” behind requirements, spot weaknesses in a design, ask hard questions early, and improve a system’s performance, operability, reliability, and cost. One day that may mean digging into system architecture, operability, or failure modes. Another day it may mean reviewing a P&ID, building CAD, tightening a spec, challenging a vendor design, or catching issues in a drawing package before they become field problems.

What You’ll Work On

Arcturus is an industrial steam system, not an HVAC unit. The hardware and physics you will own include:

  • Saturated water and steam systems from vacuum up to tens of bar: flash vessels, hot water recirculation, condensate return, venting, and draining
  • Multi-megawatt, multi-stage centrifugal steam compression (larger systems exceed 10 MWe), plus the motors, VFDs, and controls around it
  • Heat exchangers, pumps (including low-NPSH service), control valves, relief devices, steam traps, strainers, and instrumentation
  • Skidded and modular packages, pressure vessels, and the piping, supports, and thermal growth that tie them together
  • Integration into operating plants: utility tie-ins, battery limits, outdoor installation, and freeze protection

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as lead mechanical engineer on a commercial Arcturus project, owning the inside-battery-limits (ISBL) mechanical design and coordinating with our engineering firm on the site side
  • Help develop and refine industrial thermal-fluid systems with a strong eye toward buildability, operability, maintainability, and cost
  • Create and maintain P&IDs, system layouts, piping concepts, mechanical arrangements, and equipment designs
  • Create CAD models, assemblies, and drawings for fabricated items in SolidWorks, not just review them
  • Help bring rigor to PDM and drawing control as we move from conceptual into detailed design
  • Critically review prints, layouts, and design packages and catch issues before they reach fabrication or the field
  • Review engineering firm deliverables, including site (OSBL) design and any ISBL checks we ask them to do
  • Work across process, mechanical, electrical, controls, and field considerations rather than staying narrowly inside one discipline
  • Develop technical specifications, datasheets, and RFQ packages for major mechanical equipment, valves, instrumentation, and supporting components
  • Lead technical vendor engagement: work directly with suppliers and fabricators to compare quotes, review submittals and designs, answer RFIs, and make sound judgments on open-ended engineering questions
  • Lead and contribute to HAZOP and FMEA reviews to find what we have missed
  • Support installation, commissioning, and startup, including time on site when it matters
  • Identify opportunities to standardize or automate parts of the design process, including AI tools, engineering tools, design workflows, drawing generation, or CAD workflows
  • Help raise the technical level of the team through strong review, clear reasoning, and high standards while keeping an eye on speed and pragmatism

The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here

This role is a strong fit for someone who:

  • Thinks from first principles and wants to understand how the system really works
  • Has strong intuition for mechanical design, field realities, and failure modes
  • Takes ownership, notices what others miss, and is comfortable speaking up
  • Makes sound engineering calls in ambiguous, first-of-a-kind, or cross-disciplinary situations
  • Communicates clearly with engineers, vendors, fabricators, and leadership

How We Use AI

AI lets a small team do the work of a much larger one, and we use it extensively, every day, across all of engineering. We use it to research unfamiliar equipment, run and check calculations, draft specifications and reports, review drawings and vendor data, and automate repetitive work.

We expect you to already use AI tools regularly in your engineering work, and to push that further here. Use it to go faster and cover more ground. Also know exactly which outputs you have independently verified and which you have not. AI produces plausible-looking errors, and catching them takes real engineering judgment. You own the result either way.

Our interview process includes a hands-on exercise where AI use is expected. If you are skeptical of AI or prefer not to use it in your work, this role is not a good fit.

How Fast We Move

Your work turns into real hardware quickly. We work in weeks, not quarters. Taking a concept package to RFQ-ready should take a small team a few weeks, not several months. Reviews are short and focused, and decisions get made by the people doing the work.

We care a lot about rigor. Speed and rigor are compatible when engineers understand the physics and know what level of detail each stage of a design actually needs. If you are used to large-company timelines and approval layers, expect an adjustment.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years designing or specifying industrial thermal-fluid or process equipment: steam, hot water, refrigeration, process, oil and gas, chemical or power plant systems. Component-level, vehicle, consumer product or building HVAC experience alone is not a match.
  • Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer, and the ability to reason from first principles about water and steam systems
  • Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals across piping, pressure vessels, materials, heat exchangers, rotating equipment, skidded systems, bearings, and fabrication
  • Skill creating and modifying P&IDs and translating system intent into practical hardware
  • Strong 3D CAD capability, ideally SolidWorks (Creo, NX or Inventor are fine), including creating models and drawings yourself
  • Experience writing specifications and working directly with vendors and fabricators
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your engineering work, with good habits for verifying what they produce
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites and vendor shops (up to about 10%), with more during installation and commissioning
  • Live in and authorized to work in the US, without sponsorship

Especially Valuable

The engineers who do best here usually have both of these in their background:

  • R&D or first-of-a-kind product development, where you had to figure out how something should work rather than follow an established standard
  • Real industrial execution at an EPC, an equipment OEM, a heavy equipment company, or in plant engineering, where you learned how equipment actually gets specified, built, installed, and maintained

Also valuable:

  • Experience in an industrial startup or fast-moving product development environment
  • Hands-on field, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, or plant support experience
  • Experience with pumps, compressors, turbomachinery, steam systems, MVR, evaporators, industrial heat pumps, or other thermal-fluid systems
  • Working knowledge of relevant codes and standards such as ASME (B31.1, B31.3, Section VIII) and API
  • HAZOP and FMEA experience
  • Owning or administering PDM (SolidWorks PDM or similar)
  • Experience reviewing or developing piping layouts, supports, stress/life considerations, materials selections, and fabrication details
  • Strong print review instincts: the ability to find issues, inconsistencies, and bad assumptions in mechanical design packages
  • Experience improving engineering workflows through Python, scripting, automation, design tools, or model-based approaches

What We Value

We value engineers who are curious, rigorous, hard to fool, and hard to impress. We are especially interested in people who combine first principles thinking with practical mechanical depth, independent thinking, and high ownership. We also want people who respect the codes, standards, and practices that make industrial equipment safe and buildable. A great idea that ignores the rules won’t get built, and a design that only follows the rules won’t be good enough to build.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO
  • Stock options
  • Medical, dental, and 401k benefits
  • Salary range: $130,000 to $160,000

Location

  • We are a remote-first organization; this role is fully remote.
  • The candidate must be currently based in and have the right to work in the United States.
  • We are not able to sponsor or transfer visas, including H-1B transfers.

raw.description:
über uns

​

Wir bei shiftavenue gestalten moderne IT-Infrastrukturen für Unternehmen, die ihre Technologie einfacher, sicherer und automatisierter betreiben wollen.

Als Remote-first-Unternehmen entwickeln wir zukunftsfähige Lösungen rund um Modern Workplace, Cloud-Infrastrukturen, Automatisierung und Cyber Security. Dabei verbinden wir technologische Expertise mit intelligenten Automatisierungsansätzen, um Prozesse zu vereinfachen und neue Potenziale zu erschließen.

Entscheidend für unseren Erfolg sind die Menschen hinter der Technologie. Deshalb schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem du Verantwortung übernehmen, dich fachlich weiterentwickeln und deine Perspektive einbringen kannst. Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu

Ready to shift your game?

ihr profil

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Cloud- und Plattformlösungen, die zu ihren tatsächlichen Anforderungen passen.
  • Von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz begleitest du technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.
  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und Infrastrukturen und findest Wege, sie einfacher, automatisierter und skalierbarer zu gestalten.
  • Statt Lösungen für jedes Projekt neu zu bauen, entwickelst du wiederverwendbare Standards und Komponenten.
  • Du löst technische Herausforderungen nicht nur kurzfristig, sondern suchst nach nachhaltigen Ansätzen, von denen Kunden langfristig profitieren.
  • Du bekommst Freiraum, neue Technologien auszuprobieren, ihren Nutzen zu bewerten und sinnvolle Ansätze in unsere Projekte einzubringen.
  • Mit deiner Erfahrung prägst du unsere technischen Standards und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Portfolios.


Was wir von dir erwarten

  • Erfahrung im Platform Engineering und Cloud Setups mit einem der einschlägigen Cloud Provider (vorzugsweise Azure oder Google Cloud)
  • Expertise in Software-Versionskontrolle (Git/GitHub/Gitlab)
  • Fähigkeit zur Orchestrierung der Infrastruktur durch Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
  • Know-how in Application Delivery (Containerisierung)
  • Starker Fokus auf Automatisierung und CI/CD-Prozesse sowie Pipelines
  • Erfahrung in Scripting (z.B. GoLang oder Python)
  • verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (B2+)

warum wir?

Remote-first
Dein Arbeitsort soll zu deinem Alltag passen. Deshalb arbeiten wir deutschlandweit remote und treffen uns gezielt dort, wo persönlicher Austausch einen echten Mehrwert bietet.

Workation
Eine Zeit lang von einem anderen Ort aus arbeiten? Im Rahmen unserer Workation-Regelung schaffen wir dafür die Möglichkeit.

Technischer Gestaltungsspielraum
Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach einen vorgegebenen Stack ab. Du kannst neue Ansätze einbringen, Entscheidungen mitprägen und unsere technologischen Standards weiterentwickeln.

Persönliches Wachstum
Wir unterstützen dich dabei, deine fachlichen und persönlichen Ziele zu verfolgen und deinen nächsten Karriereschritt aktiv zu gestalten.

Offene Unternehmenskultur
Direkte Kommunikation, ehrliches Feedback und kurze Entscheidungswege sind für uns wichtiger als starre Hierarchien.

Benefits, die bei dir ankommen
Wir unterstützen dich unter anderem mit Zuschüssen zu Internet, ÖPNV beziehungsweise Deutschlandticket und Mittagessen. Hinzu kommen betriebliche Krankenversicherung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Erholungsbeihilfe.

raw.description:
Job Description:

Position Overview

The primary responsibility of the Executive Director - Central Head of Software Development is to oversee the strategy, process, tooling and approach to global software development teams within Sands’ subsidiaries. Globally there are teams of internal software development teams including contractors delivering software developed solutions.

The Executive Director - Central Head of Software Development will also work closely with the wider corporate technology team to build, manage, and automate infrastructure and application environments in our Azure based infrastructure.

The position demands someone who is highly technically competent, detail oriented, and driven to stay current with evolving technologies.

All duties are to be performed in accordance with departmental and Las Vegas Sands Corp.’s policies, practices, and procedures. All Las Vegas Sands Corp. Team Members are expected to conduct and carry themselves in a professional manner at all times. Team Members are required to observe the Company’s standards, work requirements and rules of conduct.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for leadership of Software Development activities (SDLC) globally

  • Responsible for oversight of teams of software development professionals and outsourced partners in all Sands’ subsidiaries

  • Responsible for setting and executing strategy for software engineering practices

  • Responsible for development resourcing for subsidiaries demand

  • Drive the software development agenda globally within teams, setting objectives and continuously improving execution across all activities.

  • Provide leadership oversight over configuration management, deployment setup and production troubleshooting for a diverse set of products and infrastructure developed by the team.

  • Working closely with development team(s) and business units to assist in the design of functional specifications.

  • Assume responsibility for ensuring detailed design meets architectural standards and approvals.

  • Providing technical support for failing or troubled projects for business-critical applications

  • Ensures all existing code is analyzed to understand performance impacts and solutions implemented.

  • Prepares plans for continuous upgrades of existing solutions, websites and applications.

  • Ensure that teams design software solutions that efficiently fit in an existent application ecosystem.

  • Responsible for technical analysis and design, application development and deployment to support business requirements.

  • Providing innovative leadership and skills to handle multiple projects effectively.

  • Provide recommendations regarding product/vendor selection, technology evolution, and design strategies.

  • Champion collaboration across IT and business functions

  • Independently contribute to team objectives

  • Mentor, support, and cross-train team members

  • Contribute suggestions for new products, services, and processes to ensure best in class customer service

  • Contribute to self-service knowledgebase, operational procedures, and documents

  • Consistently demonstrate professionalism in all interactions

  • Execute business communication on system planned maintenance, incident status notifications and other customer communications

  • Perform job duties in a safe manner.

  • Attend work as scheduled on a consistent and regular basis.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 21 years of age

  • Proof of authorization to work in the United States

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, System Administration, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience required

  • Advanced degree in technology or engineering is a plus

  • 10+ years of continuous Software Development leadership experience with expertise in developments within public cloud providers, or SaaS solutions and supporting software development in DevOps environments.

  • Experience of developing SOA solutions and/or microservices in a Kubernetes environment

  • Experience with JIRA, Confluence, GitHub, CI/CD tooling

  • Demonstrated expertise in enterprise software development and maintenance using Microsoft technologies and Microsoft .NET C#

  • Knowledge of other .NET languages including Visual Basic.NET, C++/CLI, J#, and JScript.NET.

  • Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle and Agile methodologies.

  • Strong bias for action and ownership

  • Ability to professionally engage with stakeholders across all levels of the organization, including peers and executive leadership

  • Good knowledge of internet security and data privacy principles

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills in English

raw.excerpt: Practice Test Content Editor, ELA Study. com helps learners achieve their education and career goals with engaging, high‑quality learning content.
raw.description:
Practice Test Content Editor, ELA

Study.com helps learners achieve their education and career goals with engaging, high‑quality learning content. We are looking for passionate individuals to work online and edit practice test questions to help students prepare for various professional certification exams.

About the Role

We are seeking detail‑oriented Content Editors to review and revise practice question content. You will train on the guidelines for a specific exam, then evaluate and edit questions against given quality, rigor, style and formatting standards. This role is fully remote. You’ll work independently, manage your own time, and follow clear documentation to ensure consistent, high‑quality outcomes. This is an online, remote contract role. All work is paid hourly.

Project Description

- Follow internal documentation to improve content clarity, authenticity to exam questions, and option and explanation quality
- Use exam content guides to validate that questions assess the provided skills
- Use copyediting skills to follow formatting conventions and ensure language and tone are compliant with DEI policies

Required Skills:

- Strong editorial judgment for educational materials, with an eye for clarity, fairness, and learner‑appropriate rigor
- Meticulous attention to detail and consistency for question accuracy and alignment to the exam’s content guide
- Willingness to learn about instructional design and train on new exams
- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and follow structured procedures

Required Qualifications:

- A bachelors degree in Physics

- 3-5 years of working experience in your field of expertise
- Experience editing or developing educational content, assessments, or test‑prep materials
- Excellent written English and command of grammar, syntax, and tone for adult learners
- Familiarity with DEI guidelines for content publication
- Reliable internet and your own computer

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree
  • Background in K‑12, higher education, or test prep
  • Experience with content management systems
  • Familiarity with best practices in practice question design
  • Experience with wiki‑style formatting and copyediting
  • MathJax/LaTeX familiarity for occasional formatting tasks

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.
  3. Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.
  4. The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Feel free to share this opportunity with any friends you think would be interested, too.

raw.title: Scrum Master
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Scrum Master to support and guide our development teams in adopting and effectively applying Agile principles and Scrum practices.
raw.description:
We are looking for a Scrum Master to support and guide our development teams in adopting and effectively applying Agile principles and Scrum practices.

In this role, you will act as a servant-leader, helping teams improve collaboration, remove obstacles, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.

Since 2007, MMDSmart has been a leading supplier in cloud-based business communications, delivering game-changing IT products to businesses in over 100 countries. Our success is fueled by the inspiration and innovative ideas of our team members, encouraging their growth and impacting our Messaging and Voice solutions. These empower our clients to communicate more effectively with their customers. Don’t miss this chance to excel in a rapidly expanding tech company, where your potential and ambitions are not just recognized, but celebrated.

What will you do at MMDSmart?
-Support cross-functional teams in Scrum or Kanban.

  • Run planning, refinement, reviews and retrospectives that end in concrete, owned and tracked actions.
  • Act as the release readiness gateway: maintain the release calendar, run go/no-go with QA, DevOps/SRE and Product, and make sure rollback plans exist.
  • Drive a release culture where agreed readiness criteria are met and releases are well prepared before go-live.
  • Take part in incident handling for the teams products: coordinate communication and the timeline during an incident, facilitate blameless post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to closure.
  • Track cross-team dependencies and delivery risks early; give stakeholders short, factual delivery status.
  • Set up and use delivery metrics (cycle time, throughput, predictability, change failure rate, time to restore) to find bottlenecks and show the effect of changes.
  • Work with Product Owners on backlog readiness: Definition of Ready, story splitting, dependencies flagged before planning.
  • Coach the teams and run a quarterly improvement plan per team with measurable goals.
  • Cut manual reporting and coordination work with Jira automation and AI tools.
    •

Requirements

You are a perfect match if you have:

  • 3+ years as a Scrum Master, Delivery Lead or similar, including 2+ years supporting multiple teams at the same time.
  • Hands-on release coordination in a SaaS or platform product, working in sprints with regular releases.
  • Experience with production incidents: coordinating the response, running post-incident reviews, following up actions to closure.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, environments, test automation and feature flags, enough to judge release risk.
  • Practical use of delivery metrics, with examples of improvements you achieved.
  • Advanced Jira: workflows, dashboards, JQL, automation rules.
  • English B2+ (upper-intermediate or higher).

    - Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent certification;
    •

Nice to have

  • Background in QA, development or SRE/support.
  • Experience working with production SRE and DevOps teams during incidents.
  • Telecom, messaging or CPaaS domain experience.
  • Experience using AI tools in QA or Scrum processes.
    •

Benefits

Why do talents choose and stay at MMDSmart?

Embrace the opportunity to work in a company that cares about:

Your Wellness: Access to mental health programs, comprehensive medical insurance, and a sports card*.

Your Happiness: Enjoy the company of cool teammates, a friendly atmosphere, a strong mentorship, and a variety of bonuses & corporate gifts.

Your Development: Benefit from free educational events & courses, and English classes with native speakers.

Your Career: Focus on your professional development in a supportive environment.

Work-Life Balance: Choose your working format - remote, office-based, or hybrid and engage in team-building activities.

Think this role's got your name on it? Go ahead and apply, we'd love to see what you've got!

Equal-Opportunity Employment

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

  • Medical Insurance and Sport Card perks are available for employees located in Bulgaria.

Since 2007, MMDSmart has been a leading supplier in cloud-based business communications, delivering game-changing IT products to businesses in over 100 countries. These empower our clients to communicate more effectively with their customers. Don’t miss this chance to excel in a rapidly expanding tech company, where your potential and ambitions are not just recognized, but celebrated.

What will you do at MMDSmart?

raw.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Operations Associate to support the Strategic Advisory Group across business operations, marketing and business development, financial administration, and other practice defining activities. This is a highly visible, service-oriented role for someone who can move comfortably between detailed execution and higher-level coordination, interface professionally with colleagues at every level, and respond quickly as priorities change.

The successful candidate will bring an ownership mindset to every assignment, with the judgment to recognize what is urgent, the discipline to track commitments through completion, and the flexibility to take on work of any size and have the mentality of nothing is too big or small to jump in and take care of. This person will serve as a dependable team member who uses technology, organization, and clear communication to keep initiatives moving and ensure important details do not fall through the cracks.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide responsive day-to-day operational support to SAG leaders and team members, shifting focus as business needs and deadlines evolve across multiple time zones in North America.
  • Coordinate work across senior leadership, practitioners, corporate functions, and external contacts while maintaining a polished and professional approach.
  • Support marketing and business development activities, including opportunity tracking, meeting preparation, follow-up actions, event support, and maintenance of marketing materials.
  • Create, update, and quality-check pitch decks, qualifications packages, presentations, and other client-facing materials in collaboration with subject-matter experts.
  • Administer CRM data and processes, including new opportunity entry, contact and account updates, pipeline hygiene, activity tracking, reporting, and follow-up reminders.
  • Monitor accounts receivable, work in process, billing status, collections follow-up, and related reporting; coordinate with project teams and Finance to resolve issues promptly.
  • Prepare and support client invoicing, including gathering backup, confirming billing details, tracking approvals, monitoring invoice status, and maintaining accurate records.
  • Develop and maintain trackers, dashboards, templates, shared workspaces, and process documentation that improve visibility, consistency, and accountability.
  • Coordinate recurring and ad hoc meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture decisions and action items, and follow through with owners until items are closed.
  • Assist with onboarding, system access, internal requests, team communications, and other administrative or operational needs that help colleagues work effectively.
  • Use Microsoft 365 and other business systems to streamline routine tasks, improve data quality, and identify practical opportunities for automation and process improvement.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with care, sound judgment, and appropriate discretion.
  • Anticipate needs, identify risks or missing information early, and escalate appropriately while offering practical solutions.
  • Take on additional priorities as needed with a service mentality and a willingness to contribute wherever the team needs support.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in operations, project coordination, team support, marketing and business development support, finance administration, or a comparable client-service environment.
  • Exceptional organization and follow-through, with a reliable system for managing multiple deadlines, requests, stakeholders, and recurring responsibilities.
  • Ability to shift between strategic, analytical, administrative, and hands-on tasks without losing visibility into existing commitments.
  • Strong service orientation and a consistent willingness to handle both high-profile assignments and routine details with equal care.
  • Professional presence and communication skills, with the confidence and judgment to work effectively across all organizational levels and with external contacts.
  • Working knowledge of marketing and business development workflows, presentation development, CRM administration, AR/WIP/billing management, and invoicing, or the ability to learn these areas quickly.
  • Advanced proficiency or strong aptitude with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint; interest in using technology and automation to improve work.
  • Ability to produce accurate, polished, and client-ready work products, including presentations, trackers, reports, and written communications.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and accountability when handling financial, client, personnel, or other confidential information.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn unfamiliar systems, processes, and subject matter.
  • Ability to work independently, ask effective questions, collaborate across functions, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change and timely execution is essential.
  • Be flexible across all North American time zones to ensure the team has the level of support needed.

This role requires regular computer-based work, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and the ability to manage time-sensitive priorities. Flexibility may be needed outside standard business hours when business or client needs require it. The work arrangement and any travel expectations will be determined based on team and business requirements.

Some of the Benefits We Have Include

J.S. Held understands that our employees are people and that life sometimes requires flexibility. We work to provide an environment that supports our team’s needs.

  • Generous FTO policy
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) match
  • Commuter benefit

Compensation

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $60,000 - $70,000 CAD. Any offered salary is based on factors including skill set, experience, training, location, scope of role, and level of responsibility.

Other Duties

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein. California residents can click here to learn more about the personal information we collect and here to learn about additional privacy rights that may be available.

Please explore what we’re all about at www.jsheld.com.

EEO and Job Accommodations

We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!

J.S. Held is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with applicable law. Applicants who need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process may contact and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line, along with the request and contact information.

If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request for a reasonable accommodation, please email include “Applicant Accommodation” within the subject line with your request and contact information.

Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm providing technical, scientific, and financial expertise. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high-stakes events demanding urgent attention, integrity, and clear analysis. TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Canada's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

Tasks

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

  • Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools
  • Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources
  • Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning
  • Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
  • Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
  • Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • Professional fluency in English and French (native or near-native proficiency required)
  • Residency in Canada for the last 5 consecutive years
  • Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
  • Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability
  • Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of Canada
  • Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in analytical, technical, or research disciplines (strongly preferred)
  • Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Benefits

  • Remote work & location independence
  • Positive environmental impact
  • Independent contractor role

Qualification path

  • Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview

  • Review the open-book study guide and evaluation framework (provided in your welcome materials)
  • Complete an open-book qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.
