raw.excerpt: Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms.
raw.description:
Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. With embedded AI, predictive analytics, and integrated payments, Elite’s products enable firms to shorten billing cycles, reduce write-offs, and unlock firm-wide insights, making financial operations the foundation for law firm innovation and growth. Learn more at elite.com.

Position Overview

The Customer Account Manager (CAM) is a quota-carrying expansion sales role responsible for growing revenue within Elite's existing cloud customer base. CAMs own all upsell and cross-sell into that base, independently identifying, developing, and closing opportunities for new products, modules, and features, and leading their own sales motion while working alongside Customer Success Managers where it benefits the customer. The role sits within Customer Success and reports to the Director of Customer Success. On-premise to cloud migrations are out of scope, and renewals are the responsibility of Customer Success.

Over time, CAMs will also lead the introduction of new Elite products into the cloud customer base. CAMs are relationship sellers and product experts: they earn trust by understanding how each firm operates, connecting its challenges to the right Elite solutions, and turning that insight into lasting commercial growth.

Work Arrangement: Remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S. with flexibility across U.S. time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Drive expansion revenue by owning and exceeding a quarterly quota for upsell and cross-sell bookings across the Elite cloud customer base, owning every deal from qualification through close
  • Identify and develop opportunities by proactively researching accounts, spotting expansion signals (usage trends, business changes, new initiatives, pain points), and qualifying them into pipeline, drawing on CSM insight and account context where helpful
  • Run the full sales cycle, leading each opportunity through discovery, demos, proposals, and negotiation to close, then handing off to Services and Support for implementation
  • Build executive relationships by acting as a consultative advisor to firm leaders, finance and operations stakeholders, and IT
  • Translate product knowledge into outcomes by staying current on Elite's cloud platform and portfolio and connecting features to measurable outcomes for each firm
  • Introduce new products to the base by serving as an early champion for new Elite products, giving market feedback, and helping shape the playbooks used to bring them into existing accounts
  • Generate pipeline by running targeted outreach and campaigns to the cloud customer base in partnership with Marketing, including webinars, product launches, and account-based plays
  • Forecast and manage pipeline by keeping CRM records accurate and current and delivering reliable weekly and quarterly forecasts
  • Collaborate across Elite with Product, Services, Support, Sales Operations, and Customer Success to align on account plans, scope solutions, ensure smooth implementation, and protect the customer experience after the sale
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental and company objectives.​

Qualifications

  • ​​Bachelor's degree in business administration​, marketing, communications, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • ​​3–5 years​ of quota-carrying experience in inside sales, account management, or account executive roles in legal technology, finance technology, or SaaS;Familiarity with law firm operations, legal practice management, or legal financial software preferred
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota, ideally selling expansion, upsell, or cross-sell into an existing customer base
  • Strong product aptitude: learns complex software quickly and delivers compelling demos as required
  • Experience collaborating with Customer Success or other post-sale teams in a shared-account environment
  • Consultative, relationship-first selling style with executive-level leaders (e.g., managing partners, CFOs, COOs, CIOs), and working knowledge of a sales methodology (e.g., MEDDICC, Challenger, Solution Selling)
  • Proficiency in CRM (e.g., Salesforce), sales engagement tools, and virtual selling platforms
  • Excellent organization, communication, negotiation, and pipeline management skills, with the ability to prioritize across a large book of accounts
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time as business needs require
  • Must be legally authorized to work in​​United States​; ​Elite does not provide employment sponsorship for this position​

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation Package ($105,600 - $127,300 base salary + variable component)
  • Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage (Health, Dental, Vision)
  • Retirement Savings Plan with an Employer Contribution
  • Professional Development Opportunities
  • Time Off
  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Global Parental Leave
  • Calm, free premium subscription
  • Employee Discount Program

Elite may use technology, including artificial intelligence-enabled tools, to assist in aspects of the recruiting and employment process. These tools are used to support, but not replace, human decision-making.

Please note that we do not offer sponsorship for this position.

Additional Information

At Elite Technology, we embrace an employee-centric, flexible work model that empowers you to do your best work in the environment that suits you. However, we also recognize the importance of in-person collaboration for key moments that truly matter.

In our flexible remote approach, you have the freedom to choose a workspace within your home country that best fits your needs. Our corporate offices are located in New York City, Los Angeles, Costa Rica, and the Philippines, providing additional options for those who prefer or need a hybrid work environment.

Our diverse global team spans the U.S., Canada, U.K., Costa Rica, the Philippines, and Australia. Please note that at this time, we are unable to hire employees located in Quebec or Ontario Provinces, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Louisiana, and Oklahoma.

As a global business, we rely on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law.

We are not accepting applications submitted through recruiting agencies.

raw.title: Program Manager, Learning and Outreach, Neighbors Lead
raw.excerpt: Protect Democracy is seeking an experienced entrepreneurial Program Manager to join the Neighbors Lead team at an important moment in the program's launch and growth.
raw.description:
Protect Democracy is seeking an experienced entrepreneurial Program Manager to join the Neighbors Lead team at an important moment in the program's launch and growth.

At Protect Democracy, we anchor our work in service to our mission: to prevent American democracy from declining into a more authoritarian form of government. Neighbors Lead is a pilot initiative built on a simple idea: when community members work together across lines of difference, trust grows, and strong, resilient communities follow. In partnership with trusted local organizations, we recruit, train, and support Civic Captains, community members who lead civic projects in their own communities. The program is underway in Mecklenburg County, NC, and is expanding to Kenosha County, WI, and additional sites.

If you're someone who thrives at integrating strategy across several workstreams, such as evaluation, scaling, and communications, but doesn't want to lose touch with the community members the work is for, this role was designed with you in mind.

As a member of the Neighbors Lead team, you will help us answer two questions: what is this pilot teaching us, and how do we tell that story well? You will make sure our evaluation work and our communications are on track and of high quality, working with the partners and colleagues driving the underlying work. You will also manage program delivery at an assigned site, including its cohort recruitment and onboarding, and be a thought partner to the head of the program as we work through what it would take to grow Neighbors Lead if the evidence supports it.

This role is a good fit for someone who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet as they are in a conversation with a community partner, who enjoys building systems while a program is still taking shape, and who cares about getting both the relationships and our need for rigor right. Occasional travel to program sites is expected.

The Program Manager for Learning and Outreach will:

Manage program delivery at an assigned site

  • Serve as the Program Manager for an assigned pilot location in 2027—upcoming locations are in WI, GA, and NC—working closely with the site's Program Coordinator and local partner organization across the cohort cycle;

  • Make sure what we learn from the data and from your site’s cohort feeds back into how we recruit, onboard, and support our next cohort, and share those lessons with the rest of the team.

Oversee data and evaluation work across all sites

  • Work with our evaluation partners to keep evaluation work consistent, high quality, and on schedule across sites;

  • Oversee Civic-Captain-focused data collection and quality across our pilot sites, keeping data practices consistent as new sites come online;

  • Make sure analysis of Civic Captain relationship and network data is done well and translated into insights the team can use.

Oversee communications

  • Oversee communications for Neighbors Lead, including recruitment and outreach materials, partner and community messaging, and the program's brand and website, primarily by working with the partners and colleagues who produce the core work;

  • Serve as the connective link across those partners and workstreams, making sure materials are produced on time, reflect the program's goals, and can speak to community members and partners from a wide range of backgrounds and viewpoints.

Help shape how and if the program grows

  • Partner with the Program Lead on questions of scale: what the evidence suggests, what the operations would require, and what we should test next.

The ideal candidate brings:

  • Six or more years of relevant professional experience, such as administering a community engagement program, with a track record of owning complex work with limited supervision;

  • Experience overseeing evaluation, research, or data work carried out by others, such as staff, vendors, or external partners, including setting expectations, holding the work to quality standards and timelines, and turning results into decisions and clear reporting;

  • Strong project management skills, with proven ability to keep several workstreams and partners on schedule at once, including day-to-day program delivery at a site;

  • Skill in building and maintaining relationships with external partners, vendors, and community organizations, including when interests and timelines differ;

  • Excellent writing and communications judgment, including experience shaping messaging for varied audiences and guiding others who produce communications materials;

  • Familiarity with community engagement or grassroots approaches, and curiosity about how community-level change happens;

  • Sound judgment and discretion, with a high degree of integrity in handling sensitive and confidential information, including information about program participants;

  • Passion for protecting and improving our democracy and for building trust in communities, and enthusiasm for working with people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives;

  • Comfort in a fast-paced, evolving environment where processes are still being built, and a growth mindset with comfort giving and receiving feedback up, down, and sideways;

  • Willingness to work in alignment with 501(c)(3) requirements and to maintain a strictly nonpartisan posture in all program work;

  • Ability to travel to program sites, particularly in the lead-up to program launch in that location.

Pluses, but not requirements:

  • Enough comfort with survey data and quantitative reporting to question evaluation partners' methods and results, and the ability to explain findings to non-technical colleagues;

  • Deep experience as a community or relational organizer;

  • Familiarity with data tools, such as statistical software or CRM and database platforms;

  • Experience with brand, website, or content management.

We don't expect any one candidate to meet every qualification listed here. What matters most is an ability to lead complex, multi-partner programs with limited supervision, sound judgment with sensitive information, and a real interest in building trust in communities. If that describes you, we'd welcome your application even if some of the other items are new to you.

Reports to: Brittany Williams, head of Neighbors Lead (working closely with another Program Manager)
Compensation: $112,200 – $132,000, commensurate with the candidate’s relevant experience, capabilities, and skills, and in alignment with internal equity.
Start date: January 18, 2027

About Protect Democracy

  • Flexible location. We are a remote-first organization based exclusively in the United States, meaning our staff work within the US and primarily virtually. We also offer shared workspaces for those who enjoy working in an office environment. We are established for remote work in many states across the country, and while candidates based anywhere in the United States are welcome to apply, we may not be able to offer employment in your current location. If you proceed in the hiring process, we will discuss where you currently live and what is possible in our initial interview. All staff are also required to travel at least two times per year to team retreats, and this role also requires periodic travel. (Accommodations to this requirement will be made only in exceptional circumstances.)

  • Commitment to an inclusive workplace. Protect Democracy is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthens our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. Protect Democracy encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

  • Phenomenal benefits. Our benefits package includes generous sick leave and a flexible vacation policy where we encourage team members to take 4-5 weeks every year, along with 12 paid holidays, 6 weeks of paid family medical leave, and 18 weeks of paid parental leave. We also offer a 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer match that vests immediately. Additionally, we cover employee medical premiums at 100% (with up to 95% coverage for dependents depending on plan selection), and employee and dependents dental/vision at 100%. All employees have access to long-term disability and life insurance, fertility benefits, a home office stipend, and bonuses at the discretion of the Executive Director.

  • Ample opportunities for personal & professional development. Candidates who do not meet all listed criteria should still apply, as our organizational structure focuses on providing mentorship and opportunities for professional growth.

Important notes

  • Contact if you require specific accommodations at any point in the hiring process.

  • Keep an eye on your promotions/spam folders to avoid missed communication.

  • A note on fair hiring and automated tech: To help our small team review applications efficiently and fairly, we use automated screening tools to assist with resume and response review. Every candidate flagged by our system is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team; we never rely on automated scoring alone to make hiring decisions. If you have questions about this process, or need an alternative application path as an accommodation, reach out to us at .

  • We are unable to provide status updates for each application we receive. If you reach out and do not hear back, please know it is not for lack of appreciation or interest, but simply for lack of staff capacity to respond to individual inquiries.

  • The application will include a voluntary EEO survey so that we can monitor the applicant pool as a whole for representation and equal employment opportunities, and to evaluate our progress as an organization toward a diverse and inclusive workforce, which we believe is a pillar of a thriving democracy. The categories used by the EEO survey are limited and may not reflect your lived experience; please feel free to opt out of any of the questions. Your responses to this survey are entirely separate from your application materials, are not accessible to those responsible for hiring decisions, and will not affect your candidacy in any way.

raw.description:
Für unseren Kunden, ein führendes Unternehmen im Versicherungsumfeld, suchen wir einen erfahrenen Adobe AEM Forms Developer / Engineer zur Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung einer geschäftskritischen eForms-Plattform.

Im Mittelpunkt steht die Ablösung einer bestehenden Java-EE-basierten Prozess-Engine durch eine moderne, skalierbare und wartungsfreundliche Architektur. Die Plattform übernimmt zentrale Funktionen wie die Verarbeitung digitaler Formulare, Datenvorbefüllung, PDF-Generierung, E-Mail-Kommunikation und Integration verschiedener Umsysteme.

Neben der technischen Neugestaltung der Plattform verantwortest du gemeinsam mit dem Team den stabilen und sicheren Betrieb der bestehenden AEM-Forms-Landschaft.

Entwicklung & Modernisierung der eForms-Plattform

  • Analyse bestehender JEE-Prozesse, Systemarchitekturen und technischer Abhängigkeiten
  • Konzeption und Implementierung einer modernen Architektur zur Ablösung der bestehenden JEE-Prozess-Engine
  • Evaluation geeigneter Technologien und Lösungsansätze, insbesondere AEM OSGi, Flowable und AEM-Standardfunktionen
  • Entwicklung zentraler Services für Formularverarbeitung, Submission, Queueing, Auditing, Prefilling und PDF-Generierung
  • Konzeption und Implementierung von Schnittstellen zu CRM-, Kafka-, ECM- und weiteren Umsystemen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring, Health-Checks und technischen Dashboards
  • Sicherstellung einer skalierbaren, performanten und wartungsfreundlichen Lösungsarchitektur

Migration, Testing & Deployment

  • Migration bestehender Formulare und Prozesse auf die neue Plattform
  • Aufbau und Automatisierung von Build- und Deployment-Prozessen mittels Jenkins und CI/CD
  • Entwicklung und Durchführung automatisierter Unit-, Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests
  • Sicherstellung eines stabilen Parallelbetriebs während der Migration
  • Begleitung des Go-Lives und schrittweise Ablösung der bisherigen JEE-Infrastruktur
  • Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen und Durchführung des Wissenstransfers

Betrieb & Wartung von Adobe AEM Forms

  • Sicherstellung des stabilen Betriebs der bestehenden eForms-Plattform

  • Analyse und Behebung von Störungen sowie Verarbeitung und Nachlieferung fehlgeschlagener Formulare

  • Durchführung regelmässiger System-, Security- und Qualitätsprüfungen

  • Analyse und Behebung von Schwachstellen mithilfe von SonarQube, Qualys und weiteren Security-Tools

  • Installation und Validierung von Adobe-Hotfixes und Service Packs

  • Durchführung von Betriebssystem- und Infrastruktur-Upgrades auf Windows- und Linux-Servern

  • Performanceoptimierung, Fehleranalyse und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Systemstabilität

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im technischen Betrieb von Adobe Experience Manager (AEM Forms)

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, Java EE (JEE) und OSGi

  • Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung und Integration komplexer Backend-Services und APIs

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Integration von Umsystemen über REST, Messaging oder vergleichbare Schnittstellentechnologien

  • Erfahrung mit der Migration und Modernisierung bestehender Enterprise-Applikationen

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, Jenkins sowie automatisierten Testverfahren

  • Erfahrung im Betrieb und Troubleshooting von Anwendungen auf Linux- und Windows-Servern

  • Gutes Verständnis von IT-Security, Systemmonitoring und Performanceoptimierung

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Erfahrung mit Flowable, BPMN oder vergleichbaren Workflow-Engines (nice-to-have)

  • Kenntnisse von Apache Kafka und Event-driven Architectures (nice-to-have)

Simplified Chinese AI Product Evaluator/ 简体中文 - AI 产品评估员

The Project

Productive Playhouse is building a talent pool of Simplified Chinese speakers for an upcoming project testing and evaluating leading AI chatbots. The objective is to enhance response quality through direct user interaction with the various AI models.

Open to freelancers based outside the U.S and China.

This is more than one job. Apply once, and we'll keep you in mind for this project — and future ones that need your language skills.

The Details

We’re looking for independent contractor engagement (task-based - project-based).

  • Pay Rate: $11.00 USD per hour
  • You choose which tasks to take, set your own hours, and are free to work with other clients any time. You can stay flexible as the project evolves.
  • This is an iterative project, work arrives in batches (there may be pauses between them).

What You’ll Do

As an AI Evaluator, you'll play a critical role in shaping and improving the next generation of Generative AI. You'll participate in structured, hands-on evaluations by interacting directly with various AI models to assess their capabilities, safety, and helpfulness. Your insights and data will directly inform model development and optimization.

Exact tasks vary by project and will be spelled out in that project's Statement of Work (SOW) before you start. Depending on the role, your work may include:

  • Testing and evaluating AI chatbots or language models through structured conversations, using assigned goals and prompts.
  • Voice-based interactions with AI models — for projects that involve this, sessions are recorded, and audio may be shared with the client as part of the evaluation deliverable.
  • Submitting deliverables (write-ups, ratings, screenshots, or recordings) in the format each task specifies.

What We're Looking For

  • Native or expert-level fluency in Simplified Chinese, as spoken in Mainland China
  • Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills - assessment maybe required
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Hands-on experience using AI models or large language models
  • Comfortable with both written and voice-based conversation — and good at asking sharp follow-ups
  • Your own smartphone, computer, reliable internet, and comfort with web-based tools
  • Able to pass a language proficiency and technical literacy assessment
  • Responsive communicator — quick replies move you through onboarding faster
  • Able to start within 48 hours

Why PPH?

Your language skills are the whole point — and this project pays for them

Apply once, get contacted directly when a spot opens — no chasing

Work from anywhere, on your own schedule, alongside any other work you do

Clear task specs, no ongoing oversight, no micromanagement

Real project experience with a global data and language services company

Work that actually improves how AI understands your language

About Productive Playhouse

We started by teaching kids through award-winning programming. We grew into a global data and language services company trusted by clients worldwide. But the mission never changed: keep language alive.

Transcription, translation, localization, linguistic analysis, AI evaluation — it all comes back to preserving languages and the cultures they carry.

All engagements are contingent upon successful completion of identity verification. Productive Playhouse is an equal opportunity organization headquartered in California and committed to diversity and inclusion across our global workforce. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and abilities, regardless of location or engagement type. For accommodations or inquiries, please contact HR.

Candidate Privacy: Productive Playhouse collects and processes personal information as part of our recruiting process. Before applying, please review our Candidate Privacy Policy to learn what we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

raw.title: Head of Digital Acquisition
raw.excerpt: FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets.
raw.description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.

In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.

To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch this informative video.

THE MANDATE

As our product offering expands, we are looking for marketing leader to help FairMoney reach more customers and scale acquisition efficiently — growing customer volumes while making every acquisition budget work harder.

You will lead FairMoney's digital function, owning paid acquisition across Google, Meta, affiliates and other performance channels. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the acquisition strategy, manage substantial budgets and develop the in-house team, while working directly in advertising platforms, reviewing campaign data and identifying the changes needed to improve results.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Set the paid acquisition strategy across lending and banking products, translating business priorities into channel plans, campaigns and measurable targets.
  • Lead and personally optimise Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, including mobile app acquisition, bidding, targeting, budget pacing and campaign structure.
  • Own the acquisition budget: planning, forecasting and allocation — monitoring spend and returns, and scaling investment across channels and campaigns based on performance.
  • Own acquisition efficiency and quality: track and improve CAC, CPA, conversion rates, ROAS and cost per activated customer, using cohort and lifetime-value insights to judge the quality of customers acquired.
  • Run structured experiments across creatives, messaging, audiences, bidding strategies and conversion events, and partner with Brand and Design to turn insights into effective advertising.
  • Build and manage affiliate partnerships: negotiate commercial terms and payout models, and monitor traffic quality, fraud risk and acquisition costs.
  • Keep measurement and attribution reliable: work with Data and Engineering on app tracking, attribution and conversion signals, and investigate discrepancies between platform and business results.
  • Optimise the full acquisition funnel with Product, Risk and CRM — from click and install through registration, activation and first product usage, we need the right customer at the right time.
  • Lead and coach the in-house performance marketing team, set clear goals, and present results, forecasts and recommended actions to the management team.
  • Develop new channels: evaluate new paid acquisition opportunities and scale those that demonstrate repeatable results.

Requirements

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Scaled performance marketing in financial services. Has led and scaled performance marketing in fintech, consumer lending, digital banking or other consumer financial services. Emerging-markets experience is preferred.
  • Senior acquisition leadership. 7+ years in performance marketing or digital acquisition, including leading a team and owning acquisition outcomes in a B2C business.
  • Deep, hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads expertise. A recent, proven record of scaling mobile app or consumer acquisition campaigns.
  • Budget ownership at scale. Has managed substantial paid marketing budgets, including planning, forecasting, allocation and performance reporting.
  • Proven efficient growth. Can show where they improved acquisition efficiency while increasing customer volumes, with clear examples and measurable results.
  • Strong affiliate marketing experience. Including partner management, commercial negotiations and traffic-quality assessment.
  • Technical measurement fluency. Strong understanding of mobile attribution, app events, conversion tracking and value-based bidding; able to troubleshoot measurement issues with technical teams.
  • Strong analytical judgment. A practical command of CAC, CPA, ROAS, LTV, payback and cohort performance.
  • Builder and player-coach. Can build and develop an in-house team while staying closely involved in campaign execution and optimisation.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Attribution and analytics tooling. Experience with Adjust, AppsFlyer or similar platforms, alongside Firebase, GA4 and business intelligence tools.
  • Advanced analysis and automation. SQL or other advanced analytical skills, and practical use of AI or automation to improve campaign analysis, creative testing or reporting.

EXPECTATION ON AI

  • Plan in AI-era timelines. Challenge campaign and testing plans that assume pre-AI cycle times, and compress launch, test and learning loops from weeks into days.
  • Make the team AI-native operators. Expect marketers to use AI directly for creative variants, copy, audience analysis, reporting and campaign diagnostics.
  • Redesign the acquisition workflow. Jointly define with Data, Design and Engineering where AI is used across creative production, testing, bidding, measurement and reporting.
  • Measure AI leverage. Track creative testing velocity, time-to-insight, output per marketer and acquisition efficiency against pre-AI baselines.
  • Scale what works. Turn successful AI-native practices into playbooks, tooling and operating standards across the Growth team.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Efficient growth

  • New-customer volumes grow materially while CAC and CPA improve across channels.

Quality customers

  • Acquired cohorts activate and use our products, with LTV and payback improving across lending and banking.

A team that owns outcomes

  • Attribution is trusted, budget moves on evidence, and each team member owns clear channel targets.

Benefits

  • 25 days paid vacation, Sick & Public Holidays to B2B contractors
  • Remote (timezone must have significant overlap with CET)
  • Training & Development budget
  • Paid company business trips

Recruitment Process:

  • Screening session with a member of the recruitment team.
  • Technical Interview with the Chief Growth Officer
  • Case Study
  • Panel Session to discuss case study
  • Final Interview with the executive team

Was wir suchen

Hi, wir von Interlead haben ein klares Ziel: Bis Ende 2026 wollen wir die #1 Lead Company im deutschsprachigen Raum aufbauen. Damit lösen wir das größte Problem unserer Partner: laufend neue Leads, Termine und Aufträge zu generieren.

Wir leben und lieben Marketing, und wollen unser Wachstum weiter beschleunigen. Dafür brauchen wir kreative, analytische Köpfe, die Lust haben, echte Wirkung zu erzeugen.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Senior Native Advertising Manager (m/w/d) für unser Marketing-Team, hybrid oder remote.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere Native-Advertising-Kampagnen – von der Entwicklung aufmerksamkeitsstarker Werbemittel und überzeugender Advertorials bis zur eigenständigen Steuerung und Optimierung unserer Kampagnen auf Plattformen wie Taboola und Outbrain.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

Native Advertising & Kampagnenmanagement

  • Channel Development: Du entwickelst unser Native Advertising strategisch weiter, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und erschließt neue Möglichkeiten zur Skalierung.
  • Campaign Ownership: Du planst, erstellst und steuerst eigenständig Kampagnen auf Plattformen wie Taboola und Outbrain. Dabei optimierst du kontinuierlich Targeting, Placements, Gebote und Budgets mit dem Ziel viel Volumen bei gleichzeitig profitablem CPAs.

Kreation, Content & Conversion-Optimierung

  • Creative Development: Du entwickelst eigenständig aufmerksamkeitsstarke Anzeigen, Headlines, Bilder und kreative Werbekonzepte, die Nutzer ansprechen und zu Conversions führen.
  • Advertorials & Landingpages: Du konzipierst und erstellst überzeugende Advertorials, starke Headlines und conversionorientierte Landingpage-Inhalte.
  • Funnel-Optimierung: Du analysierst und optimierst die gesamte Customer Journey – vom ersten Anzeigenkontakt über das Advertorial bis zur Conversion.
  • KI & Automatisierung: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools, um die Erstellung von Texten und Creatives zu beschleunigen, neue Ansätze zu entwickeln und Testprozesse effizienter zu gestalten.

Analytics, Tracking & Zusammenarbeit

  • Performance-Analyse: Du analysierst Kampagnenergebnisse, bewertest relevante KPIs und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab.
  • Testing & Experimentation: Du entwickelst datenbasierte Hypothesen, führst systematische A/B-Tests durch und optimierst kontinuierlich Creatives, Advertorials und Conversion-Funnels.
  • Teamwork: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Performance-Marketing-Team, angrenzenden Fachbereichen und externen Partnern zusammen, um erfolgreiche Kampagnen weiterzuentwickeln und zu skalieren.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du verfügst über mindestens 2–3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Native Advertising, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder einem Inhouse-Marketing-Team.
  • Plattform-Know-how: Du hast bereits eigenständig Kampagnen auf Taboola, Outbrain gesteuert und optimiert.

raw.title: Sales Internship - Summer 2027
raw.excerpt: About OpenSesame OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI.
raw.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services, embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems, to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You'll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As a Sales Intern, you'll join our high-performing sales team and work on real projects that contribute directly to OpenSesame's growth and revenue goals. You'll gain experience in prospecting, pipeline building, and sales strategy while collaborating across departments and engaging with our leadership.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You'll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we'll encourage you to use them to research accounts, analyze market trends and competitors, prepare sales materials, and build. You'll see how human connection and AI innovation combine to win business.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You'll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Sales Team

At OpenSesame, our Sales Team is the driving force behind helping businesses tackle their training challenges and build the world's most productive and admired workforces. We go beyond selling. We are trusted partners who use market trends, competitor insights, and AI-driven analysis to craft tailored solutions for the evolving needs of our customers.

Join a team that thrives on discovery, trusted relationships, and turning customer challenges into results, and help shape the future of workforce learning sales.

Performance Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Learn OpenSesame's sales process, tools, workflows, and product offerings.
  • Get set up with our internal AI tools and learn how the team uses them day to day.
  • Explore competitor strategies and analyze market trends to build a point of view on our customers' training challenges.
  • Begin engaging with the sales team and prospects to understand key customer needs.

By 30 Days

  • Support active sales efforts by preparing materials, researching accounts, identifying opportunities, and refining strategies.
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to research prospects, draft outreach and proposals, and analyze data, and share what works with the team.
  • Assist in creating and delivering solutions that address customer training needs.
  • Collaborate with the team to turn insights into ongoing deals and customer conversations.
  • Join the intern hackathon team and build a working prototype.
  • Learn more about our organization-wide training program, OpenSesame Qualified.

By 60 Days

  • Take ownership of a project that improves sales processes, sales enablement materials, or customer engagement strategies, using data or AI-driven findings.
  • Establish yourself as a key resource for the team by providing actionable insights and support to inform decisions.
  • Develop and propose inventive recommendations to improve overall sales effectiveness and customer impact.

Not selected for this role? You’re still in the running. We’ll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we’ll reach out to you directly.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $20 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame's internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You'll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they're being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

Head of Client Operations (Cold Email & Client Delivery) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible (Aligned with U.S. Client Time Zones)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Head of Client Operations to take full ownership of client delivery, campaign performance, client retention, and operational execution for a fast-growing outbound lead generation business.

This is not a traditional account management or project coordination role. You will be responsible for ensuring clients achieve measurable outcomes by improving campaign performance, optimizing operational systems, and maintaining exceptional delivery standards.

Working directly with the founder, you’ll thrive in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve quickly, ownership is expected, and execution matters more than theory. You’ll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution—solving problems, improving systems, and building long-term client relationships.

If you’re experienced in cold email operations, outbound lead generation, and client success, and enjoy building scalable operational processes, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Client Ownership & Retention

  • Manage a portfolio of 20–30 client accounts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client delivery, campaign performance, and strategic discussions.
  • Lead client meetings, quarterly reviews, escalation management, and account planning.
  • Build trusted relationships while proactively managing client expectations.
  • Identify account risks early and implement retention strategies before issues escalate.
  • Own client satisfaction, retention, and long-term account success.

Campaign Performance & Delivery

  • Monitor and optimize cold email campaign performance.
  • Diagnose and resolve deliverability issues, inbox placement challenges, low reply rates, messaging performance, and list quality concerns.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews before campaign launches.
  • Continuously improve deliverability, engagement, reply rates, and conversion performance.
  • Ensure clients consistently receive measurable business outcomes.

Hands-On Cold Email Execution

  • Refine outbound messaging, campaign strategy, and email sequences.
  • Optimize subject lines, value propositions, calls-to-action, and email copy.
  • Improve outbound infrastructure and inbox placement.
  • Work directly within platforms including:
    • Apollo.io
    • Smartlead.ai
    • Instantly.ai
  • Troubleshoot campaigns and implement recovery and optimization strategies.

Systems, SOPs & Operational Scaling

  • Design and improve scalable operational systems and delivery workflows.
  • Develop SOPs, playbooks, and standardized processes.
  • Track and improve SLAs, client health metrics, delivery quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Continuously refine workflows to support company growth.
  • Drive practical process improvements through ongoing iteration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with outreach teams, developers, infrastructure teams, and leadership.
  • Coordinate the resolution of technical issues, automation challenges, and infrastructure concerns.
  • Maintain visibility into campaign performance, operational risks, and delivery bottlenecks.
  • Ensure smooth communication and accountability across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You thrive in fast-paced startup environments.
  • You take ownership without requiring constant direction.
  • You enjoy solving complex operational problems.
  • You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • You communicate confidently with clients, founders, and cross-functional teams.
  • You focus on measurable results and continuous improvement.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Proven experience leading client delivery, client operations, account management, or operational execution.
  • Background in cold email agencies, outbound lead generation, growth marketing, or similar high-volume outbound environments.
  • Experience working in startup or rapidly scaling businesses.

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Strong understanding of:
    • Cold email strategy
    • Deliverability
    • Inbox placement
    • Email infrastructure
    • Outbound copywriting
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve campaign performance issues independently.
  • Experience with APIs, workflow automation, and operational systems.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and automation platforms.

Communication & Leadership

  • Excellent client-facing communication and relationship management skills.
  • Comfortable handling difficult conversations and managing expectations.
  • Strong decision-making and operational judgment.
  • Able to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience scaling client delivery or account management teams.
  • Experience working directly with founders or executive leadership.
  • Familiarity with:
    • DNS configuration
    • Domain management
    • Email warming
    • Outbound infrastructure
  • Exposure to RevOps, automation systems, and outbound analytics.
  • Experience in growth-stage startup environments.

Tools & Platforms

Candidates should have experience with:

  • Apollo.io
  • Smartlead.ai
  • Instantly.ai
  • CRM platforms
  • ChatGPT and AI tools
  • Slack
  • Google Workspace
  • Automation and API platforms

What Success Looks Like

  • High client retention and reduced churn.
  • Strong campaign deliverability and reply rates.
  • Excellent client satisfaction and account health.
  • Consistent SLA adherence and delivery quality.
  • Fast, effective resolution of campaign and operational issues.
  • Increased revenue retention through successful client outcomes.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Founder Interview
  • Final Discussion
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows the founder and hiring team to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an operations leader who can own client outcomes end-to-end, optimize cold email campaigns, improve operational systems, and thrive in a fast-moving startup environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build a scalable client delivery operation that drives measurable business results.

As part of eight&four Group's continued growth, we're acquiring a specialist influencer marketing agency that's changing the way financial brands connect with their audiences, championing financial literacy through creative and meaningful influencer partnerships. They are a first media agency to specialise in helping financial products and services providers harness the power of influencers.

With ambitious plans for the year ahead, we're looking for a Paid Social Manager to join this growing team. You will be reporing directly into Co-Founder and play a leading role in our growing Paid Media team, overseeing the delivery of paid social campaigns that drive measurable business results for our clients. This role combines technical expertise, data-driven optimisation, and creative collaboration, giving you the opportunity to shape strategy, take full ownership of campaigns, contribute to proposals, mentor team members, and build trusted client relationships.

You will also have the opportunity to develop skills beyond paid social, starting with PPC and expanding into other paid media channels, as part of your longer-term career path. We’ll support your personal learning and development with dedicated time set aside each week, while providing clear goals and milestones to help you grow.

The role is fully remote, though your attendance may occasionally be required at in-person client meetings and events. Depending on your location, there are also opportunities to work in person with other members of the team on a regular basis.

To succeed in this role, you will need a passion for social media and digital marketing, a sharp analytical mindset, and the ability to lead both people and campaigns with confidence. You will take ownership of planning, execution, optimisation, and reporting across multiple platforms, ensuring that campaigns are efficient, creative, and results-driven.

Key responsibilities include:

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Lead the planning and implementation of Influencer focused paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, X, and emerging platforms.

Client & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, providing proactive updates and strategic recommendations.

Team Development & Collaboration

raw.title: Research Fellow
raw.excerpt: OVERVIEW The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA) is hiring a Research Fellow to build the data-driven case for FGA’s reforms.
raw.description:
OVERVIEW

The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA) is hiring a Research Fellow to build the data-driven case for FGA’s reforms. In this role, you’ll produce just-in-time research tied to FGA’s legislative agenda in the states and in Washington, D.C.

Unlike in most policy research jobs, you’ll build each paper for a specific reform at a specific moment. You’ll find the hard-to-get data a policymaker partner needs before a hearing or a vote, write the paper, and see it through to launch. Then you’ll watch it show up in bills, executive orders, federal rules, testimony, and national media.

If you want to spend months on a single deep white paper, this role is not for you. If you want to work fast and stay close to the action, you’ll love it here. The ideal candidate brings three or more years in policy research, writing, or analysis. This role is remote and reports to the Research Director.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at FGA are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five Core Values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of the following questions, you may be a fit.

1) Candid to Solve: Being willing to have tough conversations in order to solve issues and build trust.

  • Do you seek out constructive feedback—and provide it to others—to solve issues and build trust with coworkers?

2) Grow or Die: We don’t have a neutral gear; we must consistently challenge ourselves and each other to grow in our talents and skills.

  • Are you aware of your strengths and weaknesses, and do you seek out complementary skills and growth in order to mitigate your weaknesses?

3) Politically Savvy: Policy doesn’t change in a vacuum, but in a political reality that we must understand and account for.

  • Do you agree that embracing the realities of politics is necessary to change public policy?

4) Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.

  • Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?

5) Bought in to Win: We’re at FGA because we want to change policy. No one is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes, that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.

  • Do you fully support FGA’s mission and believe that lives are improved through work, not welfare, and that free markets create more freedom and opportunity than government control?

These values shape how we hire and how we work together. Expect to talk about them openly during the interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As Research Fellow, you will have four primary areas of responsibility:

1) Build the Case for FGA’s Reforms

  • Write detailed outlines before drafting, and find original and hard-to-find data.
  • Master new reform areas quickly and pull in the outside sources that make FGA’s arguments stronger.

2) Write Papers That Move Policy

  • Draft two to three research papers and other products per quarter in FGA’s style, fast enough for lawmakers to use while a bill is moving.
  • Hand off clean, accurate drafts with complete citations, written for the audience that will use them.

3) Take Every Product to Launch

  • Run quality control with the Policy and Data teams, and keep the Design and Communications teams moving toward launch.
  • Review web versions before launch so papers go live without errors.

4) Put FGA Research to Work

  • Write memos, talking points, and testimony on request, and answer data and research questions from teammates and outside partners.
  • Turn your papers into op-eds and exclusives with the Communications team, and deliver presentations and briefings as needed.

REQUIREMENTS

🔹 Three or more years in policy research, writing, or analysis.

🔹 Excellent writer who turns complex policy into clear, persuasive writing.

🔹 Skilled at finding and analyzing data, and precise in presenting it.

🔹 Curious, critical thinker who picks up new policy areas fast and hits tight deadlines.

🔹 Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research and drafting.

🔹 Able to travel one to two times per quarter for team meetings and occasional briefings.

🔹 Match FGA’s Core Values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION, AND COMPENSATION

FGA is seeking to fill this position as soon as possible.

FGA’s headquarters are in Naples, FL, but nearly all of our staff work remotely from across the country. We build our systems and culture around clarity, flexibility, and strong communication. Key elements include:

  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with FGA’s big vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the FGA team, our policies, and how we operate
  • Home office setup, including equipment and communication tools you need to hit the ground running

FGA offers a competitive salary between $80,000–$110,000, depending on experience and qualifications, along with a benefits package that includes a six percent retirement match, health benefits, and generous paid leave.

raw.description:
Seeq builds advanced analytics software for customers in process manufacturing industries such as pharmaceuticals, mining, renewables, and energy — organizations with massive amounts of time-series and event data from industrial operations.

We are a fully remote company that has operated this way from the start, using tools like Zoom, Slack, and our homegrown Qube virtual office to collaborate as if we were in the same building. Our teams iterate using agile practices and care deeply about clear communication, shared learning, and delivering software that exceeds customer expectations.

Role Overview

The Senior Backend Software Engineer - AI is a hands-on engineer who helps design, build, and scale the backend platforms and AI systems supporting Seeq’s intelligent applications.

You will work on complex technical challenges involving production AI systems, agentic workflows, distributed systems, and backend platforms and agentic systems, helping establish the shared infrastructure, services, APIs, and engineering patterns that allow AI-enabled capabilities to operate reliably and safely at scale across Seeq.

This is a deeply hands-on role. You will combine experience building AI systems with strong backend and distributed systems expertise, and continued involvement in designing, coding, debugging, and shipping production software.

A Senior Software Engineer at Seeq is a highly independent and productive engineer who owns complex work, contributes to technical decisions, and begins taking on broader leadership and mentorship responsibilities. Primarily operates within their team while collaborating effectively with other teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build backend and AI platform capabilities: Contribute to architecture, patterns, and technical approaches for scalable systems supporting AI and agentic applications.
  • Deliver high-impact AI and platform initiatives: Own complex, ambiguous projects from concept through production, collaborating with engineers, teams, and stakeholders.
  • Build agentic systems: Design and build systems supporting agent routing, orchestration, tool use, evaluations, runtime infrastructure, sandboxing, and agent-to-agent communication.
  • Develop shared platform infrastructure: Define Build and improve backend services, runtime environments, interfaces, and architectural patterns that other engineering teams rely on to build AI-enabled applications.
  • Build reliable distributed and data-intensive systems: Develop backend services and APIs capable of supporting AI workloads across large data volumes and complex workflows.
  • Create reusable AI platform capabilities: Build shared services, APIs, libraries, orchestration patterns, runtime infrastructure, and developer-facing platform capabilities that enable multiple teams to build, deploy, and operate AI features consistently.
  • Improve AI evaluation and reliability: Develop and implement approaches for evaluating agentic output, monitoring system behavior, and improving the reliability, safety, and observability of AI-enabled systems.
  • Design systems integrations: Build integrations that allow AI agents, internal services, and third-party enterprise platforms to communicate effectively.
  • Drive work from idea to production: Evaluate emerging approaches and translate promising AI technologies and patterns into pragmatic, maintainable production systems.
  • Stay close to customers: Work directly with customers during early deployments, understand how AI-enabled capabilities perform in real-world environments, and incorporate those learnings back into the product.
  • Mentor and collaborate with engineers: Provide technical mentorship in backend architecture, platform engineering, agentic systems, AI engineering, and operational excellence. Share technical knowledge and support the growth of other engineers, with increasing leadership responsibilities at higher levels.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Surface risks, challenge assumptions, and identify better technical approaches rather than waiting for problems or solutions to be fully defined. Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the evolution of our backend and AI platforms.
  • Collaborate with product managers and owners to develop and hone a vision for how generative AI is used by analytics engineering teams.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in backend software engineering.
  • Recent, hands-on experience developing and deploying generative AI or agentic systems in production environments.
  • Experience building agentic capabilities, including agents, routing and orchestration, tool integration, evaluations, runtimes, sandboxing, or related infrastructure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and working knowledge of TypeScript and Java.
  • Experience with modern AI/LLM frameworks, SDKs, or orchestration tooling used to build production AI and agentic applications.
  • Familiarity with SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • Experience operating software in a SaaS environment.
  • Strong understanding of production AI concerns including reliability, monitoring, performance, cost, and failure handling.
  • Ability to evaluate emerging AI approaches and translate them into pragmatic, maintainable software.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive complex technical problems forward.
  • Experience contributing to technical decisions, collaborating across engineering teams, and sharing technical knowledge.
  • Strong communication skills and experience mentoring and supporting other engineers.
  • A desire to build, ship, and maintain software in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience developing or implementing evaluation strategies and observability for AI or agentic systems.
  • Experience deploying and operating production systems in Kubernetes or another containerized runtime environment.
  • Experience with AI or backend platform capabilities used broadly across an engineering organization.
  • Experience with retrieval architectures such as vector search, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, or RAG.
  • Experience integrating AI agents with third-party enterprise platforms.
  • Experience working with industrial, operational, or time-series data.
  • Experience building software products used by technical or engineering-focused customers.
  • A background in mechanical, chemical, process, or another engineering discipline before moving into software.

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

The Perks of Working at Seeq

  • Competitive salary plus cash bonus incentives.
    • $155,000 USD.
    • Salary range for US-based; local adjustments for other countries.
  • Benefits:
    • 12-week paid Seeq family leave
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Internet and mobile phone reimbursements

    • Group term life insurance
    • Short-term and long-term disability insurance pre-tax benefits
    • Voluntary vision and dental (ortho)
    • Vacation bonus program
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Generous home office allowance
    • The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.)

    • You love your job!

Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.
  • Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.
  • Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.
  • Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.
  • Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.

Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, weil ein Teil unseres Teams in Indien sitzt
  • Du denkst in Strukturen und machst gern aus Chaos klare Abläufe
  • Mit Fremden zu telefonieren fällt dir leicht, für dich ist es der schnellste Weg zu Antworten
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst nicht für jeden Schritt eine Anleitung
  • Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Werkzeugen und KI-Tools um
  • Du bist zuverlässig und diskret, denn du bekommst Einblick in viele Firmen

Erfahrung aus einem Startup, einer Beratung oder als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Wichtiger als der Lebenslauf sind uns Lernbereitschaft und Motivation.

Was wir bieten

  • 100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst
  • Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands ist auch Freelance möglich
  • Du lernst extrem schnell: wie Firmen entstehen, finanziert und aufgebaut werden, in über 20 Firmen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und Phasen
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern zusammen
  • Du baust etwas Eigenes: Die Prozesse und Systeme, die du schaffst, tragen am Ende die ganze Maschine
  • Ein klarer Weg nach oben: Wer sich bewährt, wird Chief of Staff und hat Karriereperspektiven bis in die Geschäftsführung oder auf C-Level

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte vier kurze Fragen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Fragen vorab beantwortet Felix Wilhelm gern unter +49 176 95422094.

raw.description:
Reports To: North America Sales Director

Company Overview

Founded in 1947, Pulpdent Corporation is an industry-leading dental research and manufacturing company. Pulpdent’s corporate headquarters, research laboratory, and manufacturing facilities are located in Watertown, Massachusetts, in the Boston metro area. Its products are distributed globally. Pulpdent is a third-generation, family-owned business widely respected for its innovative products and authentic company culture, which promotes work-life balance, employee retention, and product excellence. The enduring hallmarks of the Pulpdent brand are imagination, dedication, and empowerment, each inspiring the daily work of Pulpdent’s employees.
To meet the continued demand for our dental materials in the United States, we are hiring a Strategic Accounts Manager to develop and grow strategic relationships with Dental Service Organizations (DSOs), community health centers, and other key group accounts. To learn more about Pulpdent, including its breakthrough advances in bioactive dental materials and commitment to ethical business practices, visit pulpdent.com.

Job Description

The Strategic Accounts Manager is an ambitious, self-motivated leader eager to define – and continuously refine – Pulpdent’s channel sales strategy in a rapidly changing commercial landscape. This business development professional blends relationship-building skills with analytical acumen to target key accounts, build relationships, and negotiate contracts with DSOs, CHCs, GPOs, and universities.
The Strategic Account Manager owns the revenue attainment objectives for the Multisite, Government, and Education Markets. The SAM is responsible for developing and executing the sales strategy that identifies growth opportunities, strengthens customer relationships, expands portfolio adoption and aligns Pulpdent's objectives with Dealer partners in this segment of the market.
The SAM builds trusted relationships with segment decision markers, champions, influencers, and dealer partners that lead to a sustained, meaningful presence for Pulpdent in the market.
Working collaboratively with the Pulpdent Commercial team and reporting to the North American Sales Director; the SAM translates segment priorities, organizational structures, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities into commercial strategies and executable initiatives.

Essential Functions
  • Strategic Account Planning & Growth
    • Develop and execute customized strategic account plans in collaboration with the North American Sales Director
    • Develop and refine channel sales strategy in alignment with Pulpdent’s broader growth.
    • Establish standard operating procedures and qualification criteria to support this strategy.
    • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize growth opportunities across assigned accounts
    • Establish account-specific development plans to expand product adoption.
    • Maintain current knowledge of account organizational structures, key decision-makers, personnel changes, purchasing processes, and evolving business priorities.
    • Establish a business review cadence with account and dealer partners to address performance, identify opportunities, and review contracts.
  • Customer Relationship Management & Commercial Leadership
    • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned accounts, maintaining regular communication and proactively addressing customer needs, challenges, and opportunities.
    • Partner with local Pulpdent sales representatives and sales leadership to align account strategies, coordinate customer engagement, share competitive intelligence, and address account-specific challenges.
    • Maintain close relationships with key distribution personnel to support account development, improve coordination, and drive sales growth.
    • Represent Pulpdent professionally at customer meetings, strategic planning sessions, industry events, and other relevant engagements.
  • Sales Pipeline & Performance Management
    • Construct and negotiate contracts that optimize for customer satisfaction and Pulpdent’s bottom-line growth.
    • Own the sales opportunity pipeline, monitor progress against account plans and sales objectives, and review pipeline performance and growth opportunities with the North American Sales Director monthly.
    • Utilize CRM and Data sets consistently to document sales activity, maintain accurate account and opportunity information, track follow-up activities, and provide visibility into pipeline health and expected business outcomes.
    • Analyze account performance, identify gaps between sales objectives and results, and recommend actionable strategies to address challenges and capture additional opportunities including pricing adjustments and contract renegotiations.
  • Product Education & Customer Engagement
    • Deliver high-quality product training and education to new customers and new staff within existing accounts to support product knowledge, confidence, and adoption.
    • Work with territory managers to coordinate product training and continuing education opportunities for key accounts
    • Expertly present Pulpdent products and solutions in a manner that aligns with segments objectives.
    • Participate in relevant dental industry trade shows, conferences, and regularly scheduled dental meetings throughout the United States.
    • Maintain a strong understanding of Pulpdent’s products, the dental marketplace, competitive offerings, and emerging customer needs to provide relevant solutions and support informed purchasing decisions.
  • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
    • Collaborate with the North American Sales Director, territory managers, and distribution partners to share account intelligence, communicate best practices, and improve the effectiveness of sales strategies.
    • Contribute customer feedback and market insights to help inform sales priorities, product education, and business development initiatives.
    • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in outside sales; dental sales experience preferred but not required.
  • Knowledgeable in Formulary, RFP, and group purchasing protocols.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic sales plans, manage a pipeline of opportunities, and follow through on account growth initiatives.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish trust and credibility with executive decision-makers, clinical leaders, and distribution partners.
  • Strong strategic planning, analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent planning, organizational, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, prioritize competing demands, and manage a geographically dispersed portfolio of accounts.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional colleagues and contribute to shared business objectives.
  • Professional, proactive, and positive attitude, with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to motivate and influence others.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM platforms preferred.
Work Environment & Physical Demands
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30–50% of the time throughout the United States.
  • Ability to attend regularly scheduled dental meetings, industry conferences, customer meetings, and other relevant events across the country.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining effective communication and collaboration with colleagues and leadership.
We Offer
  • Competitive salary and commission, this position is bonus eligible
  • Medical and dental insurance, and flexible spending account (FSA) plan and HSA plan
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance and life insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Paid time off (PTO) and standard holidays
  • Opportunity for professional development and future career growth
Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.
PULPDENT® is an equal opportunity employer. We employ a diverse workforce and encourage people of all backgrounds to apply for employment.
