Client Success Manager

Location: Remote, Canada (preferred) or United States
Employment Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor
Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–5 PM (Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time)
Base Compensation: USD $60,000–$70,000 per year
Target OTE: Approximately USD $80,000–$90,000 per year, negotiable based on experience
Performance Incentives: Mainly tied to quarterly client retention, with additional bonuses for client testimonials

About the Company

Our client is a done-for-you Meta advertising and appointment-setting agency. It supports medspas and aesthetic wellness businesses across the United States. As its client portfolio grows, the agency is hiring a dedicated Client Success Manager to build a consistent, proactive experience for clients after the sale.

The Opportunity

You’ll own the experience of about 40 agency clients. That covers onboarding, campaign launch, ongoing service, retention, and renewal support. You’ll be clients’ main point of contact and the bridge between them and the creative, media buying, appointment-setting, sales, and operations teams.

This is a client relationship and coordination role. It is not a hands-on media buying position. You’ll also help shape the agency’s first dedicated Client Success function, including the processes and playbook the team will rely on as it scales.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead structured client onboarding, coordinate handoffs from sales to delivery, set expectations, and document client goals and success metrics.
  • Manage a portfolio of about 40 client relationships through scheduled check-ins.
  • Respond to client Slack messages within 24 hours on business days.
  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date.
  • Spot dissatisfaction and at-risk accounts early, coordinate recovery plans, and support renewals and retention.
  • Turn client concerns into clear actions for the creative, media buying, appointment-setting, and operations teams, and follow through until they’re resolved.
  • Prepare client-facing performance updates and maintain a portfolio health dashboard that leadership can see.
  • Improve onboarding checklists and SOPs, and build a repeatable Client Success playbook.
  • Track retention, NPS trends, response times, and onboarding SLAs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Annual client retention of 93% or higher.
  • Every new-client onboarding completed within agreed SLAs.
  • Every client contacted according to the established check-in schedule.
  • Client interactions logged in the CRM within 24 hours, and churn risks identified before they escalate.

Your First 90 Days

  • Days 1–30: Learn the client journey, tools, account history, and existing team workflows.
  • Days 31–60: Begin managing about 10–20 accounts on your own, set up regular check-ins, and track account health.
  • Days 61–90: Work toward full portfolio ownership, report on retention health, and recommend process improvements.

Earning Potential

  • Base: USD $60,000–$70,000 per year.
  • Variable: Performance incentives are mainly tied to quarterly client retention, with additional bonuses for client testimonials. Detailed retention bonus tiers will be shared before the offer stage.
  • Target OTE: The total target earning opportunity is approximately USD $80,000–$90,000 per year, negotiable based on experience. Earnings above base depend on performance and are not guaranteed.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • About 1–2 years of relevant experience in client success, account management, customer service, or a client-facing agency role. Exceptional transferable experience will also be considered.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with confident client communication.
  • Empathy, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Strong organization and follow-through while managing multiple accounts and competing priorities.
  • Proactive problem-solving and comfort working with distributed teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to understand basic marketing performance reports and explain practical next steps to clients.
  • Based in Canada (preferred) or the United States.
  • Available Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–5 PM Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medspas, aesthetics, or wellness, or experience supporting growth at a medspa.
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel, ClickUp or similar project management tools, and Meta Ads Manager. These platforms can be taught.

Benefits

  • Fully remote role for candidates in Canada or the United States.
  • Consistent Monday–Friday daytime schedule.
  • Competitive USD base compensation of $60,000–$70,000 per year.
  • Performance incentives tied to quarterly client retention, plus bonuses for client testimonials. Target OTE is approximately USD $80,000–$90,000.
  • Training on the agency’s platforms, including GoHighLevel, ClickUp, and Meta Ads Manager.
  • Chance to help build the agency’s first dedicated Client Success function and shape its processes and playbook.
  • Room to grow as the agency scales, with potential paths to Senior Client Success Manager and Head of Client Success.

Wir sind eine unabhängige Digital-Performance-Agentur aus Deutschland und verbinden über 25 Jahre Marketing-Erfahrung mit AI, First-Party Data, eigener Technologie und datengetriebenen Lösungen.

Als Senior SEA & Google Ads Manager steuerst und entwickelst Du anspruchsvolle Accounts für führende internationale Kunden. Gleichzeitig hinterfragst Du bestehende Ansätze, testest neue Möglichkeiten und gestaltest gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft des Search und AI Advertising.

Aufgaben

Dein Spielfeld:

  • Du gibst die Richtung vor.
    Du steuerst anspruchsvolle nationale und internationale Search-Accounts und entwickelst die strategische Roadmap für nachhaltiges Wachstum.
  • Du findest Hebel, die andere übersehen.
    Tracking, Feeds, Automatisierung, Skripte und Conversion-Daten sind für Dich keine Einzeldisziplinen, sondern die Grundlage für bessere Entscheidungen und messbar mehr Performance.
  • Sparringspartner:
    Du hinterfragst Briefings, bringst eigene Ideen ein und berätst Kunden auf Augenhöhe. In Pitches überzeugst Du mit Substanz, Klarheit und einem echten Verständnis für das Business.
  • Du arbeitest an dem, was als Nächstes kommt.
    Du testest neue Google-Ads-Features, AI-Anwendungen und Werbeplattformen wie ChatGPT Ads, bevor sie zum Standard werden – und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungen für unsere Kunden und unser Team.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Erfahrung, die Wirkung zeigt.
    Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Full-Funnel-SEA und komplexe Google-Ads-Accounts bereits erfolgreich gesteuert. Agenturerfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Du analysierst messerscharf.
    Du erkennst Muster, hinterfragst Ergebnisse und trennst echte Ursachen von Zufällen. Aus komplexen Daten leitest Du klare Entscheidungen, Tests und konkrete Wachstumshebel ab.
  • Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben.
    Du siehst Potenziale früh, entwickelst eigene Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Du bringst Themen aktiv voran, statt nur Briefings abzuarbeiten.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend.
    Du beherrschst Deutsch verhandlungssicher und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln – intern wie im direkten Austausch mit Kunden. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
  • Du beherrschst den modernen SEA-Stack.
    Google Ads, Search Ads 360, Merchant Center, Tracking und Analytics gehören für Dich zum Alltag. Entscheidend ist nicht nur, dass Du die Tools bedienen kannst, sondern dass Du aus ihnen bessere Entscheidungen ableitest.

Benefits

Was wir Dir bieten:

  • 100 % remote und flexibel.
    Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und ohne unnötige Präsenzpflicht.
  • Verantwortung statt Micromanagement.
    Du bekommst den Freiraum, Strategien mitzugestalten, eigene Ideen umzusetzen und Themen wirklich voranzubringen.
  • Tech, Data und AI statt Agenturstandard.
    Du arbeitest mit modernen Marketing-Technologien, unseren eigenen Tools und erfahrenen Spezialisten aus Search, Data und Tech.
  • Benefits, die zählen.
    EGYM Wellpass, Bike-Leasing, moderne Ausstattung und ein fachlich starkes Team.

So einfach bewirbst Du Dich

Auf ein klassisches Anschreiben verzichten wir. Schick uns einfach Deinen CV und ein kurzes Video, zum Beispiel über Loom.

Erzähl uns darin in zwei bis drei Minuten:

  • Welche SEA-Strategie oder welcher Case Dich zuletzt besonders begeistert hat
  • Wie Du an komplexe Herausforderungen herangehst
  • Was Dich fachlich und persönlich auszeichnet

Schaue Dir gerne dieses Video zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess an:

Ein Video ist fester Bestandteil Deiner Bewerbung und hilft uns, neben Deiner Erfahrung auch Deine Denkweise und Persönlichkeit kennenzulernen.

Ohne Video können wir Deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen.

Wir freuen uns darauf, mehr über Dich zu erfahren!

This is a relationship-driven, high-ticket sales role — not transactional or high-volume cold sales. You’ll own the client journey from initial inquiry through booking and post-flight follow-up while delivering a polished, white-glove experience.

If you have strong sales instincts, thrive around premium clientele, and know how to build trust quickly, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Private Jet Charter Sales

  • Convert qualified opportunities into closed bookings
  • Understand client travel requirements and recommend tailored flight solutions
  • Guide clients through aircraft selection, pricing, and booking
  • Maximize revenue while maintaining premium service standards
  • Follow up consistently to move opportunities toward close

High-Net-Worth Client Relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with high-value and repeat clients
  • Deliver personalized, white-glove communication
  • Manage the experience from inquiry → booking → flight → follow-up
  • Anticipate client needs and proactively address questions or concerns
  • Drive repeat business through exceptional service

Charter Coordination

  • Communicate pricing, logistics, and booking details clearly
  • Coordinate closely with internal teams to ensure seamless execution

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Track opportunities, bookings, follow-ups, and client interactions
  • Maintain clear pipeline visibility and organized client records
  • Ensure no high-value opportunity falls through the cracks

On-Call Client Support

  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule
  • Respond professionally to time-sensitive charter requests
  • Remain calm and solutions-focused when plans change quickly
  • Help maintain reliable client coverage outside standard hours when scheduled

Requirements

  • Proven experience in sales, high-ticket sales, or relationship-driven client-facing roles
  • Strong closing and relationship-building ability
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Professional, polished communication style suitable for high-net-worth clients
  • Strong follow-up and organizational skills
  • CRM experience, including Salesforce or similar platforms
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable working EST hours and participating in rotating on-call coverage

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Avinode or similar charter platforms
  • Understanding of private jet models, cabin configurations, and aircraft capabilities
  • Knowledge of Part 135 operations

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong inquiry-to-booking conversion rates
  • Consistent charter revenue generation
  • Fast response times to client inquiries
  • High client satisfaction and repeat business
  • Strong relationships with high-value clients
  • Accurate CRM and pipeline management

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have experience selling high-value services, excel at building lasting client relationships, and can deliver the level of responsiveness and professionalism expected in private aviation and luxury travel, we’d love to hear from you.

About Relay

Relay is hiring remote outbound SDRs to book meetings for our B2B clients. We care more about what you have done on the phone than what your job title said. If you can show us your numbers, we would love to hear from you.

The work

You will make outbound calls, on our dialler, to book qualified meetings for Relay’s clients. You choose how you work, as long as you deliver. This is a fully remote role where you provide your own computer, internet connection, and headset.

The expectation is 50 conversations a week with decision makers. Dials are vanity metrics, we care about conversations, and meetings that actually take place.

What we remove

In most other sales roles, the calling gets squeezed by everything around it. At Relay, we have eliminated that. We handle the enriched list building and the research behind the scenes. We take care of the emails and the follow-up, even the follow-ups. We do everything. We even have AI taking the notes from your call transcripts, so you do not have to write notes in the CRM. Everything that bogs you down day to day in another SDR or sales role, we have removed, so you can focus on what you do best: great conversations.

What we want to see

Performance is what matters here, so we will ask about results rather than titles:

  • How many conversations do you hold, and with whom?

  • How many meetings have you booked, and over what period?

  • Did you hit target? By how much?

  • How did you rank against your peers?

Be honest with us. Real numbers, even modest ones, tell us far more than a polished CV, and they help us both work out quickly whether this is the right fit.

We look for tenacity (sustained activity and output), curiosity (the questions you actually ask), and resilience (what you do after a no, and whether you keep going).

What we offer

This is an uncapped commission-led opportunity, with 1:2:1 coaching to accelerate your growth.

Technical Coordinator

Location: Remote – Ireland, United Kingdom or Sweden
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Working Arrangement: Remote, with occasional international travel as required
Reporting to: Technical Manager

About Crown

Crown is an Irish, family-owned specialist contractor established in 1993, delivering high-quality roofing, cladding and façade solutions across Ireland, the UK and mainland Europe.

We work across a diverse range of sectors, including hyperscale data centres, pharmaceutical, commercial and industrial, delivering complex projects for some of the world's leading organisations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Technical Coordinator to join our growing team, working remotely from Ireland, the United Kingdom or Sweden.

Reporting to the Technical Manager, you will coordinate technical activities and documentation, supporting projects from mobilisation through to site operations.

Working closely with the Technical, Commercial, Procurement and Project teams, you will help ensure technical submissions, supplier information and approvals are progressed in line with project requirements and programme deadlines.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented technical professional with experience in roofing, cladding or façade construction to support major international projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and coordinate technical submittals, calculations and supporting documentation.
  • Review project specifications, drawings and Bills of Quantities.
  • Maintain project trackers, monitoring technical packages, supplier lead times and approvals.
  • Liaise with suppliers to obtain technical information, product data and calculations.
  • Coordinate samples and client approvals.
  • Maintain procurement schedules and flag potential delays.
  • Coordinate O&M manuals, warranties, certificates and handover documentation.
  • Work closely with Technical, Commercial, Procurement and Project teams to ensure information and approvals progress in line with project requirements.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in a similar role within a roofing, cladding or façade contractor.
  • Third-level qualification in Engineering, Architectural Technology, Project Management or a related discipline.
  • Strong understanding of building envelope systems.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and project specifications.
  • Experience with technical submittals and project documentation.
  • Familiarity with Common Data Environments (CDEs).
  • Excellent organisational, communication and IT skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to work remotely and collaborate effectively with international project teams.

Benefits

What Crown Offers

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Opportunity to support major international construction projects.
  • Join an established, family-owned Irish contractor with a growing European presence.
  • Work alongside experienced Technical and Project teams.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

Interested?

If you have experience in technical coordination within the roofing, cladding or façade sector and are looking for a remote opportunity supporting major international projects, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about joining the Crown team.

raw.description:
Location: Remote (USA). Travel up to 25%.

Reports To: Manager, Implementation

About the Role

The Implementation Lead owns each client engagement from kickoff through go-live and transition to Customer Success and Technical Support. You will run the Design phase with the client's core team, build and configure the entire account in Ottimate (backend and UI), and bring in the Enablement Consultant for UI training and adoption. When an engagement needs integration setup, custom development, or a data migration, you will scope it and work with the Technical Consultant team to deliver it.

This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable completing an assessment to check a client's data and just as comfortable leading a workflow mapping session with a Controller. An accounting or AP background is beneficial, because you will advise clients on approval policies, coding structures, and payment processes, and you need to understand why they work the way they do.

Responsibilities

Engagement ownership

  • Own the engagement end to end: project plan, milestones, risks, status reporting, and go-live readiness
  • Build a plan around each client's entities, ERP, volume, and complexity, and keep it current as scope changes
  • Run kickoff, set expectations with executive sponsors and the client project team, and hold both sides accountable to their commitments (data, decisions, approvers, testing, etc)
  • Transition to Customer Success at the end of the engagement with clear documentation of the configuration decisions made and the reasons for them

Design phase

  • Lead the Design sessions: workflow mapping, approval policy consultation, invoice data capture consultation, payments, and integrations
  • Map each client's current AP process and recommend how to restructure it so that Ottimate's automation removes manual steps
  • Turn the decisions from these sessions into a written design and get client sign-off before building
  • Identify early which clients need integration work, custom development, or a data migration, and bring in the Technical Consultant team with a defined scope

Build & configuration

  • Build and configure the entire account, backend and UI: users and roles, approval workflows, coding and GL structures, vendor setup, invoice data capture settings, and payment configuration
  • Use required tools to analyze, validate, and correct client data and to troubleshoot configuration issues
  • Lead user acceptance testing with the client, resolve issues, and confirm go-live readiness

Technical scoping & troubleshooting

  • Evaluate each client's ERP environment and data structures to identify integration considerations
  • Triage technical issues to determine whether they are a data or mapping problem, a configuration problem, or an engineering issue, and escalate with a clear write-up when needed

Enablement & adoption transition

  • Give the Enablement Consultant the design documentation and configuration context needed to build client-specific UI training, and schedule training ahead of go-live
  • Stay involved through go-live and early adoption so the engagement ends with the client working in the platform, not just configured in it

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to give clients one consistent experience and to resolve issues quickly
  • Report product gaps and recurring implementation issues to Product and Engineering with enough detail to prioritize them

Requirements

Experience

  • 4-6 years in SaaS implementation, professional services, or technical consulting - owning complex client implementations from start to finish
  • Working SQL skills preferred - you can write queries to analyze, validate, and transform client data without help
  • Hands-on experience configuring a workflow-driven platform and comfort building a full account yourself
  • Working knowledge of ERP and accounting systems (for example NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics BC) and of how AP workflows function within them: invoice coding, GL mapping, PO matching, and payment runs
  • Familiarity with integration methods used in AP automation (EDI, API-based connections, SFTP or file-based feeds), enough to scope the work and know when to bring in the Technical Consultant team
  • Accounting background is beneficial, such as AP or controller experience, an accounting degree, or a CPA

Skills & qualities

  • Strong facilitation and consulting skills - you can lead workshops with finance leaders and turn their requirements into a design
  • Strong project management skills - timelines, risk management, and stakeholder communication across several engagements at once
  • A strong sense of ownership and a proactive approach to finding and fixing problems
  • Clear communicator who builds strong client relationships
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

Benefits

We care deeply about making Ottimate an incredible place to work and invest a significant amount of time and energy into creating and maintaining a company culture that provides our team with a generous level of support whilst inspiring them to do their best work.

The specific benefits/perks we offer are continually evolving, but currently include:

  • Compensation: Range is $110,000 to $135,000 USD a year plus
  • Work from home in an energetic remote-first environment that supports flexible working hours and understands work-life balance.
  • Competitive salary based on skills & experience.
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and other Company-Subsidized Benefits for you and your family.
  • Employer sponsored 401(k) with company match.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (and the encouragement to use it).
  • Promote from within philosophy.

Beyond the tangible benefits though:

  • You will be part of a growing team, at a pinnacle moment of scale for the business, and experience the excitement of working in a startup where each action makes a huge difference.
  • You will have the agency to solve difficult problems creatively, the freedom to explore work that inspires you, and infrastructure to ensure you're constantly challenged and developing.
  • You will work with sharp, passionate teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and positioning our product as a premier finance automation solution.
  • Our commitment to empowering a diverse and inclusive workforce, celebrating differences, and creating a safe space for our employees to bring their whole selves to work is second to none.
  • We are transforming entire industries using innovative technology including Artificial Intelligence, Payment Tech, and Neural Networks.
  • Our leaders lead with a people-first approach; inspiring excellence, nurturing ideas, and finding creative ways to eliminate obstacles for cultivating growth.
  • We truly love what we do and who we do it with - and we think you will too!

Ottimate is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or marital status. If you are excited about the role but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. Nothing in this job posting should be construed as an offer or guarantee of employment.

raw.description:
The Group Controller is responsible for overseeing the overall financial management, accounting operations, and financial reporting functions across the Group and its subsidiaries. This role ensures the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of financial information across multiple business entities while maintaining compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
The position provides strategic financial guidance to senior management, drives financial planning and performance monitoring, strengthens internal controls, and ensures effective financial governance across the organization. The Group Controller will also lead and develop the finance and accounting teams while supporting business growth, operational efficiency, and long-term financial sustainability.
Key Responsibilities
1. Group Financial Management & Consolidation
  • Oversee the overall accounting and financial management functions across the Group and its subsidiaries.
  • Lead the preparation, review, and consolidation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial reporting across different business entities.
  • Monitor the financial performance of individual entities and the consolidated Group, identifying variances, risks, and opportunities.
  • Establish standardized accounting policies, procedures, and reporting practices across the organization.
2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Analysis
  • Lead the Group's annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes.
  • Monitor financial performance against approved budgets and business objectives.
  • Provide financial analysis, management reports, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.
  • Evaluate business performance, profitability, cost structures, and financial trends across subsidiaries.
  • Recommend strategies to improve financial efficiency, profitability, and resource allocation.
3. Financial Controls, Governance & Compliance
  • Establish, implement, and maintain effective financial policies, internal controls, and governance frameworks across the Group.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory requirements, and corporate policies.
  • Monitor financial processes and identify potential control weaknesses, implementing corrective measures where necessary.
  • Ensure proper financial documentation, accountability, and transparency across all entities.
  • Oversee financial risk management and ensure appropriate measures are in place to safeguard company assets.
4. Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
  • Oversee Group-wide cash flow planning, liquidity management, and working capital requirements.
  • Monitor cash positions, funding requirements, receivables, payables, and financial obligations across subsidiaries.
  • Develop strategies to optimize cash utilization and strengthen financial stability.
  • Monitor debt exposure and support financing-related decisions in coordination with senior management.
5. Tax Management & Audit Coordination
  • Oversee tax planning, compliance, and statutory reporting across the Group.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory agencies.
  • Lead internal and external audit activities, ensuring timely completion and resolution of audit findings.
  • Ensure that all subsidiaries maintain proper accounting records and remain audit-ready.
  • Monitor changes in financial regulations and assess their potential impact on the Group.
6. Executive & Business Partnering
  • Work closely with the CFO, senior management, and business unit heads on financial strategies and business performance.
  • Present consolidated financial reports, management accounts, and financial recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Provide financial guidance on business expansion, investments, operational initiatives, and other strategic decisions.
  • Partner with different departments to ensure financial discipline and alignment with overall business objectives.
7. Leadership & Process Improvement
  • Lead, supervise, and develop the Group's finance and accounting teams.
  • Establish performance standards and ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial outputs.
  • Strengthen coordination and collaboration among finance teams across different entities.
  • Drive process improvements, standardization, and automation of accounting and financial reporting processes.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related field.
  • Must be a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
  • At least 8–10 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance, with significant exposure to financial management and controllership.
  • Previous experience handling group-level finance, multi-entity accounting, or financial consolidation is highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of financial reporting standards, accounting principles, taxation, internal controls, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and cash flow management.
  • Experience in managing external audits and implementing financial policies and control frameworks.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing and developing finance and accounting teams.
  • Strong analytical, strategic planning, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency in ERP/accounting systems and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

raw.description:
Job Title:Team Manager, Landlord Database

Location: Fully Remote with an occasional travel to office.

Brand:LRG

About Us:

LRG are an award-winning national property company, who are going through exciting periods of growth and offer tailored training and development programmes at all levels. With over 300 branches across England and Wales we have a reputation for perfection and delivering an outstanding customer experience. Investment in people is built into our culture, and there are opportunities for driven individuals to achieve their career aspirations within the company.

Job Summary and key responsibilities :

The Landlord Database Manager will be responsible for overseeing the successful implementation, ongoing management and maintenance of the Landlord Database across LRG.

The role will ensure that all required landlord compliance documentation and tenancy information is accurately uploaded, maintained and audited in line with regulatory requirements and agreed deadlines.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Landlord Database Rollout and Implementation

  • Lead and coordinate the phased rollout of the Landlord Database across LRG.

  • Oversee the upload of landlord compliance documentation and tenancy information, ensuring all required records are completed within the relevant deadlines.

  • Manage the process for landlords who have delegated responsibility to LRG to upload and maintain documentation on their behalf.

  • Ensure compliance documents, including Gas Safety Certificates (GSCs), Electrical Installation Condition Reports (EICRs) and Energy Performance Certificates (EPCs), are accurately retrieved from Reapit and uploaded to the government database where required.

  • Oversee the accurate input of tenancy information, including rental amounts, household and occupier details, HMO status and property licensing information.

  • Develop and maintain a structured rollout plan with clear milestones, deadlines and performance targets.

  • Monitor progress, identify potential delays and implement appropriate actions to ensure deadlines are achieved.

  • Work closely with Property Management, branch teams, Service Delivery, QA and IT to resolve issues and support a successful rollout.

  • Provide regular progress reports to senior management, highlighting completion rates, outstanding actions and potential risks.

2. Team Management

  • Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the team.

  • Allocate workloads and establish clear daily, weekly and monthly productivity targets.

  • Monitor individual and team performance against agreed KPIs and service standards.

  • Ensure the team receives appropriate training, guidance and ongoing support.

  • Implement quality assurance checks to ensure documentation and tenancy information are uploaded accurately.

  • Identify performance concerns and provide coaching and development where required.

  • Manage team capacity and resources to ensure workloads are completed within agreed timescales.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement and high-quality service delivery.

3. Auditing and Quality Assurance

  • Develop and maintain a structured auditing programme to ensure information held on the Landlord Database is accurate and complete.

  • Conduct regular audits of uploaded documentation and tenancy records.

  • Identify missing, incorrect or outdated information and ensure appropriate corrective action is taken.

  • Monitor audit findings and implement improvements to reduce recurring errors.

  • Ensure appropriate records and audit trails are maintained.

  • Identify potential compliance risks and escalate concerns where necessary.

4. Stakeholder Management and Communication

  • Act as the central point of contact for operational matters relating to the Landlord Database.

  • Build effective working relationships with Property Management, branch teams, Service Delivery, QA, IT and senior management.

  • Provide clear guidance and updates to the wider business regarding processes, responsibilities and deadlines.

  • Ensure issues and escalations are managed promptly and effectively.

What are we looking for:

  • Previous experience in a management or team leadership role, ideally within property management, lettings, compliance or a regulated administrative environment.

  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Experience managing high-volume administrative processes and maintaining accurate records.

  • Proven ability to manage, motivate and develop teams.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and quality assurance.

  • Experience developing, implementing and monitoring operational processes and procedures.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to identify operational risks, resolve issues and implement improvements.

  • Experience monitoring KPIs, managing workloads and producing performance reports.

  • Confident using databases, property management systems and Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to work independently, make informed decisions and take ownership of operational delivery

What we can offer you:

  • Proven track record for career growth and advancement within the company

  • Market leading training and ongoing professional development

  • Supportive and collaborative team environment

Benefits:

  • Competitive base salary and Commission structure

  • Quarterly and yearly awards

  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme

  • Generous Holiday allowance.

LRG are an equal opportunities employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We look forward to welcoming a dedicated individual to our team who shares our commitment to excellence in the Real Estate Industry.

LRG does not engage the services of Recruitment agencies for the purpose of hiring. All job openings are managed directly by our Internal Recruitment team. We do not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate referral from Recruitment agencies, and any such submissions will not be considered.

Job Description:

ICAM DevOps Engineer – AKS & GitLab Automation Services


GDIT has an opportunity for a seasoned DevOps and Platform Engineering leader with 15+ years of experience designing, implementing, and governing enterprise-scale cloud platforms, CI/CD ecosystems, and Kubernetes-based application modernization initiatives. Proven expertise leading Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) platform strategy, GitLab automation services, Infrastructure as Code, and secure cloud-native architectures within highly regulated environments.

This is a fully remote position.


Meaningful Work and Personal Impact:
The ideal candidate is a hands-on DevOps engineer with deep experience in AKS, GitLab pipeline automation, container orchestration, and cloud-native operational patterns. You will lead engineering teams by providing secure, repeatable build-and-release automation while ensuring services are deployed reliably and monitored effectively.

Your work directly improves deployment velocity, operational resilience, and modernization efforts in support of enterprise ICAM mission requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, governance, and lifecycle management of enterprise Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) platforms supporting mission-critical applications and services.
  • Define and implement enterprise DevSecOps strategies leveraging GitLab CI/CD, GitOps methodologies, automated security controls, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Build and maintain Helm charts, YAML manifests, templates, and reusable AKS deployment patterns.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM) for provisioning and managing cluster and cloud resources.
  • Collaborate with application teams to containerize applications, troubleshoot deployments, and optimize runtime performance.
  • Implement and maintain observability tools (Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK) for monitoring cluster health, logs, and metrics.
  • Ensure secure handling of secrets, certificates, and configuration values using Key Vault or equivalent tools.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex production incidents involving AKS clusters, networking, service mesh technologies, container platforms, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Document operational procedures, IaC patterns, deployment workflows, troubleshooting guides, and DevOps standards.
  • Support Zero Trust, compliance, and enterprise security requirements through hardened DevOps practices.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 15 years supporting DevOps, DevSecOps, Microservices, or ICAM services in government or regulated environments
  • Active Secret Clearance at minimum. Interim Secret Clearances are not allowed.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, technical certifications or training, or work experience.
  • DoD 8140 certification (Security+ CE or higher)

Required Skills/Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes operations, container lifecycle, networking, scaling, and security
  • Expertise with GitLab (runners, pipeline configuration, security scanning, artifact management)
  • Proficient with Docker, Helm, YAML, and Kubernetes manifests
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
  • Ability to troubleshoot cluster issues, deployments, pods, services, and containerized workloads
  • Excellent documentation and cross-team collaboration skills

Desired Skills/Knowledge:

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, ArgoCD, Flux, or other GitOps tools
  • Experience integrating AKS with identity and access controls (AAD workload identities, managed identities)
  • Experience with container security scanning, SAST/DAST, and vulnerability management
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, enterprise cloud security, and compliance frameworks

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
  • Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace


OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career in software development at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your dedication to advancing innovation.

The likely salary range for this position is $170,000 - $230,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. raw.title: Head of Operations / Fund Middle Office - US
raw.excerpt: Allocator One Group is a global investing platform redefining how institutional capital reaches private markets.
raw.description:
Allocator One Group is a global investing platform redefining how institutional capital reaches private markets. We operate through two synergistic businesses:

  • Allocator One backs exceptional first- and second-time fund managers around the world—acting as “seed-investor + platform” for emerging VC funds.
  • Infra One, our fund-ops and tech arm, provides the regulatory, administrative, and tech infrastructure that allows those new funds to scale rapidly and globally. We are already live and serving customers in the UK, US, Austria, Germany and launching Singapore, India and Luxembourg imminently.

Together, we deliver both the capital and the structure fund managers need—and in doing so build a global ecosystem of platforms, people, and ideas that reshape private markets.

This role is one of the four foundational roles that we are hiring for to establish Infra One's US operating platform. These are not narrow, siloed functions. Each role is an architect of the Infra One US operating system—building the regulatory, operational, and financial infrastructure that will enable dozens of GPs to scale with confidence.

Tasks

The Role: Architect of Investor Onboarding & Trade Operations

You are the operational backbone of the Infra One platform. You own investor onboarding (KYC/AML), investor register management, trade capture and reconciliation, position tracking, and the coordination between GPs, fund accounting, custodians, and compliance. You are the glue between investment activity and clean operational execution.

More broadly, you are building repeatable processes and checklists for bringing new GPs into the platform and scaling to 5, 10, 20+ funds. You will mentor operations analysts and define the operating standards that enable Infra One to service multiple GPs simultaneously without error or friction.

Key Responsibilities

Investor Onboarding & Administration

  • Design and execute KYC/AML procedures: investor verification, beneficial ownership documentation, sanctions screening, ongoing monitoring.
  • Maintain investor registers: track admissions, capital commitments, account statuses, and investor contact information.
  • Coordinate investor closings: collect signatures, wire instructions, tax forms (W-8BEN, W-9, etc.), and data entry.
  • Produce investor notices, capital call communications, and distribution instructions; ensure timely and accurate delivery.

Trade Capture & Reconciliation

  • Establish procedures for capturing investment decisions from GPs and translating them into fund accounting entries.
  • Reconcile trade data between GPs, fund accounting, custodian, and investor records; flag discrepancies daily/weekly.
  • Maintain position databases and update them as investments are made, marked, exited, or distributed.
  • Coordinate with fund accounting on cutoff, accruals, and performance metrics.

Data Governance & Process

  • Design data entry standards, naming conventions, and error prevention procedures.
  • Establish backup and disaster recovery procedures for critical operational data.
  • Build repeatable onboarding checklists for new GPs: investor admissions, legal documentation handoffs, position tracking setup.
  • Coordinate with IT on operational systems and data security.

Stakeholder Management

  • Interface with GPs on investor admissions, trade confirmations, and any operational questions.
  • Coordinate with custodians on asset positioning, confirmations, and month-end reconciliation.
  • Support the CCO on compliance evidence gathering (investor records, approvals, decision logs).
  • Support fund accounting on investor reporting data and K-1 preparation.

Vendor Coordination

  • Manage relationships with third-party service providers: custodians, auditors, tax advisors.
  • Ensure service levels are met and escalate any issues to the MD.

Requirements

What You Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • 6–12 years of operations/middle office experience at a PE firm, hedge fund, venture platform, or fund administrator.
  • Hands-on experience with investor onboarding, KYC/AML, and investor register management.
  • Strong knowledge of fund operational workflows: trade capture, reconciliation, and position tracking.
  • Prior experience managing 2+ funds simultaneously and coordinating across investment, accounting, and compliance teams.
  • Exposure to fund administration platforms and workflow management tools.

Mindset & Approach

  • Operational excellence: you obsess over clean data, timely execution, and process rigor.
  • Problem-solver: you anticipate operational pain points and design solutions before they become crises.
  • Cross-functional fluency: you speak the language of investments, accounting, compliance, and GPs.
  • Teacher: you document processes, mentor junior staff, and ensure continuity even as the team scales.
  • Low ego, high ownership: you are comfortable doing hands-on work (data entry, tracking, reconciliation) while also building systems.

Nice to Have

  • FINRA Series 7 or Series 65 (not required, but valued).
  • Prior multi-fund platform experience.
  • CPA or accounting background is a plus.
  • Exposure to infrastructure or venture investing.

Benefits

  • Location: Remote (preferred US timezone overlap with San Francisco HQ)
  • Salary Range: $140,000–$210,000 base + 20% bonus
  • Equity: TBD (0.05%–0.15%)
  • Reports to: US Platform Head / Managing Director
  • Hiring Timeline: Month 2–4

Why This Role Matters

Operations is the hidden differentiator between a credible platform and a chaotic one. Clean, timely, error-free operations build institutional LP confidence and reduce friction for GPs. You are building that credibility.

Why Infra One

  • Impact: Build operational standards and processes that scale to 20+, 50+ funds.
  • Team building: Hire and mentor operations analysts as the platform grows.
  • Learning curve: Exposure to multi-fund management, LP reporting, and institutional investor relations.
  • Strategic partnership: Direct access to the MD; input into platform design and vendor selection.
  • Equity upside: Early-stage role with meaningful equity; directly tied to platform success.

raw.excerpt: Who We Are Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world’s leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We’re an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

Our Values

Customers

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

Action

We make ‘thoughtfully fast’ decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

Team Spirit

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

Innovation

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

Excellence

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

About the Role:

The Senior Product Manager owns the commercial lifecycle of multiple Payments products or premium features, from idea incubation through technical requirements, go-to-market launch, customer adoption, and ongoing support. Working with internal and external stakeholders, this role defines the requirements behind world-class order-to-cash products. Responsible for partnering closely with engineering leads to translating those requirements into detailed functionality and shepherd the build through to release. The Senior Product Manager is accountable for delivering business outcomes via successful launch and utilization and brings deep SaaS and market expertise to fuel profitable growth of the product portfolio.

What You'll Do:

  • Own commercial success of assigned Payments products and features, aligning roadmap to revenue, margin, and adoption targets
  • Define, prioritize, and manage the product backlog to drive meaningful pod outcomes, with clear business justification behind each initiative
  • Act as the primary commercial voice across cross-functional teams, synthesizing input from Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering into a compelling product strategy
  • Evaluate and champion new ideas based on market demand, AI readiness, ROI, and long-term customer value
  • Serve as a thought leader on AI integration within Payments workflows, identifying ways to streamline, automate, and differentiate through intelligent design
  • Lead competitive analysis and market research to defend and extend our leadership position in AR automation
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to define messaging, positioning, and enablement tied to core product differentiators
  • Run product launch and go-to-market efforts for new features, capabilities, and AI-powered workflows
  • Engage actively with customers to validate the roadmap, guide adoption, and build a feedback loop that fuels continuous innovation
  • Monitor and report on product KPIs, delivering transparency and accountability across all levels of the organization
  • Lead the annual planning baseline, defining tradeoffs, benefits, and impact of work
  • Recognize the drivers of financial health for the product portfolio, accounting for tradeoffs and presenting options
  • Manage a high volume of large product initiatives within a defined period, ensuring successful build outcomes
  • Act as a mentor and coach for other product managers
  • Travel quarterly for customer onsite meetings and events
    •

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5–7+ years of commercial and technical product ownership experience across multiple companies
  • Experience in financial, payment, or treasury product roles requiring high attention to detail, including online payments, payment reconciliation, or B2B fintech
  • Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable automation, Cash Application workflows, and B2B finance processes
  • Proven experience in go-to-market and launch strategy
  • Strong grasp of market drivers, with familiarity in Total Addressable Market (TAM), Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), and Target Customer Profile (TCP)
  • Demonstrated success scaling mature products and leading transformation efforts, ideally involving AI/ML capabilities
  • Exposure to AI technologies, including LLMs, data classification models, and agent-based automation
  • Deep commercial acumen, with the ability to dissect revenue drivers, customer segments, pricing models, and adoption funnels
  • Ability to manage a product backlog in a fast-paced, product-centric environment
  • Prior experience working directly with enterprise customers and translating complex needs into scalable solutions
  • Ability to engage clients directly in user forums, roundtables, and customer outreach sessions
  • Exceptional self-starter who is proactive, resourceful, and accountable without requiring constant oversight
  • Strong communicator and influencer, able to align stakeholders around strategy and execution
    •
The expected base salary range for this position is $117,000 - $156,00 annually.
Compensation may vary depending on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, competencies, and geographic location. Some roles may qualify for additional incentives like equity, commissions, or other variable performance-related bonuses. Further details will be provided by our Talent Acquisition team during the interview process.

What You’ll Get

At Billtrust, we believe your total rewards should reflect the impact you make. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health coverage, competitive retirement, generous PTO and parental leave, flexible work options, and meaningful investment in your professional development. We’re building something special and we want you to feel supported while doing it.

At Billtrust, we value an equitable and inclusive work environment and strive to build and foster diverse teams. Even if your work experience doesn’t align exactly with the position requirements, we’d still love to hear from you. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace that celebrates and supports diversity and inclusion. We make all employment and related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

raw.title: Intermediate Substation Protection & Control Engineer
raw.excerpt: As an Intermediate Protection and Control Electrical Engineer on our Industrial Commercial Energy team, you’ll independently execute defined P&C packages for utility substation projects as they move through each project phase.
raw.description:
As an Intermediate Protection and Control Electrical Engineer on our Industrial Commercial Energy team, you’ll independently execute defined P&C packages for utility substation projects as they move through each project phase. Working under the Senior P&C lead, you’ll develop protection, control, wiring, communications, and relay design deliverables for distribution- and transmission-voltage substations and switchyards. From anywhere in the continental United States, you’ll collaborate with engineers, designers, clients, and construction teams while helping deliver reliable power infrastructure and sharing in the firm you help build.

About Wade Trim

    Wade Trim has been developing solutions to complex engineering and planning challenges for a century to deliver water and sewer services to residents and businesses, keep traffic flowing smoothly and safely, treat wastewater and stormwater to protect our waterways, distribute reliable power to customers, and provide community spaces to enjoy.

    We’re 100% employee-owned, so our 850+ employee-owners share in the firm’s success and help set its direction. Our teams are organized by practice, so you’ll collaborate with experts and leaders across offices and markets. We also invest in new ideas through our Office of Applied Technology and Innovation Hub.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently execute defined P&C packages for a utility substation project and affected adjacent substations under the direction of the Senior P&C lead

  • Develop schematics, AC/DC elementary and three-line diagrams, panel elevations and wiring, interconnection drawings, protection and control circuits, panel and DICM details, and communications and logic diagrams, including adjacent-substation relaying modifications

  • Prepare and update RTU control, status, and analog point lists; wiring, raceway, and cable schedules; signage and nameplate packages; and engineering calculations such as cable sizing, voltage drop, and station service interface support

  • Work with AutoCAD Electrical designers and drafters, incorporate redlines and review comments, and coordinate with SCADA/communications, senior engineers, designers, and other disciplines through project submittals

  • Assist with QA/QC reviews and apply engineering standards, client requirements, and utility practices while contributing to P&C standards, templates, and workflows

  • Participate in client and project meetings, provide technical support during procurement, construction, factory acceptance testing, and commissioning, maintain excellent client relations, and maintain a safe working environment

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering

  • 4+ years of substation Protection and Control design experience, including utility substation projects

  • Experience with distribution- and transmission-voltage substations and switchyards

  • Experience with protective relaying and control design, including schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, and interconnection drawings

  • Ability to independently produce defined P&C packages, including cable schedules, protection and control circuits, panel and DICM details, and communications and logic diagrams

  • Familiarity with utility standards and engineering codes, along with strong writing, organizational, and communication skills and the ability to be self-motivated and work well with others

  • Willingness to travel up to 10%

Nice to Have

  • E.I.T. certification; PE licensure is a plus

  • Knowledge of IEEE, NESC, NEC, NFPA, and ANSI standards

  • Experience with AutoCAD Electrical workflows

  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Bluebeam Revu PDF Editor

  • Experience with Bentley ProjectWise or SharePoint

  • Familiarity with relay engineering or power-system software tools

Work Arrangement

    This is a full-time remote opportunity for candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones within the continental United States. A hybrid work arrangement is preferred for candidates who live within reasonable driving distance of a Wade Trim office

What We Offer

    As an employee-owner, you’ll share in the firm’s success through profit sharing, an employee stock purchase plan, and a 401(k) with a company match. You’ll have every opportunity to grow through mentoring, the Wade Trim Leadership Academy, and tuition reimbursement.

    And because life outside of work matters, we offer paid parental leave, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, and a stewardship day, along with medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance and an employee assistance program.

Come grow with us! Apply today and help build the infrastructure your community counts on. 3209

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants of every background, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.title: DevSecOps Engineer
raw.excerpt: Chcesz rozwijać nowoczesne platformy Monitoring & Observability i wykorzystywać AI do zwiększania niezawodności systemów?
raw.description:
Chcesz rozwijać nowoczesne platformy Monitoring & Observability i wykorzystywać AI do zwiększania niezawodności systemów? Dołącz do projektu realizowanego dla globalnej organizacji technologicznej, która intensywnie inwestuje w platformy chmurowe, inteligentną automatyzację oraz rozwiązania nowej generacji w obszarze obserwowalności systemów.

Szukamy osób na poziomie Mid i Senior, które mają doświadczenie w obszarze DevSecOps, SRE lub Platform Engineering, dobrze odnajdują się w złożonych środowiskach chmurowych i chcą rozwijać rozwiązania wspierające proaktywne monitorowanie, automatyzację operacji oraz szybsze reagowanie na incydenty.

Ważne: praca w tym projekcie odbywa się w języku angielskim.

O roli i zespole

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego nowoczesne rozwiązania Monitoring & Observability dla globalnej organizacji technologicznej. Będziesz projektować i optymalizować platformy monitoringu, które zwiększają widoczność działania aplikacji i infrastruktury, usprawniają diagnostykę oraz przyspieszają reagowanie na incydenty.

W codziennej pracy będziesz:

  • Rozwijać rozwiązania monitoringu i telemetryczne z wykorzystaniem Azure Monitor, Grafana, Splunk i OpenTelemetry.

  • Tworzyć dashboardy, alerty i mechanizmy wykrywania anomalii.

  • Wykorzystywać AI i automatyzację do usprawniania operacji oraz analizy przyczyn incydentów.

  • Wspierać rozwój rozwiązań self-healing i autonomicznych procesów operacyjnych.

  • Współpracować z międzynarodowymi zespołami engineering, security i operations.

Wymagania

  • Doświadczenie w obszarze DevSecOps, SRE, Platform Engineering lub na podobnym stanowisku.

  • Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi monitoringu i observability, takich jak Azure Monitor, Grafana lub Splunk.

  • Doświadczenie z OpenTelemetry w zakresie metryk, logów i distributed tracing.

  • Znajomość automatyzacji i monitorowania infrastruktury w dużych środowiskach.

  • Doświadczenie w diagnostyce problemów, zarządzaniu incydentami i analizie ich przyczyn (RCA).

  • Umiejętność współpracy w międzynarodowym środowisku – językiem pracy w projekcie jest angielski.

Dodatkowym atutem będzie:

  • Doświadczenie w wykorzystaniu AI do monitoringu i wykrywania anomalii.

  • Znajomość rozwiązań self-healing, automatyzacji oraz systemów opartych na agentach.

Oferujemy

  • Współpracę w formule B2B opartą na partnerskich zasadach.

  • Możliwość realizacji ambitnych projektów dla klientów z różnych branż.

  • Udział w projektach technologicznych z obszaru AI, data oraz transformacji cyfrowej.

  • Współpracę z organizacją realnie zaangażowaną w zrównoważony rozwój i odpowiedzialne wykorzystanie technologii.

  • Elastyczność w zakresie organizacji i sposobu realizacji zadań projektowych.

  • Dostęp do środowiska ekspertów i wymianę wiedzy w ramach realizowanych przedsięwzięć.

  • Projekty realizowane z wykorzystaniem nowoczesnego stosu technologicznego i najnowszych rozwiązań rynkowych.

  • Poszerzanie doświadczeń poprzez udział w innowacyjnych przedsięwzięciach i wdrożeniach.

Knowit

Knowit to nordycka firma konsultingowa, która pomaga firmom, instytucjom publicznym i organizacjom odnosić sukcesy w transformacji cyfrowej. Dzięki ekspertyzie w obszarze tworzenia oprogramowania, AI, cyberbezpieczeństwa, usług chmurowych, cyfrowych doświadczeń klienta oraz doradztwa zarządczego, tworzymy rozwiązania, które przyczyniają się do bardziej zrównoważonego i skoncentrowanego na człowieku społeczeństwa.

raw.title: Product Manager Co-op – DNA to Family History (Bridges)
raw.excerpt: About Ancestry: When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important.
raw.description:
About Ancestry:

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.

We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- see the full list of eligible US locations HERE). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.

Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

As a Product Management Co-op, you will spend six months working 20 hours per week on the Bridges team, working directly with the Senior Director of Product for Activate. You will own real pieces of the roadmap, run experiments, and ship to customers on the web and in the Ancestry app. You will work with product managers, designers, engineers, data scientists, DNA scientists, and user researchers.

This role is designed as a path into product management at Ancestry. Co-ops who perform strongly will be considered for a full-time product role.


What you'll do:

  • Understand DNA-first customers. Dig into research, customer feedback, and session recordings to learn why DNA customers do or don't move into family history, and where they drop off.
  • Shape and ship Bridges experiences. Help define features that connect DNA matches, origins, and grandparent-level insights to tree building and records, then write clear requirements and work with design and engineering to ship them.
  • Run experiments. Form hypotheses, set up A/B tests with analytics partners, analyze the results, and recommend next steps.
  • Improve the path to subscription. Find ways to make the moment a DNA customer meets a paywall clearer and more relevant to what they care about.
  • Measure what matters. Track Bridges metrics such as DNA-to-family-history conversion, tree creation and repeat visits, and share what you learn with the team and leadership.
  • Build with AI. Use our AI tools for discovery, prototyping, and requirements, and take part in the product org's AI Builder Weeks.

Who you are:

  • Currently enrolled in a graduate program (business, information systems, computer science, data, design, genetics, or a related field), and available immediately for part-time work for 6 months.
  • Curiosity about people and why they do what they do, shown through school projects, research, a startup, product work, or an internship.
  • Comfort with data: you can pull together a spreadsheet analysis, read an experiment result, and explain what it means in plain language.
  • Clear writing and speaking, and the ability to work with engineers, designers, and analysts without formal authority.
  • Strong ownership: you take on ambiguous problems, ask good questions, and follow through.
  • Interest in family history, genetics, personal identity, or storytelling.

Nice to have:

  • Prior product, UX, analytics, or growth internship experience, especially on a consumer app or subscription product.
  • Experience with A/B testing, SQL, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude for research, analysis, or prototyping.
  • Familiarity with DNA matching, ethnicity estimates, or genealogy research.

Additional Information:

Ancestry is an Equal Opportunity Employer that makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, citizenship, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. In addition, Ancestry will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

All job offers are contingent on a background check screen that complies with applicable law. For candidates who live in San Francisco, CA, pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Ancestry will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Ancestry is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Ancestry via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Ancestry. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Ancestry as a result of the referral or through other means.

Why join ghSMART?

Meaningful Impact Everyday: We believe leadership is the greatest force for good.  At ghSMART, whether you're guiding the world’s top leaders or helping power the firm from within, you play a vital role in solving our clients’ greatest challenge: building and developing talented, diverse teams that fuel lasting success. Learn why our consultants love working here.  
We are ranked #1 or #2 in 10 Consulting categories by Vault. See what others think about working at ghSMART on Glassdoor. 

Compensation

Our compensation model reflects these values. Compensation for this role in the United States includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution, and a comprehensive benefits package. You should reasonably expect a base salary of $90,000 - $95,000. In addition, we offer an annual discretionary performance bonus.

Wir sind ein dynamisches Team aus Berlin Friedrichshain.

Start: ab sofort

Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.

We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly $200M raised to date.

Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company, and swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards, including Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform, and the Hotelier’s Choice Award. We’re scaling our team to bring innovation to life faster than ever.

We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. We value rigor and velocity in equal measure: high standards, fast pace, real ownership. If that's the environment you're looking for, this is the place for you.

Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.

About the Role

Canary Technologies is seeking a highly motivated Associate Account Executive to help our growing company drive new customer acquisition in Greece. This is an excellent opportunity for a self-starter who is looking to grow their sales career at a fast-paced tech company.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage the full sales cycle from lead generation and prospecting to negotiation and closing
  • Deliver against a revenue quota while maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities
  • Research and engage target accounts through multiple channels
  • Effectively communicate Canary’s value proposition and tailor solutions to customer needs
  • Leverage Salesforce for lead and pipeline management, and sales forecasting
  • Contribute to building and refining sales processes that enable Canary to scale globally

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of work experience in Sales
  • Languages: Greek fluent/native and English

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience as an FCR
  • Prior experience in hospitality, software, or sales

Compensation

    Target cash compensation ranges from €50,000–€65,000, including a fixed annual salary and uncapped commission paid monthly.

    This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval.

    Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location.

Perks & Benefits

We work hard to make Canary a fun, rewarding, and high-energy place to work. Here’s how we take care of our flock:

Time Off

  • Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to truly rest and recharge.
  • Holidays + Canary Days: Standard holidays plus monthly company-wide days off for a guaranteed long weekend.
  • Birthday Holiday: A dedicated day off to celebrate you!

Travel & Office Flexibility

  • Office Exchange: A travel stipend to visit the team in person at our SF, NY, or Dallas hubs.
  • Canary Hotel Experience: Staying at a Canary hotel? We’ve got you covered with a credit toward your stay.
  • Preferred Hotels Discount: Enjoy a minimum 30% off the best available rate at select partner hotels globally.

Growth & Community

  • Self Improvement Club: A monthly budget to help you smash your personal goals.
  • Professional Development: Level up your career with a dedicated learning stipend to fuel your skills and cross-functional connection.
